quest.0000A88BB40B2149.quest_desc: Now before you get to the Chaos Island I recommend preparing, he may look like the Ender Dragon but this one is much more difficult. You'll want Draconic Weapons or Tools that do a lot of damage as those will make it easier. He will also do a crap-ton of damage good Armor like Unobtainium or Meka-Suit will be recommeneded. (Also effects of Regeneration, Absorption, and Resistance will help you survive}. Don't worry you can always come back to fight another day if you aren't ready.
quest.00075A5F9AC120ED.quest_desc: This will take the items out of your input chest.
quest.001A348054127235.quest_desc:
&5Budding Amethyst&r can be useful for Crafting Recipes and even just Growing &5Amethyst&r! 

With a &5Amethyst Block&r, &a60 Eterna&r, between &c30% &fand &c50% Quanta&r, and &550% Arcana&r we can &d&lInfuse&r one. 

To get all those stats we can use 10 &9Deepshelves&r (not &9Dormant&r ones), 2 &2Melonshelves&r, and 7 &7Basic Bookshelves&r.

Or, if you chose &bSeashelves&r, you can use 11 &bCrystalline Seashelves&r and 1 &bInfused Seashelf&r.
quest.00453FF528AA0B1C.quest_desc:
&7Lonestar Skeletons&r are hostile Mobs that can spawn anywhere. 

They have 10 &4Hearts&r and will throw their Sword at you to attack you. 

On death they can drop Bones, &7Deepsilver Nuggets&r, and &7Shattered Swords&r.
quest.008D186B4E0ED14F.title: Steam Oven
quest.00AC7CC291A3E590.quest_desc:
You've probably (definitely) seen structures around the world with what looks like Beacons coming out of them. They're made of cobblestone, have 4 legs supporting them, kinda high in the air! 

Hopefully you know it but they're called &8Dark Temples&r and they have an &aEnviromental Accumulator&r which we need. 

You'll have to wait for Thunderstorm to happen to fill your Weather Container. Then, you can make your &3Lightning Bomb&r!
quest.00AC7CC291A3E590.title: &3Lightning Bomb
quest.00C26068B55F4FD9.quest_desc: Runes of Silence only do one thing to the spawner and that's to shut it up. Don't like hearing the stupid Spawner noises? Then use a Rune of Silence!
quest.00C26068B55F4FD9.title: Quiet down you'll wake up the mobs!
quest.00D7BCC68D971A53.quest_desc: Living creatures nearby will be automatically tracked, even through walls. If it's an aggressive mob you'll get a warning when it targets you.
quest.00D80AA4CDD8335C.quest_desc:
&6&lPriest&r not &6Holy&r enough for you? Well you can Craft the &6Lightbringer Chestplate&r! 

First, you'll need the &6Priest Robes&r, which you can Craft. 

You'll need 3 &bMithril Weaves&r which are made from &bMithril&r and Chains. 

Then, you will have to get the &dDivine Soulshard&r and you can Craft the &6Chestplate&r. 

This &6Chestplate&r has the same Armor Points as the &6Priest Robes&r, but everything else gets much better! 

You get Armor Toughness, Knockback Resistance, and of course more &3Spell Power&r and Mana.
quest.00E1F1279F97557B.quest_desc: Similar to the Extruder MK1 but this one is more evolved! Can be used with Patterns so when Blocks are placed they will go in that pattern!
quest.00F2C4A528873A6B.quest_desc: The &l&bRunic Crucible&r requires &dSource&r to work. Unfortunately, we do not have &dSource Hatches&r to support it. We have another solution, though. Converting that &dSource&r into a liquid using the &dSource Condenser&r. Simply place a &dSource Jar&r with some &dSource&r next to the &dSource Condenser&r, and it will convert it into &dLiquefied Source&r. Now it can be handled by &9Fluid Hatches&r.
quest.00F2C4A528873A6B.title: &l&dSource Condensation

quest.01EC5DB1A4A25B0B.quest_desc: &aGateways&r are easy ways to get &aPassive Mobs&r and Loot Rewards! \\n\\nOkay, maybe not easy. You'll need to Fight off Waves of &cMonsters&r. Plus you'll need an &aEye of Ender&r or an &5Ender Pearl&r to make it. \\n\\nBut it is worth it! \\n\\nDifferent &aGates&r give different Rewards and &cMonsters&r.
quest.022C38096F79EF07.quest_desc: &6&lForbidden \& Arcanus&r is all about using the Arcane to do rituals with the Forge to become stronger! \n\nOr what most know it for, Eternal Stella. There's more to the Mod you know!
quest.02414CBEF2CD5A9D.title: &7Deepsilver Sword
quest.028472D7F51D439A.title: &aFlowglaze Scythe
quest.02B5E57E9E803F78.title: The Sentient Shell
quest.02C6132919DEAF2A.quest_desc:
Before we start making &aEnergy&r let's get our Steam all over the place. We can do that by surrounding the &9Rotational Complex&r with &9Pressure Dispersers&r! 

Above that layer we'll need a new layer, this one full of &aElectromagnetic Coils&r. These will be moved because of the &9Rotational Complex&r, them moving with each other is what develops &aEnergy&r through their Magnetic Forces. Same thing happens with Hydroelectric Plants! 

Above the &aElectromagnetic Coils&r we can use &9Saturating Condensers&r which will recycle our Steam back into some &9Water&r! The &9Water&r will be extracted through the &9Vents&r.
quest.02F2DF9D9DA7833A.quest_desc:
In order to get our &9Corrupt Souls&r we'll need to do some &5Enchanting&r! 

We are looking for the &5Soul Looting Enchantment&r. It goes on Weapons, and everytime you kill a Mob it has a chance to spawn a &9Corrupt Soul&r. 

These can then be killed to get them as Items. Try to do it quickly as they like to fly away. 

Maybe they know you want to kill them?
quest.02F2DF9D9DA7833A.title: &5Soul Looting Enchantment
quest.02F3133A9006BC1E.quest_subtitle: Molten Steel over Iron/Coal Bee Spawn Egg
quest.03250A0202C25E80.quest_desc: After you've successfully slain the &9Unbound Marid&r Demon that you summoned with &4Tibira's Attraction&r, you can use the &9Marid Essence&r that it drops to craft the "highest" colored Chalk, Blue Chalk.
quest.034A9FBCA6D79BB6.quest_desc: The Harvester Pylon needs a Hoe to work. \n\n(Hoes that can't break will work forever, Hoes that can will need to be replaced).
quest.03564837ECB5CC79.quest_desc:
Another Ritual of course, this one being &2Ihagan's Enthrallment&r. (BTW in order to sacrifice a Horse you need it nearby while doing the ritual) 

Once done you will be given a &2Dragon Familiar&r. You will have to throw a Creature Catcher at it to use it for the &6&lATM Star&r.

This one will follow you around and can be pet by using Shift Right Click on it.
quest.03564837ECB5CC79.title: &2Dragon Familiar&r in a Creature Catcher
quest.035C52EF63AD23A7.quest_desc: Hence the name of the mod, &lRailCraft&r, and what it revolves around, &5Trains&r, &6Rails&r are pretty important. \n\nThe &2Vanilla&r ones work for lots of these but come on we all know they suck. Upgraded ones will need some more special items for their recipes! Craft them! (They might require using machines to make the items so check out that part of the quest!)
quest.037488EF1F3581CE.quest_desc: By default, an ME network on its own only has an internal buffer of 800AE without an ME Controller, with the controller adding an extra 8kAE per block. For large enough networks, this can be insufficient and may cause a network to power off intermittently when trying to recoup power for any connected devices.\n\nThe &bEnergy Cell&f allows for an ME network to hold significantly more energy, adding another 200kAE per regular Energy Cell and 1.6MAE per &bDense&f Energy Cell. These can also be placed anywhere in the network to provide the increased energy buffer.
quest.038812A14456236C.quest_desc: By combining some Processors, an Energy Cell, and any Dense Cable we get the ME Quantum Ring. \n\nUsually we'd use it to connect our ME system across Dimensions but we only care about the &6&lATM Star&r!
quest.03C54B07106091DD.quest_desc:
&cSmelter Prism&r is probably the most used Item from these Rituals, like how it is needed for the &6&lATM Star&r! 

You'll need 4 &cBlaze Powder&r, 2 &8Coal&r, and a block of &bArcane Crystal&r to make it. And don't forget the &3Elementarium&r Relic! 
Obviously and what you are most likely wanting the &cSmelter Prism&r for is the &6&lATM Star&r. It can also be used with Tools to Smelt the Items that they break: Raw Ore to Ingots, Logs to Charcoal, Sand to Glass. 

You can also use it for Furnace Fuel, but it kinda sucks. Which is dumb because the name suggests it would be better!
quest.03C54B07106091DD.title: &cSmelter Prism
quest.03E05018D64DDEE1.quest_desc: &eTier 5&r is basically just for Allthemodium Ore, not much else.
quest.03E6FA4DCB71162E.quest_desc: The &bColor Applicator&f is a chargeable tool that allows for in-world dyeing of cables. It functions more or less as a specialised &estorage cell&f to be loaded up with either vanilla dyes or &epaint balls&f for specific colours, along with &esnowballs&f to wash colours off and turn cables back to their Fluix variant.\n\nApplying colour to a cable uses 100AE of energy from its internal battery, for a total of 3400 cable segments in a single charge.
quest.03E6FA4DCB71162E.title: Color Applicator
quest.041CDB45450A67E0.quest_subtitle: Alloy Platinum Bee Spawn Egg with Ancient Bee Spawn Egg
quest.0447551EF7FB171B.quest_desc: Don't need anymore processing, this isn't a &4Blood&r Test, it's just fuel! \n\nJust Pipe the &4Pedestal&r to the &c&lForge&r and watch the &4Blood&r flow in!
quest.04833C4BB0CCCBB7.quest_desc: Same as Stone Weapons just the &7Sword &rwill Drop &eAmbrosium Shards&r when Hitting Mobs and the &7Axe&r will drop them when chopping down &2Trees&r.
quest.04833C4BB0CCCBB7.title: &7Holystone&r Weapons
quest.0483D3B051665F07.quest_desc:
&5Zanite&r gets a whole lot more uses than the other Items before it. 

We can make Tools and Armor out of it. 

Even special Items like &5Nature Staff&r and an &5&lAltar&r.
quest.0483D3B051665F07.title: &5Zanite
quest.0484051446480B54.title: &6Allthemodium &5Alloy &3Axe
quest.04A7AA70C23830FF.quest_desc: Sickles tools that can be used to clear large amount of organic materials. Sickles break blocks in an area around the block you mine.

quest.04B92FAB179A74C9.quest_desc: The &dGravitite Sword&r will toss whatever it Hits in the Air. Like Knockback... just up! \n\nThe &dGravitite Axe&r is the only way to cut down &eGolden Oak Trees&r.
quest.04B92FAB179A74C9.title: &dGravitite&r Weapons
quest.050CCE5D1DD6B21E.title: &c&lAutomatic Hepheastus Forge
quest.050CD33E92601651.title: &l&3Tier 2 &6Forge
quest.0539AF15A10B2859.quest_desc:
&lCompact Machines&r allow you to enter a compacted dimension. After placing a &lCompact Machine&r, you can enter it using the Personal Shrinking Device.

The size of the &lCompact Machine&r is dependent on the recipe, ranging from 5x5x5 to 45x45x45!

You can't break the &lCompact Machine&r's walls, and you can exit by Right Clicking the Personal Shrinking Device.
quest.0573B6F1BE5110FD.title: &e&lProductive Bees&r
quest.05850541675B2493.quest_desc:
It does. 

You have created the &6&lATM Star&r, that means you have beat the modpack!

So what's next?
quest.05850541675B2493.title: &6&lATM Star
quest.060CAF1582B83918.title: &eOccupied Village
quest.061A51A0EC13CA0F.quest_desc:
Now that we have a &aController&r, &bDrains&r, and &4Tanks&r, we'll need a few more Blocks. 

First, is &6Liquid Heating Coils&r. These will make up the floor of the &c&lFoundry&r, and are needed to Heat up the &c&lFoundry&r. 

Last is either &c&lFoundry&r Windows or &cFire Bricks&r. These are what we'll use for the rest of the structure! The building blocks, quite literally. 

The &c&lFoundry&r will not need the frame built out, so every corner can remain empty; but it must have 4 Walls and a Floor to be completed. The &aController&r will tell you where a Block is missing, if there is one. 

The &c&lFoundry&r can be as small as 1x1 on the inside, as long as it has a &aController&r, &6Liquid Heating Coils&r, and the other Walls filled! 

I don't recommend making one so small though, as the bigger the &c&lFoundry&r, the more space it has in it! 

You'll know the &c&lFoundry&r is built, when the &aController&r lights up like a Furnace, and the &6Liquid Heating Coils&r turn &6Orange&r.
quest.061C4A9E439CE09B.title: &9Malarite Shovel
quest.066438B01655D866.quest_desc: While their &dEssence&r is useful, we can also capture these Spirits for later use. That sounds evil, doesn't it?\n\nTo become a Spirit Hunter, you'll need to create the &dVengeance Focus&r first. This is used to &aFreeze Spirits&r in place, then you place a &9Box of Eternal Closure&r near the Spirit. This will then suck the Spirit in for later use.
quest.066B8A75B299AED8.title: &9&lSqueezer
quest.068294A7C21DE550.quest_desc: &cTrack Kits&r are used to craft with &6rails&r to make special &6rails&r. \n\nThese &6rails&r will be helpful for everything &5Train&r wise like: stopping the &5Train&r, moving the &5Train&r, and emitting redstone.
quest.068294A7C21DE550.title: &c&lTracks&r!
quest.0688CE330DAF8714.title: &cStarfire Hoe
quest.06AD25DB96F3A1CC.title: &cMercury&r Vessel
quest.06B6786122F3DAF9.quest_desc: Affects the time of day a bee can work. There are 3 levels of this: &aDiurnal&r, &dNocturnal&r, &cMetaturnal&r. &aDiurnal&r bees can only work during daytime, &dNocturnal&r bees can only work during nighttime, &cMetaturnal&r bees can work at any time of the day. &cMetaturnal&r is what we're after. BeeBee naturally has the &cMetaturnal&r trait. As mentioned in the &a&lProductivity&r quest, this bee is found in The Other, and is a particularly lethal one.\n\nIf you'd rather not deal with that lethal bee, there's another option. We will need to leash some bees to a fence during nighttime to make them &dNocturnal&r, then leaving those bees out on a fence during daytime to make them &cMetaturnal&r. We can skip one of these steps with a Ghostly Bee or Shroombees, which are naturally &dNocturnal&r.
quest.06B85804163DD18B.quest_desc: The Soaryn Box (Soaryn being the author of XyCraft) is the chest of XyCraft.\n\nIt will not hold items off breaking the block! I wonder what those squares on it do?
quest.06B9D8973E9C6A2C.quest_desc: You might be wondering: Why is an Ars Nouveau item in the Occultism chapter? That's because we have Ars Ocultas, to bridge the two mods. Particularly, Spirits, like our Foliot Crusher, can work in these jars. You can even pipe items into the jars for the spirits to interact with, and they will output it to adjacent inventories (I found the bottom side of the jar to be the most reliable place they output to). If they cannot output to an inventory, they'll output the items into the world.
quest.06B9D8973E9C6A2C.quest_subtitle: Spirits can work in Containment Jars
quest.06B9D8973E9C6A2C.title: Ars Ocultas: Spirit Jars
quest.06D3EC025557855F.title: &7Deepsilver Axe
quest.06F70F6CA37168CC.quest_desc:
The &6&oGem Case of House Fabergé&r is a better &5Gem Case&r. 

It can hold higher amounts of &aGems&r.

The &5Gem Case&r can hold 32768, while the &6&oGem Case of House Fabergé&r can hold 2.1 Billion of each unique &aGem&r! 

To obtain it, we'll need to &d&lInfuse&r the &5Gem Case&r. 

Use 4 &9Soul-Touched Sculkshelves&f, 4 &9Echoing Sculkshelves&f, 2 &dDraconic Endshelves&f, 7 &7Stoneshelves&r, and 1 &7Basic Bookshelf&r.
quest.06F70F6CA37168CC.title: &6&oGem Case of House Fabergé
quest.070CAEAD49B8DBA3.quest_desc:
For 8 Stacks of &7Compressed Iron Blocks&r and an &6&lATM Star&r you can get the &5Creative &7Compressed Iron Block&r! 

This can be set to any temperature you want it to be set to, which can then be used in your Machines. 

8 Stacks of &7Compressed Iron Blocks&r equals 4,608 &7Compressed Iron Ingots&r... good luck!
quest.0720474D384F4774.quest_desc:
&eMarimold&r are Mushrooms that grow Underwater. 

You can find big and little versions of them. 

The Blocks look like a mix of &6Honey&r and &eShroomlights&r.
quest.0720474D384F4774.title: &eMarimold
quest.073D0D41BA5F219B.quest_desc:
Deep within the hellish, heretic lands of the &cNether&r lies a &6relic&r that demands timing... the &cShield of Retaliation&r. 

Forged by a machine to shield against attacks, but with a price. The price being vulnerability if the window of opportunity passes. 

- &lIt has 1 ability:&r 

 &4Retaliation&r: 
 Upon use, you block the next instance of damage that faces the &6relic&r for a short period of time. Failing to block damage during the window makes you more vulnerable for some time.

- A &6relic&r of precise timing, protecting the user at just the right moment.
quest.073D0D41BA5F219B.title: &cShield of Retaliation
quest.076A648E3E3245C9.title: &aEmerald Generator
quest.079A415488A32076.quest_desc: Blaze Ember is a new material added by JDT. Blaze Ember is acquired by performing Goo Spread on Primal Coal Blocks using tier two goo or higher. Blaze Ember Ore is affected by fortune.
quest.07AF1D5C24B069DD.quest_desc:
The &0Cockatrice Specter&r is made from &0Cockatrice Eyes&r and &0Wither&r parts. Wait another Eye? Why are we collecting Eyes? 

With the &0Specter&r we can give (some) Mobs &0Wither&r III for 2 Seconds. 

It has a range of about 20 Blocks and does have a Cooldown.
quest.07AF1D5C24B069DD.title: &8Cockatrice Specter
quest.07BEB974DF1E5AD3.quest_desc: Makes Energy at the same rate as an &aEmerald Generator&r but has a much higher Transfer Rate. Also arguably cheaper as it takes less items but that item is also &5Netherite&r so...
quest.07BEB974DF1E5AD3.title: &5Netherite Generator
quest.07BEE6FEC14765DC.quest_desc:
Pretty simple recipe needing Clay, Iron, Slimeballs, and more... 

Lodestones are best to loot for, Mods add these in Loot Pools all over &c&lThe Nether&r so don't craft one just find one! 

Wax is a new Item added by &6&lForbidden \& Arcanus&r which is a mix of Bottle of Honey and Slimeballs! 

You can use it on a &6Darkstone Pedestal&r to get &7Magnetized Pedestals&r which work in hand with Hoppers (and Hopper like Items like Pipes). 

You can also use it with Boots to increase how close Items can be to get dragged into your Inventory!
quest.07FDA46D83F8360D.quest_desc:
For 4 &6Allthemodium Nuggets&r and an Ender Pearl you get a Teleport Pad. 

Place it down in one of the Minecraft dimensions to teleport to a different dimension. 

To teleport you need to shift right click with your main and offhand empty! That is important, read it! 

BOTH hands need to be EMPTY!
quest.0854589F28AAA8D0.title: &dStarlit Diamond Hoe
quest.08788F976B5C3281.quest_desc:
The &6Holy Sword&r is like a &bDiamond Sword&r with Smite on it. 

Smite does extra Damage to Undead Mobs. So does the &6Holy Sword&r. 

Best part is, you can Enchant it with Smite to add even more Damage!
quest.08788F976B5C3281.title: &6Holy Sword
quest.0893EFCAC7031FEA.quest_subtitle: Have your Cake and Eat it too
quest.08AC2D81A1004984.title: &6Allthemodium &5Alloy &3Trident
quest.08B60D8A25008CCC.quest_desc:
This Quest has been authored by &6AllTheMods Staff&r, or a &2Community contributor&r for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all &6AllTheMods&r packs are licensed under &eAll Rights Reserved&r, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by &6AllTheMods Team&r without explicit permission.

quest.08DDE018A804BFE7.quest_desc:
The &d&lEnrichment Chamber&r will &dEnrich &eItems&r that go through it. Just place the &eItems&r in the &4Red Slots&r and the &dEnriched Items&r will come out of the &9Blue Slots&r. 

What is an &dEnriched Item&r? Or what happens when an &eItem&r gets &dEnriched&r? Either we get more of it the &eItems&r it can be made into or change the &eItem&r themselves! 

We can get 2 Dust from 1 Ore. We can get more Dyes from one Flower. We can even change &6Copper&r Stages or take &2Moss&r off &7Cobblestone&r! 

With later Tiers of &d&lEnrichment Chambers&r we get even more Slots to &dEnrich&f more &eItems&r at once. 

We also get the ability to Auto-Sort. With the press of this Button! We can set it so the Stacks of &eItems&r will be evenly distributed to each Slot so the &d&lMachine&r is more Efficient.
quest.08E484DD3E751697.quest_subtitle: The B in Roy G. Biv
quest.08E4892F96828EC4.title: &c&lSun Spirit
quest.0910C28A609ECBC1.quest_desc:
The &6Honey Compass&r is a very useful tool added by &6&lBumblezone&r. 

You can craft one or trade for it. 

You can Shift Right Click a &eBeehive&r to track that &eHive&r (including &lProductive Beehives&r) or Right Click the Air to locate a Cell Maze.
quest.0910C28A609ECBC1.title: &6Honey Compass
quest.091957223C32B094.quest_desc: Another &aMax Eterna&r raise is necessary at this point. This time, it's to &a60&r on the &e&lAscent&r &lWorld Tier&r.
quest.091957223C32B094.title: &e&lAscent&r to 60
quest.0923C941A9696122.quest_desc:
Incase you have to bring 256 Million Items on an Adventure with you! 

You'll need a few simple Items like &8MEGA Item Cell Housing&r, &5ME Chest&r, and a &5Dense Energy Cell&r. 

And we'll then need the &d256M MEGA Storage Component&r... this one is much harder to make. 

If repetitive Crafting makes you hate &2&lMinecraft&r, then you might want to Craft the &2Blastproof Casing&r! 

We'll need either 2 256M Portable Item Cells, 2 &2Blastproof Casings&r, or a mix of both to Craft the &3&lImprobable Probability Device&r.
quest.0923C941A9696122.title: 256M Portable Item Cell
quest.097FDC136BC843A7.quest_desc:
&lWorld Tier: &6Summit&r will need you to upgrade your &eArmor&r and &eTool/Weapon&r from &aUncommon&r to &9Rare&r (or better)! You'll also need to kill &0&lThe Wither&r. 

&0&lThe Wither&r doesn't need to be an &4Invader&r and honestly, it'll be easier if he isn't. 

In &6&lSummit&r &5Epic&r &eItems &fand &2Gems&r will be the most common, and for &eItems&r you can now get &6Mythic&r and with &aGems&r you can find &zPerfect&r. Again, both being extremely rare! 

Now you'll get 75% Experience Gained, 50% Luck, and &a75 Max Eterna&r. 

&4Monsters&r will also be buffed to get 12 Armor Points, 10 Armor Toughness, 15 Armor Pierce, and 10 Protection Pierce. 

Is it just me or are their upgrades better than ours?
quest.09981C89C585002E.title: &bGlacite Helmet
quest.09BA45CBBFB4AE26.quest_desc: The next stage of this mod requires you to set up &3Assembly Lines&r. The main component of an &3Assembly Line&r is the &3Assembly Controller&r.\n\nThis is where the pressure will go.
quest.09BE81548CD81068.quest_desc: You have finally made it to the components required for the &#FFEB6EAllthemods Star&r!!
quest.09C3C0F0278C842F.title: &4Amaramber Chestplate
quest.09C82CDDA800D8C9.quest_desc:
The Wither is the second Minecraft Boss, this one being more elective. 

You'll have to build the Wither to spawn him in. Using 4 Soul Sand in a T shape and placing 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls on top will spawn him in! 

He has 300 Hearts and will fly around shooting Wither Skulls at Players or Mobs. 

When taken to half Health he will gain a shield against Projectiles and will need to be killed with a Sword or Axe. 

Once you kill him he'll drop: Nether Star, chance at a Withering Soul, and a ton of Corail Items.
quest.09D2137B4F42006E.quest_desc: Eclipse Ember is a new material added by JDT. Eclipse Ember is acquired by performing Goo Spread on Voidflame Coal Blocks using tier four goo. Eclipse Ember Ore is affected by fortune.
quest.09D76E9B8CABC31E.quest_desc: For &5&lCreative Essence&r you'll need 4 &5Insanium Essence Blocks&r. Each Block is 9 &5Essence&r now let me do the math... \n\nYou'll need 9,216 &aInferium Essence&r to get just one of these Blocks. So you'll need 36,864 &aInferium Essence&r total!
quest.09D76E9B8CABC31E.title: 4 &5Insanium Blocks
quest.09DEA44456CD5010.title: Breaching the Veil
quest.09F49ED309152E24.title: &l&cChisel Reborn
quest.0A43D38D27CF4304.title: &3Abandoned Spire
quest.0A64D0937A5F7513.title: Golden Fishing Rod
quest.0A7B0D0B81E138DE.quest_desc:
The &e&lEngineer's Toolbox&r works as a segregated Shulker. 

It has sections: Food, which you can only put Food in. Tools, which can hold &8&lIE&r Tools or other Tools just not &bBuckets&r. &cWiring&r, which can have &cWires&r, &cConnectors&r, or &cRelays&r. And Anything, which doesn't discriminate. Try to be more like the Anything section! 

Some Items can't be held within it though, like &bBuckets full of Fluids&r or Accumulator Backpacks. 

You can Shift Right Click to place down the &e&lToolbox&r to make it act like a Chest, then you can do the same to pick it up.
quest.0AC8FE3B59D1B09D.quest_desc:
The Quantum Catcher is a very useful Tool for moving Mobs. 

Simply Right Click a Mob to "catch" them, then Right Click again to let them go. 

You'll need a set amount of &bAureal&r on you in order to use it though, this is dependent on the Health of the Mob. More Health, more &bAureal&r needed! It won't cost anything to let Mobs go though, that's free. 

Oh wait, I probably should tell you how to Craft it! You'll need a &7Quantum Core&r which is crafted with &7Runes&r, &cMundabitur Dust&r, and &8Flint&r! 

The Spawner Scraps are drops from Mining a Spawner without Silk Touch, so it'll break the Spawner.
quest.0AD2B11565B484E7.quest_desc: You'll need every Furnace before &5Netherite&r for these. Yes all, even the &6Copper&r! Even the &7Silver&r! Even the &3Crystal&r!
quest.0AD2B11565B484E7.title: &zRainbow Plating
quest.0ADBE90B33ACC9FB.quest_desc: The &zRainbow Generator&r is a boost to the &zRainbow Furnace&r while using &3Augment&r: Generator. If all other 9 Furnaces (not counting AllTheModium Furnaces and above) are around the &zRainbow Furnace&r, have &3Augment&r: Generator, and are actively making Energy (fueled up and not full) they will give a boost to a &zRainbow Furnace&r that has &3Augment&r: Generator and is working. It will make 2kFE a tick more!
quest.0AE6AD813928DE4F.quest_desc:
The External Heater can be used with Furnaces, like the &2&lVanilla&r ones, not &c&lCrude Blast Furnace&r! 

It takes in &cEnergy&r from the Bottom and uses it for Heat. 

The Heat comes out of the other sides of it, to adjacent Blocks. 

It is technically used for the &4&lImproved Blast Furnace&r, by Crafting the Preheaters but I don't count that!
quest.0B1DF8A040826D87.quest_desc: Now that you have &cRossinite&r, you can mix it with &aBenitoite&r to create &dInsanite&r ingots.\n\n&aBenitoite Ore&r can be found in the Nether.
quest.0B1DF8A040826D87.title: Insanite
quest.0B218DD73FE8D985.quest_desc: If you did that last quest correctly, you should have turned that singularity into a pair of &bQuantum Entangled Singularities&f. These new singularities are used to link together a ring-shaped device known as a &eQuantum Network Bridge&f.\n\nWhen two of these individual rings have been linked using the Quantum Entangled Singularities and jumpstarted with some AE power (e.g. an energy cell), an ME network can be expanded wirelessly on the other side of the bridge, across either long distances or even dimensions.
quest.0B718FC37699B822.quest_desc:
&aEcho Logs&r are made from &aEcho Trees&r which spawn in the &5Echoing Forest&r... is there an echo in here, why do I hear it so much? 

&aEcho Trees&r have &5Purple Leaves&r and Sculk Gleam within them. While their Logs have a &7Light Grey Bark&r and a very &aLight Green Log color&r. 

All the Planks and Wood Items made from it are all the &aLight Green Color&r, almost Mint like. 

The Trapdoors and Doors even have cool unique patterns!
quest.0B9F2B443813F43C.quest_desc: Have you ever wanted to be able to attack things with a Shovel, and have it hurt? I would ask why, but this is EvilCraft.\n\nWell look no further! This serves as both a weapon, and a tool for breaking soft things!
quest.0BA0AA8A6F07D383.title: The Scribe's Tool
quest.0BCC79C1D002F532.quest_desc: To make the &bArcane Crystal Dust&r into &bLiquid Aureal&r, we'll need a liquid! Infact we'll need THE Liquid... which is &9Water&r! \n\nJust pipe &9Water&r from a &9Sink&r, it's infinite.
quest.0C096EE635645E43.title: &dCrystal &bCrossbow
quest.0C25F73C0E0FB22A.quest_desc:
Another Essence needed for our &c&lAutomatic Forge&r is &aExperience&r! Well it's &aFluid XP&r from &3&lJust Dire Things&r. 

To get &aXP Fluid&r we'll need an &aExperience Holder&r, these can be set to collect &aXP&r in a set area with the Collect XP option. 

Don't worry, Mobs killed by &7Spiked Plates&r will still drop &aXP&r, so put these next to your Farms! 

You can also deposit other forms of &aFluid XP&r into it or even your own &aXP&r levels!
quest.0C9F9196CA49FF8D.title: Oritech Beginnings
quest.0CC48C2AA553A314.quest_desc: &3Drill Bits&r can be used in a Pneumatic Jackhammer.
quest.0CE236731DF15DFF.quest_desc:
Why wait? Usually items dropped in Minecraft have a second they need to hit the ground to be picked up again. 

But why wait?

This upgrade lets the Vacuum Module not wait and immediately pick up the items. 

Very good for less lag!
quest.0CFAAF6F13EB6C2C.title: &cStarfire Hammer
quest.0D1C143B2C788204.quest_desc:
&5Seekers&r are Hostile Mobs which can Spawn anywhere in the &9&lStarlight&r. 

They have 12 and a half &4Hearts&r and fly around. 

They will Attack you by flying close and shooting their tongue at you. 

&5Seekers&r are also a great way of Farming &5Seeking Eyes&r!
quest.0D1C143B2C788204.title: &5Seekers
quest.0D2BF2C5D784FCBE.quest_desc: The &eValkyrie Cape&r will act like a Slow Falling Potion. \n\nHelpful for &e&lThe Aether&r and &d&lThe End&r!
quest.0D2BF2C5D784FCBE.title: &eValkyrie Cape
quest.0D2F07FC0F804223.title: &e&lValkyrie Queen

quest.0D330FAD6C993DBC.quest_desc: This is the next upgrade to your Spellbook! \n\nThis will increase your overall mana and mana regen, as well as allowing you to create and use Tier 2 Glyphs.
quest.0D427BD581ADC3A6.title: &aFlowglaze Pickaxe
quest.0D50BDEFA0319EA1.quest_desc: This will drop the finished product into your output chest.
quest.0D9560C8E247F9E7.quest_desc: Right-click somewhere and you will be able to pathfind your way back. If you're close enough and have a direct route, a path will appear.
quest.0DAF5D42694EA8C9.title: &#949494Forge Hammer
quest.0DC0E236C8213050.quest_desc: By combining 500mB of Unrefined Liquid Souls with a singular Soul, we can create 500mB of Liquid Souls! \n\nThis will need twice the amount of &dLiquefied Source&r that the &bLiquid Aureal&r needs, at 2000 &dLiquefied Source&r.
quest.0E057B7F76401421.title: &6Copper Backpack
quest.0E1BC2AE1BE0BDFA.title: &2Amethyst Nest
quest.0E1C2DA415D5742D.title: &bGlacite Sword
quest.0E20A9B79D1C6637.quest_desc:
The Warden is a boss added in 1.20. 

He spawns by having 3 naturally spawning Sculk Shriekers going off in a row, or any Shriekers going off after a first Warden has spawned. 

He is the most powerful Mob added by Minecraft, with 500 Hearts and over 20 Hearts damage with his attacks. 

His attacks include hitting you and Sonar Blasts for those farther. 

His only weakness is being blind, but like daredevil it just made his other senses much stronger! If you are close he can smell you and careful with making noise! 

If you somehow kill him he will drop: Sculk Catalysts, Warden Carapace, and Heart of the Deep.
quest.0E32DB6B8E023764.quest_desc:
&6&lProductive Bees&r? What are you doing here? 

Sometimes along the &6&lHive Walls&r or &6&lPillars&r you may find deposits of Combs from &l&6Productive Bees&r! 

Kinda like mining Ores in the &2Overworld&r.
quest.0E90577AC72749C4.quest_desc:
The &6Thundering Spawner Upgrade Rune&r, the 4th and final tier of Spawner Upgrade Runes brings your Spawner to its highest potential.

It sets both Minimum and Maximum Spawn Delay to 20, Spawn Count to 16, Max Entities to 32, and Activation Range to 48.

Endersurge Gems can be obtained in The End.
quest.0EF9F10A2178451F.quest_desc: All parts of the &c&lFoundry&r (except Taps, Casting Tables, and Basins) can be dyed to any &zColor&r. &zColors&r are interchangeable in a &c&lFoundry&r, too, so you can have multi-colored &c&lFoundries&r, if you like.
quest.0EF9F10A2178451F.title: &zDyeable &c&lFoundry&r &zParts
quest.0EFD0A4AE82153E8.quest_desc: You will need to craft these Tokens too for other items.
quest.0F026D5A17CCCF51.quest_desc: &dNetherite&r items are even better overall, and won't burn in lava! You still will though, even wearing the armor. Don't try it out.\n\nThese items can be used to make some of the best tools and armor in the game.
quest.0F03E75CF79BADD7.quest_desc: MEGA Cells&f offers the bespoke &bBulk Item Storage Cell&f, which is limited to no more than &oone&r type of item storeable per cell but can store a practically &o&lINFINITE&r* number of that item type. Before it can accept an item type, it must be filtered in advance using a Cell Workbench.\n\n*&oTechnically "max long". If you know, you know.&r
quest.0F0D41F29386333A.title: &dScarlet Trees
quest.0F14270F0A718C01.title: &cWarm Items
quest.0F3A0A4DC18E5E55.quest_desc:
&aEterna&r sets the &5Enchantment Level&r which determines what &5Enchantments&r you can or will get! 

It's default is &a0&r and max is determined by your &lWorld Tier&r.

&a30&r on &9&lHaven&r.
&a45&r on &2&lFrontier&r.
&a60&r on &e&lAscent&r.
&a75&r on &6&lSummit&r.
&a100&r on &4&lPinnacle&r.

Check out the Apotheosis Gear chapter or the linked quests in this chapter to learn more about &lWorld Tiers&r!

Almost all &7Bookshelves&r will give &aEterna&r but each has max they can set it to.
quest.0F412542271B6254.quest_desc:
Before we proceed with &dOccultism&r, it's time we learn about upgrading each type of Pentacle. Each pentacle builds off of the previous of that type.

This means that rather than building separate Pentacles for each tier of Ritual (I.E. a separate pentacle for summoning &aDjinnis&r and for summoning &aFoliots&r), you can have one pentacle handle multiple tiers of Rituals. For example, &9Fatma's Incentivized Attraction&r builds off of all previous Summoning pentacles.

Because of this, I suggest setting up 4 19x19 areas for each Pentacle. One for Summoning, one for Infusion, one for Possession, one for the Miscellaneous rituals (Wild and Eldritch).
quest.0F412542271B6254.title: Foreword on Pentacles
quest.0F4783FA019C4567.quest_desc: &4Amaramber&r is found rarely by stripping &cTorreya Logs&r. \n\nIt can be crafted into Ingots to make Armor and Tools or used in other recipes like a campfire which will you give you regen!
quest.0F4783FA019C4567.title: &4Amaramber
quest.0F49E9167B5E97C9.quest_desc: Any damage you take when falling (ignoring armor) will also be dealt to nearby mobs.
quest.0F5549B02D1B383B.quest_desc: Kill 16 Cave Spiders. \n\nDon't worry there is plenty of things from &6&lBumblezone&r to help with Poison.
quest.0F812AE4F247FF1C.title: &bGlacite Chestplate
quest.0F8955B74DBDF5F9.title: &cStarfire Scythe
quest.0F89BFD4A3F63A48.quest_desc: Some mobs (mostly monsters) need certain Light Levels to spawn. Hostile ones needing lower levels and passive needing higher ones. Using a Rune of Perpetual Twilight makes it so you never have to worry about Light Levels as it ignores them! This does not ignore other requirements for spawning like livestock animals needing Grass.
quest.0FD26FD88E801C0E.quest_desc: You can make a large number of vanilla mobs with the &2Altar of Birthing&r. &dSpirits of Birthing&r are made by breeding animals in areas with large amounts of aura.
quest.0FD638380EECFFBD.title: Building the &6&lForge
quest.0FE15701F2EDC3E9.quest_desc:
By stacking an &5Aethersent Block&r with a &5Lunaris Cactus Fruit&r we can make an &5Aethersent Golem&r! 

This bad boy has one job, prevent &5Creteor&r Spawns from &5Meteor Showers&r. 

If a &5Meteor Shower&r happens, he'll shoot them down before they can even Spawn!
quest.0FE15701F2EDC3E9.title: &5Aethersent Golem
quest.102DD961706E861A.quest_desc:
&5Aechor Plants&r are Hostile living Plants. Wait all Plants are living... well these have 7 and a Half &4Hearts&r which other &2&lMinecraft&r Plants don't. 

&5Aechor Plants&r will shoot out Arrows which if they hit you, you'll get the &5Inebreviation Effect&r. It acts as a Poison mixed with Nausea and a whole new Effect. 

When Killed they'll Drop their &5Petal&r.
quest.102DD961706E861A.title: &5Aechor Plant
quest.103834774B57D611.quest_desc:
The Mini End Portal will need quite a few &dEndshelves&r. These are the last tiers of Shelves you'll get from &5&lApotheosis&r. You'll need &dInfused Dragon's Breath&r to craft them. 

After that you'll just need Eyes of Ender which you'll need to have made them in order to actually get the &dEndshelves&r. 

If you somehow got to &d&lThe End&r and got the Shelves without Eyes of Ender then I'm impressed!
quest.104EBBC08B4733F5.quest_desc:
The &dSimulation Chamber&r is the main machine within HNN.

When given power, it will run simulations based on the &bData Model&r that is placed inside. The power required also depends on the &bData Model&r placed inside, and can be seen within the &bModel&r's tooltip. 

The machine also requires at least one &9Prediction Matrix&r to run a simulation.

Simulations have two modes.

&a&lTraining:&r
The &bData Model&r gains data, without producing any &eGeneralized Predictions&r or &dMob Predictions&r. Costs more &cForge Energy&r compared to &2&lInference&r.

&2&lInference:&r
The result of the simulation will be output onto the Matrix, without the &bData Model&r gaining any Data.

Simulations will always produce some kind of &eGeneralized Prediction&r, which can be used in various crafting recipes. They also vary depending on the origin of the mob in the Data Model.

If the simulation succeeds, you will receive a &dMob Prediction&r based off of the model. The higher the tier of the Data Model used, the higher the success rate is for a simulation.

Faster compared to &a&lTraining&r.
quest.10642351AD9A9907.title: &3Amphithere Arrows
quest.10D78DC368E16987.title: &aFlowglaze Axe
quest.1102B27CBF564127.quest_desc: Spawner Agitators are different from the other listed Modification items, this one is provided by PneumaticCraft instead of Apothic Spawners. Without the Apothic Spawners mod being in the Modpack, having an Agitator on a Spawner will make it spawn mobs no matter where the Player is. With Apothic Spawners, which yes we do have, it won't change that but rather will keep spawned mobs from despawning incase you leave the chunks.
quest.1113BF457DB7F1DE.quest_desc: This one is not required for the main shelf progression, but is necessary for certain &d&lInfusions&r.\n\nThe penultimate &lWorld Tier&r, &6&lSummit&r raises your &aMax Eterna&r to &a75&r.
quest.1113BF457DB7F1DE.title: To reach the &6&lSummit
quest.11374A3B5BD644F5.quest_desc: &lIndustrial Foregoing&r is a Tech Mod with tons of Machines and Tools. All following the same Color Code! \n\nYou'll need to start with Rubber and yes there is a Quest page for it!
quest.11783E5EF07481C3.title: &aFlowglaze Bow
quest.11A6D020D6F411A8.quest_desc:
Within the Land of &d&lThe End&r where nothing makes sense, lies a &2Glitchy Mantle&r. 

The &2Glitchy Mantle&r makes Enemies question their own &2perception&r... and &9sanity&r. 

&l- It has 3 Abilities&r 

1. &2Perception Glitch&r: 
Sometimes Enemies will miss their Attack against you. 

2. &9Glitchy Copy&r: 
Every little bit a &9Clone&r of you will appear. If something touches it, they'll be Stunned for a few Seconds same with any other Mobs or Players nearby. 

3. &bSurface Tear&r: 
With this you can Walk on Air like Scaffolding. Jump to go up, Shift to go down. If you Stand still for a few Seconds though the Ability will go away and you'll come crashing down! 

- A &6Relic&r that shifts Reality to your liking.
quest.11A6D020D6F411A8.title: &2Glitchy Mantle
quest.11E957CDEFA0CAAB.quest_desc:
Welcome to &5&lThe Beyond&r! 

There's nothing here! 

You might want an Angel Block.
quest.11E957CDEFA0CAAB.title: &5&lThe Beyond
quest.11F6669733F1420B.title: Tier III: The Master's Orb
quest.12256A90B1CE3F90.quest_desc:
While yes you can use Quarries or Void Miners to get the Ores but if you really want the best way of automating &bArcane Crystals&r then you'll need &6&lBees&r! 
&bDiamond Bees&r to be more exact. Simply feed a &bDiamond Bee&r a &bBlock of Arcane Crystals&r and they will become an &bArcanus Bee&r! 

&bArcanus Bees&r need &bBlocks of Arcane Crystals&r as Flowering Blocks as well, then they will make &bArcanus Comb&r! Which can be made into &bArcane Crystals&r.
quest.122FBF5110E4CFF2.quest_desc: The Iron Downgrade will downgrade the Drawer's max space to a stack. This can be usefull for keeping items on stock, but not too many.
quest.127D085D6C9DB690.title: &eSaltpeter Powder
quest.129E09C03E40BA57.quest_desc: The Reactor takes Awakened Draconium as Fuel, don't worry its efficient! Fuel Conversion determines when the Awakened Draconium will change to Chaos. It can take only 8 Blocks at a time and can only be Fueled or Refueled when the Reactor is shut off. SAS mode helps to make that easier! Also Fuel goes into the bottom right Slots.
quest.12BDE512C734D19A.quest_desc: Draconium Cores are a vital Ingredient in many recipes in Draconic Evolution. Especially for Basic Tier items.
quest.12BDE512C734D19A.title: Basic (Draconium) Core
quest.131164DA08BB87B3.quest_desc:
Hippogryphs can be Tamed! 

Just from a distance with Rabbit Feet. Toss some Rabbit Feet near them and they will Eat it. 

They are like most Tame by Food Mobs, who knows how many they need! They might only want 1 Rabbit Foot while another might need an entire Stack of Rabbits Feet! 

Once they lay down, that is how you know they are Tamed. Then, you can Shift Right Click it to open its Inventory. Now we can give it Saddles to Ride it, Chests to Store Items, and even Armor! 

When Flying you can use Space Bar to Fly up, this needs time to accelerate. WASD to move forward, back, left, or right. And (X) to go down. 

We can even use (G) to Attack Mobs like with a &eDeath Worm&r!
quest.132DF9ECEFFB3B71.quest_desc: The &3Module Expansion Card&r makes the Charging Module even better.
quest.1366B946928C873B.quest_desc: Checkout the &6&lBumblezone&r Quest Page to learn more!
quest.13B338F377951032.title: &bSonorous Staff
quest.13D5F689E6884281.quest_desc:
&eKobolediators&r are one of the two mini-bosses within the &eCursed Pyramid&r. 

They will remain dormant until a Player (in Survival, took me awhile to figure that out) walks near them and they will wake up. 

They have 540 &4Hearts&r and will inflict Mining Fatigue on you. 

They will swing their Sword at you if you get too close! If you gain some distance from them, they will charge at you as if you were holding a Football and running for the endzone! 

On death they will drop Koboleton Bones, Ancient Metal Ingots, and their Skull!
quest.1404BB8956D5F8C7.quest_subtitle: The least big one of the big ones
quest.1409C17773B6A131.quest_desc: \\nAll Upgrades increase the amount the &e&lPipez&r move and also grant more options to use with the &e&lPipe&r. \\n\\nBasic Upgrade allows Redstone Activation with &e&lPipez&r, to change distribution either:Closest First, Farthest First, Round-Robin, or Random, and to add Filters.\\n\\nImproved, Advanced, and Ultimate upgrades don't grant anything new they just move more!
quest.1427B3AB09510D20.quest_desc: Craft together your Unassmbled PCB with 2 Capacitors and 2 Transistors to get yourself a &3Finished PCB&r.
quest.142C67218BD16867.quest_desc: Load up your Minigun with this &3Minigun Ammo&r to use it.
quest.144BB025516E0994.title: &3Vibranium Ingot&r
quest.144ECED643031A9A.quest_desc:
Glowing Mushrooms are huge Mushroom plants you can find in the Scarlet Forests! 

They function just like Brown or Red Mushrooms just these ones Glow much brighter! 

(If you didn't know Brown and Red Mushrooms actually emit a Light Source level of 1).
quest.149C260C10B34BB0.title: Left &6&lATM Star&r part
quest.14B3542ECB59869C.quest_desc:
The &5Loot Fabricator&r is the machine that gets you that sweet, sweet loot from Mob Predictions.

When given power and a successful Mob Prediction, you will be able to choose which item you'd like to get from that mob's Data Model. The machine will remember your choice, so it can be automated.

Examples of Mob Predictions:

- &dEnder Dragons&r for &dDragon Eggs
 - &2Zombies&r for Iron
 - &0Withers&r for &5Nether Stars
quest.14B3542ECB59869C.title: Creating &dLoot
quest.14B7EEBE0F6C2776.quest_desc:
&dInfused Dragon's Breath&r is obtained by... well Infusing &dDragon's Breath&r. 

You can use 2 &9Soul-Touched Sculkshelves&r, 3 &bHeart-Forged Seashelves&r, 8 Normal Bookshelves, and 1 &6Geode-Encased Bookshelf of Stability&r. 

It'll also be needed for other recipes but we don't talk about that!
quest.14C27D44D3C8EDF5.quest_desc:
1. You'll most likely just loot &dEnd Cities&r for it. 

2. To automate it you'll need to get all the items. 

Bonemeal, &7Gunpowder&r, &4Redstone&r, &cBlaze Powder&r, and Phantom Membrane can all be automated with &b&lHNN&r or &2&lMA&r. 

&bArcane Crystals&r will need either &6&lBees&r or &2&lMA&r for it then smelt it into &bDust&r.
quest.15007DCAF701B361.quest_desc: Charges other pressurizable items in your inventory from the chestplate's storage.
quest.15195F456D8AD4C8.quest_desc: When Ether touches &9Water&r, &aThioquartz&r will form. This can happen naturally with random generation or you can make it happen! \n\nThese aren't how we get Shards though, those are from &aBudding Thioquartz&r!
quest.15195F456D8AD4C8.title: &aThioquartz
quest.1533D98B3B2A758E.quest_desc: &7Shattered Swords&r can either be dropped from &7Lonestar Skeletons&r or crafted using the dropped &7Blades&r. \n\nThe &7Shattered Sword&r is used more like a Trident than a Sword, instead of hitting you'll throw it. Then, you can Right Click to bring back the &7Blade&r like a Loyalty Trident, and Right Click again to reload it if needed.
quest.1533D98B3B2A758E.title: &7Shattered Sword
quest.15540271BF17C2E4.quest_desc:
&lWelcome to XyCraft!&r

This series of mods is mostly dedicated to XyCraft: World and Machines!
World gives us the Gems which can be found while mining.
quest.15540271BF17C2E4.title: &lXyCraft
quest.15564C11744D6AA0.quest_desc: Once you have obtained a full set of the required &eInscriber Presses&r, it's time to start making some &eProcessors&f. These are an important crafting ingredient used to make the large majority of ME-connected devices.
quest.15849165CA8C00F9.title: &l&9Tier 5 &6Forge
quest.158F872A3A2C3650.quest_desc:
Now that we have our max &aEterna&r of &a80&r, we can start &d&lInfusing&r &dDragon's Breath&r! 

&dDragon's Breath&r can be obtained when fighting the &d&lEnder Dragon&r. When she is perched above her nest she might shoot a &dPink&r mist at you. When in it, you can Right Click with an Empty Bottle, to obtain &dDragon's Breath&r! 

The best way to get our Levels is with 4 &9Echoing Sculkshelves&r, 4 &9Soul-Touched Sculkshelves&r, and 6 &6Geode-Encased Bookshelves of Stability&r. 

These will give us &a80 Eterna&r, &c25% Quanta&r and &5100% Arcana&r. Perfect for &d&lInfusion&r!
quest.15978093237448FE.quest_desc: Why upgrade &cNetherite&r to &6Allthemodium&r or even anything else when we can upgrade it to &3Warden Armor&r! \n\nYou'll need a few Warden Drops in order to make it though!
quest.15C9CCCC8E06D430.quest_subtitle: Feed a Black Quartz Block to a Crystalline Bee
quest.15D355EB164EBE68.title: Capacitors
quest.15FEA03A2CDBA33B.quest_desc:
&b&lThe Other&r has seen dozens of changes over the years but always it has been a realm for adventures! 

There's dozens of new biomes, blocks, and of course structures! 

The Structures are: Piglin Village, Ancient Pyramid, and Dungeon, plus some structures from When Dungeons Arise and &b&lIce &fand &cFire&r. All containing amazing loot with some things being unique to their structure! 

You can also mine for &3Vibranium&r (and other ores!) or find it and better in the structures! 

You can't set up Quarries for many blocks in &b&lThe Other&r though, no cheesing anything here.
quest.1617C1935F22FBD1.quest_desc:
Now that you have maximized your max &aEterna&r at &a100&r, you can start &d&lInfusing&r &6Godforged Pearls&r!

&6Godforged Pearls&r can be obtained by salvaging &6Mythic&r &eItems&r in a &c&lSalvaging Table&r.

You'll need &a100 Eterna&r, &c9.65-11.00% Quanta&r, and &558.75-60.0% Arcana&r.

You can get this with 1 &dDraconic Endshelf&r, 6 &6Geode-Encased Bookshelves of Stability&r, 1 &9Echoing Sculkshelf&r, 5 &9Soul-Touched Sculkshelves&r, 1 &7Stoneshelf&r, and 1 Candle.
quest.1617C1935F22FBD1.quest_subtitle: We're infusing ANYTHING at this rate
quest.1617C1935F22FBD1.title: &6God-Fused Pearl
quest.16299B9AE87257DC.quest_desc:
The &bWireless Terminal&f functions identically to a regular terminal, but wirelessly.

Before it can be used to access a network, it must first be &elinked&f to the network by placing it into the top-right slot of the &eWireless Access Point&r. If it is not linked to a network, or is out of either range or power, the terminal will not function.

Wireless terminals can also be upgraded with &eEnergy Cards&f to provide a larger internal battery.
quest.16299B9AE87257DC.quest_subtitle: This is what you're here for
quest.162D2286A69D6E07.title: &6Allthemodium Arcanist Armor
quest.167E1474644C9908.quest_desc: The Quartz makes whatever the other item does, it does the opposite for the Spawner. With Quartz in your offhand and the other Spawner Modification item in your main it will do the opposite of its role. With Quartz and Runes of Spawning Range instead of increasing Spawn Range it will decrease it. With Quartz and Runes of Debilitation it'll increase Starting Health.
quest.1682CED78D9D4BA7.quest_desc:
&9&lTwilight Forest&r is one of the most well known and recognized Mods, and for good reason. It has practically defined Adventure Mods! 

To get there simply have a 2x2 pool of Water, surround it with Flowers, and drop a Diamond into it! 

Then, your Portal shall open up, and you can enter the &l&9Twilight Forest&r. 

Here you'll need to follow a strict order of Bosses to kill and progress!
quest.1695917695648018.title: &3Abandoned Temple
quest.16B88F46021E956D.quest_desc:
&l&6Theurgy&r has Machines so of course it needs Logistics!

(Check out the Basic Logistics Page to learn more about logistics).

With &cMercury&r you can move Items and Fluids from place to place using &cMercury Wires&r and other Items! Wires are what will actually move the Items.
quest.16B88F46021E956D.title: Logistics with &cMercury&r
quest.16D0F1E3CEB60ABF.title: Iron Fishing Rod
quest.1705175C20CE91DD.quest_desc: Eclipse Alloy is a new material added by JDT. Eclipse Alloy is acquired by performing Goo Spread on Netherite Blocks using tier four goo.
quest.173541B0765DA13E.quest_desc:
This one I'd argue is the easiest to automate. 

Phantom Membranes, Feathers, and Wool can be automated via &b&lHNN&r. 

Only the &7Bat Wing&r is more difficult needing to be farmed via spawners!
quest.17410BE15A81DD96.quest_desc:
The &9Wayfarer's Spawner Upgrade Rune&r is the 2nd tier of Spawner Upgrade Runes.

This one sets Minimum Spawn Delay to 100, Maximum Spawn Delay to 400, Spawn Count to 10, Max Entities to 18, and Activation Range to 32.

Any Spawn Egg works for crafting this Rune.
quest.17598C171E610752.quest_desc:
I don't even know what to say for this. I'm getting lost looking through the recipes. I'd rather list out all the Family Trees for &l&2Productive Trees&r. 

Get &6Advanced Motors&r and combine them with &dTitanium Rods&r and a &9Processing Unit&r to make the &6Large Advanced Motor&r. 
Or you can use a &6Mechanical Arm&r, but I can't promise you that those are easier to Craft!
quest.17598C171E610752.title: &6Large Advanced Motor
quest.176ACC61DC206E55.quest_desc: You can find these bees at Crimson Forests. Its nest can also be obtained from growing Crimson Fungi, at a 2% chance.
quest.176ACC61DC206E55.title: Crimson Shroombee
quest.177396B9C4F9B3E2.quest_desc: Why wait? Oh you have valid reasons for waiting? Like items that might despawn. Huh wasn't thinking about those. \n\nWith Pickup Delay Augment the Vacuum Module will wait 10 ticks with every Augment in it to pick up dropped items!
quest.17A8E4151DE37015.quest_desc: In order to make the &cStarfire&r Tools and Weapons you'll first need &6Thermal Springstone&r Tools to upgrade. Then, the &cUpgrade Template&r. \n\nThe &cStarfire Upgrade Template&r is found in the Boss Structures: &9Cursed Garden&r and &bGolem Forge&r.
quest.17A8E4151DE37015.title: &cStarfire Template
quest.17C87EB8ED8A27AB.quest_desc: Spawner Runes are the base material for modifying Spawners.
quest.17D82EEA20D02EC8.title: &5Dusted Gravel
quest.18246A48C20B29D8.quest_desc: The Infusion Pylon works similar as a Beacon just much better and cheaper! \nWhen a Potion Effect is put in by a Potion Filter, it will continuously give you the Potion Effect while you're in the set Chunk area.
quest.1843C79133DFB024.quest_desc: The most powerful and efficient Generator, the Netherstar Generator. Take a guess what it uses to make Energy!
quest.185074907753AE77.quest_desc:
If you are using Routers I hope you have some game knowledge. 

Just incase, to void an Item means to delete it. 

Any items that come into the Router, will be deleted forever! 

Recommend using Filters with this one...
quest.185DBBDD252CBA0C.title: &l&cTier 1 &6Forge
quest.186731580B14F9D2.quest_desc:
To interact with our Turbine, we'll need several &6Ports&r.

The &9Fluid Port&r is used to insert vapors like &bSteam&r, or extract exhaust, like &9water&r. Because of this, you'll need two for your Turbine.

The &cPower Tap&r extracts power, and is required to complete the multiblock.
quest.187816477B732517.quest_desc: The &3Transfer Gadget&r acts like a Hopper that can be placed inbetween blocks.
quest.189018F641FBB44E.quest_desc: The &4Mega Autocrafter&r has 54 Pattern slots, works 8x faster, and has a &eStack Upgrade&r integrated.
quest.189018F641FBB44E.title: &4Mega Autocrafter
quest.18914FDF9CF9EEA8.title: &aClockwork Bearing
quest.18AA0B2E9C3B912A.quest_desc: It's a &9Snail&r. \n\nIt will Drop its Shell and Meat.
quest.18AA0B2E9C3B912A.title: &9Shadow Snail
quest.18AA64DF63F68762.quest_desc: This should be the last gate in this chapter
quest.18AA64DF63F68762.title: Another Gate
quest.18DB8C875F2331B2.quest_subtitle: Not all relics are meant to keep you grounded...
quest.18E0F5A78F696FA3.quest_desc: Runes of Echoes give a special effect to the spawner. Any mobs spawned will have the loot that they drop multiplied.
quest.18FAD56CDE05646A.quest_desc:
Before Quarries in the &7&lMining Dimension&r used to mine everything but leave &6Allthemodium Ore&r. 

Now it will Mine &6Allthemodium&r but Void the drops... might want to be careful with your Quarries now! 

I recommend Mining with Ore Sight Potions if you are looking strictly for &6Allthemodium&r!
quest.1972B36F72808D55.title: &l&bChipped&r Stones
quest.19862DBCE9305DE3.quest_desc:
The &3Spear&r, the &7Denizen's&r weapon of choice... along with the Wooden Axe. 

You'll need 2 Sticks and &3Rogdorium&r to Craft it. 

It has the same Damage as a &bDiamond Sword&r, plus longer Reach! 

It can also be thrown like a Trident.
quest.19862DBCE9305DE3.title: &3Spear
quest.19891A8F26FBAB0A.title: A Belt Full of Sigils
quest.198E9E90CC9606C4.quest_desc:
We got our Items on Pedestals, we got our &bAureal&r, Souls, &4Blood&r, and &aExperience&r... and it isn't finishing? Why isn't it finishing? 

In order to actually finalize the Ritual we'll need to use a Gavel! 

It works like a Pickaxe but it also has a limited amount of uses for finishing Rituals, just Right Click the &6&lForge&r with it!
quest.19A2016B54C6FA34.quest_desc: Some Machines in &l&6Theurgy&r need Heat to get started! Except &l&6Theurgy&r is very jealous with how their Machines get Heat, you can only use these two Machines as Heat sources. \n\n(The Machines that use Heat are: Liquefaction Cauldron, Calcination Oven, &cMercury&r Distiller, and Incubator.)
quest.19B8871B701F11F4.title: &dStarlit Diamond Pickaxe
quest.19E356E67EF17E4A.quest_desc: Only the greatest Tool in history! Like a swiss army knife but better! \n\nHighest Mining Tier, chops down Trees like butter, makes pathways, and of course hits a lot to be hit by!
quest.19E356E67EF17E4A.title: &6Allthemodium &5Alloy &3Paxel
quest.19F7BAD1150A2107.quest_desc: &cStarfire&r! \n\nNo, not like from Teen Titans or Teen Titans Go. This one is a material which can be used to make Tools and Weapons or...
quest.19F7BAD1150A2107.title: &cStarfire
quest.1A05C605A52A4218.title: &5Unobtainium&r - &6Allthemodium&r Alloy Ingot
quest.1A23BBF444D17A63.title: &2Greater Dweller
quest.1A806C1A54B26EB5.quest_desc: You don't want everything to do their actions at a larger range? You want your Vacuum to leave some room for dropping items in your World? Then I guess you can range down.
quest.1A95BFE57029F9C4.quest_desc:
Upset we didn't get the Tuff Golem? Well don't you fret, we have the &7Grimstone Golem&r! 

He does the same exact thing, just stands there and holds a Block or Item. 

Just place a &5Lunaris Cactus Fruit&r over &7Grimstone Bricks&r and you'll get it.
quest.1A95BFE57029F9C4.title: &7Grimstone Golem
quest.1A96C595CBA42840.quest_desc: Kivi Seeds can be used to grow Kivi Essence which can be crafted in Kivi!
quest.1A96C595CBA42840.title: Kivi Automation
quest.1AA81C41431FD145.quest_desc:
Pull..! Pull..! Pull..! 

The Puller is the opposite of the Sender, it pulls items from Inventories into the Router's Buffer. 

The Inventory has to be adjacent to the Router.
quest.1AAF0B31B47AF23D.quest_desc: Individual ME devices can also be configured to respond to redstone signals. When upgraded with a &bRedstone Card&f, a device can be configured to do work only when powered with redstone or otherwise as needed.\n\nThis behavior can also apply to entire &osections&r of an ME network by using an &bME Toggle Bus&f. This allows a section of the network on the other side of the bus to come online only when the bus is powered by redstone, or to go offline if using an &einverted&f toggle bus.
quest.1AAFC306507DFCF8.title: &bGlacite Scythe
quest.1ACB3EDBCB732514.quest_subtitle: Feed a Block of Monazite to a Sulfur Bee
quest.1AFCA421A6A50DA4.quest_desc: &aFlowglaze Upgrade Template&r also Spawns in Boss Structures: &9Cursed Garden&r and &bGolem Forge&r. \n\nYou'll need to apply the &aFlowglaze&f and &aUpgrade Template&f to &bGlacite &fto make &aFlowglaze Weapons&r.
quest.1AFCA421A6A50DA4.title: &aFlowglaze Template
quest.1B4CD5AC8F6C3307.quest_desc: The &#4497DBOverdrive module&r preserves the efficiency of the machine even when the recipe is not currently running. In return, it locks the machine to its current recipe and makes it always use power.
quest.1B4ED65C614B102F.quest_desc:
The &bIgnited Revenant&r stands in our way to kill the &b&lIgnis&r. 

The &bRevenant&r looks and acts like a Blaze, but instead of being Rods, he has Shields! 

These Shields make him invulnerable to all attacks, you'll need to wait for him to lift them, to attack him! 

He has 640 &4Hearts&r and has 2 attacks: one where he lifts in the air and throws Blaze Rods all around him, and the other where he spins his Shields around as if he was doing Spinjitzu. 

On death he will drop the &bBurning Ashes&r.
quest.1B6642BBDAEB2BD5.quest_desc: We can only forge the &cVeneficus Orb of Vitae&r once the altar sits at Tier II, and it's worth the wait: it swaps the Discipulus's tight reserve for &e150,000 EV&r of breathing room — six times what we had.
quest.1B6642BBDAEB2BD5.title: Tier II: The Magician's Orb
quest.1B7A15730657ED30.title: &eDesert Site
quest.1B7B377CB757867E.quest_desc: All &dGravitite Tools&r can be Right Clicked on their specific Blocks they break to blast them off into the Sky! \n\nThey're also the best Tools &l&eThe Aether&r has to offer.
quest.1B7B377CB757867E.title: &dGravitite&r Tools
quest.1BBABB2106D321A4.title: Early Blood Automation
quest.1C2309DB4B890E71.quest_desc:
&bSpouts&r are used with systems to fill &eItems&r with &bFluid&r. 

First, you'll need to fill the &bSpout&r by &bPiping Fluid&r into it! 

Then, if there is a &bFluid&r Holding &eItem&r: Bucket or Bottle, then it will be filled with the &bFluid&r in the Spout. 

It will automatically fill it, it doesn't need Rotational Power it uses Gravity!
quest.1C273D9E046FD18A.quest_desc: Used to energize items using the Energizing Orb.
quest.1C27C74722A19FC1.quest_desc:
With a ton of super expensive &l&5Mekanism&r Items you can upgrade &5Unobtainium Armor&r to the &aMekaSuit&r! 

Now it can hold Energy and instead of taking hearts from damage, it will take Energy. 

You can use Upgrade Units to make it even better!
quest.1C27C74722A19FC1.title: &aMekaSuit
quest.1C829609915E0012.title: Making Power with &cMercury
quest.1C863B4BC6EAD1CD.title: &9Malarite Sickle
quest.1CD05CB4A3DB112A.quest_desc:
The &c&lSalvaging Table&r can finally get you Materials and &9Gem Dust&r without using &7Anvils&r. 

You can recycle &eTools &fand &eArmor &fwith &eAffixes&r to get their Materials. 

The Materials you get are based on the Rarity of Item, &8Common&r Items will give &8Common&r Materials. 

And break down Horse/Dog Armor for some reason.
quest.1CE7B24E7E62C25B.quest_subtitle: &oThe unknown but yet it is everything we do know.
quest.1CF8263756EE8F2A.title: &5Cognizant Dust&r
quest.1D1FAA2F86695781.quest_desc:
For &l&2Frontier&r the Rarity of &eAffixes&r didn't matter, but now for &l&eAscent&r you'll need everything being &aUncommon&r or better. 

You'll also need to kill an &4Invader&r aka an &6&lApothic&r Boss, to upgrade your &lWorld Tier&r. The Rarity of &4Boss&r doesn't matter! 

&eAffixes&r will only stay up to &5Epic&r but now &9Rare&r is more common than the rest. We can also get &6Mythic&r &aGems&r... just only with Lady Luck's Favor! 

Speaking of Luck, our Luck will increase to 30%, Experience will jump to 55%, and &aMax Eterna&r will rise to &a60&r. 

&4Monsters&r in return will now have 8 Armor Points and 5 Armor Pierce.
quest.1D2C70F1750E84D0.title: &cRotbelcher
quest.1D39634260A47C9A.quest_desc: If you use &2Infused Iron Ingots&r or &6Tainted Gold Ingots&r on the Offering Table you will get &bIngots of the Skies&r.
quest.1D87415343E65AA7.quest_desc:
The &5Creative &8Compressor&r allows you to choose any Bar Pressure you want! Positive, Negative, even 0! It can be used within Machines. 

You'll need 4 stacks of Advanced Pressure Tubes, Advanced Liquid Compressor, Advanced Air Compressor, Electrostatic Compressor, and a Flux Compressor. 

I don't know what's harder getting the &6&lStar&r or remembering all the Items you need to make this!
quest.1D995548A159F291.quest_subtitle: Feed a Soulium Dagger to a Ghostly Bee
quest.1E1EB7DC19DDCFB7.quest_desc:
To create Netherite tools and armor you'll need to find the &6Netherite Smithing Template&r in chests found inside of Bastions.

These can be combined with a &cNetherite&r ingot and a Diamond tool or armor piece in a &aSmithing Table&r to upgrade it to &cNetherite&r.

Tip: Don't use all of your templates in one go! You can create duplicates by using the recipe to create another.
quest.1E2A9446594638E2.quest_desc:
Hidden within the strange lands of the &6End&r, a &6relic&r bends space itself... the &5Chorus Staff&r. 

 Forged from the mysterious &5chorus plants&r, this staff holds the &5unstable power&r of &2teleportation&r, allowing its wielder to slip through space in the blink of an &leye&r. 

- &lIt has 1 ability:&r 

 &dTeleportation&r: 
 Using the staff &9instantly teleports&r you forward a &a&oshort distance&r. This ability &econsumes charges&r from an internal buffer, which &e&oslowly&r regenerates over time. 

- A &6relic&r of movement... where every step is a &9disappearance&r.
quest.1E2A9446594638E2.title: &dChorus Staff&r
quest.1E2B363E3365A62F.quest_desc: Allthemodium Seeds require Magical Soil placed below in order for them to grow.
quest.1E3471513C75CC54.quest_desc:
If you place a Bucket of Blood on the ground long enough or place it in a Drying Basin, it will dry into &cHardened Blood&r.

Aside from being incredibly unsanitary, we need all kinds of blood for us to progress. Even dried blood.

This will turn back into blood in the rain, or by breaking it with regular tools. If you break it with &9Flint and Steel&r, you'll get &dBlood Shards&r instead.
quest.1E535784A9D3DE89.quest_desc: These are things from ExtendedAE that don't require Entro Crystals.
quest.1E7B5CDF0D5F833F.title: &7Deepsilver Pickaxe
quest.1EA98CFE85035939.title: &5Aethersent Bottoms
quest.1EB04FE105ACA4BE.quest_desc:
When a &9Warden&r dies it has a chance to drop a &9Heart of the Deep&r. 

This can be used for the &6&lATM Star&r, or to activate the Portal in the Ancient City! 

There can't be anything in the Portal to activate it, that includes &9Sculk&r!
quest.1EB887F8072439A3.quest_desc: After using either &9Fatma's Incentivized Attraction&r to summon a &9Marid Crusher&r or &aOphyx' Calling&r to summon a &aDjinni Crusher&r, you can turn Ice, Packed Ice, and Blue Ice into their crushed forms, and use these to create Light Blue Chalk.
quest.1EBD5E4410A6DF34.quest_subtitle: Feed a Ghostly Bee a Soulium Dagger
quest.1ECAEC7BE573BB9C.quest_desc:
The &5&lAltar&r is a very useful Block. 

It can &5Enchant&r Items and Repair &e&lAether&r or &2&lVanilla&r Tools. 

When it says Enchant it doesn't mean the &2&lVanilla&r Enchantments with Books. It just transforms certain &e&lAether&r Items! 

The fuel for the &5&lAltar&r is &eAmbrosium&r.
quest.1ECAEC7BE573BB9C.title: &5&lAltar
quest.1ECD4331DDFBBB52.title: &cTorreya Trees
quest.1EECA19DF9CF6A0C.quest_desc:
Flux Dust can also be automated using &6XyCraft&r!

Place a charged redstone crystal block on bedrock, surround the crystal block with 4 obsidian on all sides and place the extractor on top.
Then just place a storage on top of the extractor and you're done!
quest.1F446EF3AD20DC6B.quest_desc:
This &5Hammer&r is both a ranged and Melee Weapon. 

You can bash Mobs like normal, or Right Click to Shoot Projectiles. 

The Projectiles will toss back Mobs like Breezeballs and will do Damage.
quest.1F446EF3AD20DC6B.title: &5Hammer of Kingbdogz
quest.1F6C8117F3CED939.title: &6Allthemodium Bow
quest.1F748ACA3976A92F.quest_desc: This gate only exists to allow for either the Seashelf or Hellshelf path to be taken while also forcing the Frontier World Tier quest from Apotheosis Gear.
quest.1F748ACA3976A92F.title: A Gate
quest.1F7ACF813D8804A6.title: Circle of Intent
quest.1F7DFA5AA65F2812.quest_desc: The &bAcceleration Card&f, depending on the device being upgraded with it, will either increase the speed at which the device operates or allow the device to carry out more operations in one go.\n\nIn the case of the &eMolecular Assembler&f, a full set of 5 cards reduces the time taken for the MA to fulfil a craft from one second (with no cards) to one &otick&r.
quest.1FC1588A131B6A4A.quest_desc: Just like making the &6&lATM Star&r normally, automating it needs to be within the &6&lRunic Star Altar&r! \n\nCheck out the Quest in Chapter 3 to learn how to build and use it.
quest.1FCC474860587169.quest_desc:
To get later recipes you'll most likely need a &6Smelter Prism&r and don't worry we only need a Tier 1 Forge to get it! 

You can check how much of each Stat in the Forge you need in JEI! Plus you'll need 4 &6Blaze Powder&r, 2 &8Coal&r, and an &bArcane Crystal&r. 

Lastly, you'll need &9Elementarium&r which can be found in Jungle Temples, Desert Pyramids, and Underwater Ruins!
quest.1FCC474860587169.title: &6Smelter Prism
quest.1FE17B1C7C639F88.quest_desc:
The Storage Controller allows you to work with multiple storages as if they were one big storage multiblock.

This allows for a very large storage network, which can be combined with mods like Applied Energistics or Integrated Dynamics, as the Storage Controller acts as an in/out point for all storages attached to it.

Connecting either can be done by simply putting storages next to Storage Controller or next to others that are already connected to Storage Controller (this works up to 14 blocks away from controller in all directions).
quest.1FE47F03B5DF492D.title: &5Unobtainium Arcanist Armor
quest.2002AB7D061007FA.quest_desc:
The &6Artisan Relic&r is found within a few Buildings in Villages. 

When used in the &l&bClibano&r it will allow you to make &5Obsidiansteel&r. 

When used in &6&lForges&r it will give you a discount on &aExperience&r used!
quest.201EE3566D4D3123.title: &6Allthemodium Ingot
quest.203C91B992BA8CF9.quest_desc:
In order to remake the &6&lATM Star&r we'll need an Infused &dPatrick &aStar&r, which also needs a &dPatrick &aStar&r for it. Both are made via &6&lRunic Star Altar&r. 

The other items needed to make Infused &dPatrick &aStar&r are the 4 &5Mending Books&r and &dInfused Dragon's Breath&r which are obtained through &5&lRunic Enchanting&r. 

&6Star Shards&r which we get from our Bees! 

And Alloy Ingots: &3Vibranium&f-&6Allthemodium&r, &5Unobtainium&f-&6Allthemodium&r, and &5Unobtainium&f-&3Vibranium&r Ingots. 

All three are crafted in their own unique ways described in the &6&lAllthemodium&r chapter! 

Throw all of these into a &6&lRunic Star Altar&r, plus 85MFE, and we'll get our Infused &dPatrick &aStar&r!
quest.20C2A09007E1309A.quest_desc: &dGravitite Ore&r doesn't get Smelted, instead it gets &5Enchanted&r with the &5&lAltar&r. \n\nOnce &5Enchanted&r we can make Tools and Armor with it. Plus a Jukebox!
quest.20C2A09007E1309A.title: &dGravitite
quest.20D705C99BD11F18.title: &cStarfire Axe
quest.20D8DA523E900A52.title: Wireless Energy Link
quest.20D957B3C350CDE2.quest_desc:
&dGravitite Armor&r has 20 Armor Points and 8 Armor Toughness. 

When wearing all 5 Pieces (yes, the &dGloves&r count too) you won't jump into the air, you'll leap! 

It will also prevent Fall Damage too!
quest.20D957B3C350CDE2.title: &dGravitite&r Armor
quest.21398F45428CD1D1.quest_desc:
&6Bloom Berries&r grow from &bGlowing Vines&r on the roof of the &bBlooming Caverns&r. 

Within the &bGlowing Vines&r, &6Bloom Berries&r might spawn and will wait for you to pick them off the &bVine&r with Right Click! 

This is the only Food Source in the &3&lOtherside&r.
quest.21398F45428CD1D1.title: &6Bloom Berries
quest.2156C00E30424844.quest_desc:
&4Tanks&r are made for adding Liquids into our &c&lFoundry&r. 

Mostly Fuel. 

Mostly &cLava&r! 

That appears to be one of the only ways to actually Fuel the &c&lFoundry&r.
quest.215AD616E6847E9A.quest_desc: Each &5Insanium Gemstone&r is 2 &5Insanium Essence&r. So each &5Gemstone Block&r is 18 &5Insanium Essence&r. \n\nThat means we can take our 9,216 &aInferium Essence&r for the &5Insanium Blocks&r and double it to get 18,432 &aInferium Essence&r for just the 4 &5Insanium Gemstone Blocks&r.
quest.215AD616E6847E9A.title: 4 &5Insanium Gemstone Blocks
quest.21693C4DE6531D73.title: Crusher
quest.216DA9782EBDFF34.quest_desc: I think this Mod is unrealistic. I don't care what Books or Items you have, I don't think the Demonic will follow your every command and work as a slave for you. \n\nRegardless you can follow the Quests to do so.
quest.2171DC0B13C4BD43.quest_desc:
&a&lRoots Classic&r may look small in JEI but I can promise you there's so much to it! 

Roots is all about using nature's gifts to make rituals.

Trust me you'll find these items everywhere!
quest.2171DC0B13C4BD43.title: &a&lRoots Classic
quest.2182492BCC1B33D8.quest_desc:
When installed in a Hive, it gives a 5% chance for a new baby Bee to be spawned every time honey is delivered.

When placed in a Catcher, it only allows the catcher to catch baby Bees.

You can stack these for a greater chance.
quest.2188C52C1F384DE4.title: &c&lPhilosopher's Fuel
quest.21AB14A8553896E9.quest_desc:
Guys I think you didn't hear me right I said &e&lProductive Bees&r! Oh wait there's another Mod! 

This one is related to &e&lProductive Bees&r as you'll need them for breeding Trees. 

No, Trees do not use Wheat to breed, they use Bees. 

&oThe Trees and the Bees&r.
quest.21AB14A8553896E9.title: &2&lProductive Trees
quest.21B96130EA516B82.quest_desc: "I am Compressed Iron Man!" \n\nIt can be used and upgraded with compressed Air!
quest.21BEE9867796933A.quest_desc:
Carried for generations by &6nomads&r and &6messengers&r, the &5Rider Flute&r produces a sound familiar to any &9riding animal&r. A single note can &ccall&r a mount to your side, while another signals it to &cpause&r patiently until needed. 

 Its mysterious power allows the wearer to &5store&r up to &c2 mounts&r inside the flute, ready to be &creleased&r or &6recalled&r at will. Switch between stored mounts by &csneaking&r and scrolling the mouse wheel. To completely release a mount, simply &csneak&r and right-click, giving the rider total control over their &9companions&r. 

- &lIt has 1 ability: 

 &6Stable&r: 
 Right-click a tamed &9riding animal&r to place it inside the &6Rider Flute&r, and right-click again to &crelease&r or &6recall&r it. Store up to &c2&r mounts and switch between them while &csneaking&r. To fully release a mount, &csneak&r and right-click. 

- A &6relic&r for those who guide their &6mounts&r with a &6song&r… and never leave a friend behind.
quest.21BEE9867796933A.title: &cRider Flute&r
quest.21BFDE6AD1C0F62A.quest_desc: Obviously in real life there is much more than just &6Honey Bees&r or &6Bumble Bees&r, so the &6&lBumblezone&r adds more &8B&6e&8e&6s&r and unique &8B&6e&8e&6s&r! \n\nFrom &4&lRedtail&r &8B&6e&8e&6s&r, to &9Blue&r &8B&6e&8e&6s&r, to Neopolitan &8B&6e&8e&6s&r!
quest.21F3379C904BFD50.quest_desc:
The &6Resistive Heater&r will also generate &6Heat&r, but instead of using Furnace Fuel, it will use &aEnergy&r! 

By feeding it &aEnergy&r, we can choose however much &6Heat&r it will make. 

The more &6Heat&r it makes, the more &aEnergy&r it takes! 

The max &6Heat&r is 9,999,999 something.
quest.21F3379C904BFD50.title: &6Resistive Heater
quest.22171982D22CE15F.quest_desc:
Instead of each &a&lMekaSuit Part&r having their own individual Charge, they will now share one Charge. 

This is important in keeping every &a&lPart&r Charged. 

And that is important to keeping you alive!
quest.22171982D22CE15F.title: &aCharge Distribution &7Units
quest.2224AA108FC006F3.quest_desc: The Revolver Speedloader isn't actually an Upgrade, rather it is a seperate Item that's used to help. \n\nFill it with Cartridges like the &d&lRevolver&r, but now whenever you need to Reload the &d&lRevolver&r you can just Right Click with it to instantly reload!
quest.227E9783382527CA.quest_desc:
&cFree Runners&r are different from the other Armors, these will use &aEnergy&r instead of a &cChemical Fuel&r. 

When Powered and tied onto your Feet, you can press (B) they will start working and you can press it again to switch it's modes. 

&2Regular&r: the &cFree Runners&r will protect you from Fall Damage and Auto-Jump over Blocks for you. 

&6Safety&r: will prevent Fall Damage but won't Auto-Jump. (The preferred Method). 

&4Disabled&r: Free Runners won't protect or Auto-Jump, just look stylish! 

You can also Upgrade &cFree Runners&r to give them Armor Protection, just like the &cJetpack&r.
quest.2296CE4418AE62D4.quest_desc: &6Allthemodium Armor&r but with buffs to &d&lArs Nouveau&r Spells!
quest.2296CE4418AE62D4.title: &6Allthemodium Arcanist Gear
quest.22B8D57337944D9C.quest_desc: &#DF9DE0Titanium Hot Ingots&r can now be cooled down in the &#5CD1CFVacuum Freezer&r to get usable &#F069F0Titanium Ingots&r.
quest.22BB55249EF2E819.quest_desc: &l&6The Bumblezone&r is an Exploration Mod that adds a whole new dimension inside our &eBeehives&r. \n\nEver wonder what &6B&8e&6e&8s&r do in their &eHives&r? Well you can find out by adventuring into it!
quest.22BB55249EF2E819.title: &l&6The Bumblezone!
quest.22CB17C102BB6773.title: Refining the Tau
quest.22F5F931D38E5187.quest_desc: Crimson Stones are found within Pillager Outposts, they are a little rare but doesn't help they only give us 2 Chests! \n\nThey aren't used for new Recipes rather they will decrease Soul usage in the &6&lForge&r.
quest.22F80D267321BFC5.quest_desc: The &3Autocrafer Manager&r allows you to access all your &3Autocrafters&r from one block.\n\nHope you don't try to organise everything, for your sake.
quest.22F80D267321BFC5.title: &3Managing Autocrafters
quest.230EEE4671B46D0C.quest_desc:
&9Darkstone&r appears deep underground near Lava Lakes, like at Y Level -54. 

It is the most used Block for &6&lForbidden \& Arcanus&r, all Multiblocks will use them for their base. 
Make sure to grab a ton of them!
quest.23254CE8487D2E68.quest_desc:
The &8Wither Builder&r is one of the greatest Machines you can get from &lIndustrial Foregoing&r, and because of that it's expensive. 

First you will need the parts that make a &8Wither&r and a drop from the &8Wither&r. 

Then, you'll need a &6Supreme Machine Frame&r which you need &bEther Gas&r to make. Guess what you need for &bEther Gas&r? That's right! A &8Wither&r! You'll need a Laser Drill working on a &8Wither&r to get it. 

&8Withers&r like to leave and kill things so a Stasis Chamber would make milking them easier!
quest.23254CE8487D2E68.title: &8Wither Builder
quest.2329AA0AFBEF1E13.title: &l&ePipez
quest.2338E5269CA23C91.quest_desc: The &3Netherite Drill Bit&r is the best Drill Bit, it's even better than the Diamond Drill Bit.
quest.234DC1702333EB18.quest_subtitle: I'm not writing the Toy Story line
quest.235273F7C9A9B0D0.title: Bottom Right &6&lATM Star&r part
quest.23708582B1064C9D.quest_desc: A &#46DBBBCircuit&r will require some of these basic components to function, automating parts of these will be useful in the future.
quest.23737103592776C2.quest_desc: The &3Kerosene Lamp&r is a great light source that uses fuel (Kerosene being the best) to produce light.
quest.23AE395433AED3C0.quest_desc:
The &6&lATM Star&r needs a few Blocks to hold together the different Items, and make its star shape! 

The first Blocks are &5Unobtainium&r - &6Allthemodium&r &5Alloy&r &6Blocks&r. You need to use an Enchanting Apparatus from &d&lArs Nouveau&r to make them! To make 28 to be exact. 

For 17 X3 Netherstar Blocks you'll need 111,537 Netherstars. (Please I am begging you use &l&bHNN&r just don't spawn and kill 111,537, please!)
quest.23DE60E57136C207.quest_desc: The easiest infinite Energy storage, only needing 4 &3Energy Batteries&r (from &3&lID&r) and a &6&lStar&r! \n\nYou'll need to energize them all with... well as much Energy as &2&lMinecraft&r can handle... Quite literally the integer limit!
quest.23DE60E57136C207.title: &5&lCreative &3Energy Battery
quest.242C183437A4CCD4.title: &7Sentry Boots
quest.24934231538B6492.title: Ancient Pyramid
quest.24BA664B60E49461.quest_desc:
Only one of the most powerful Tools in all of Modded &2&lMinecraft&r! The &6Cardboard Box&r! 

These are made with very simple ingrediants, just 4 &6Sawdust&r. &6Sawdust&r is made from putting &7Sticks&r into a &e&lPrecision Sawmill&r. 

Now that we hopefully have one, just Right Click a Block with it and the Block will be placed into the &6Cardboard Box&r. Now we can break the &6Cardboard Box&r and move the Block by placing it again and Shift Right Clicking it to remove the Box. 

Some Blocks won't work like &8Bedrock&r or &dEnd Portal Frames&r... but there's so many more that will! Like &5Obsidian&f, &3Reinforced Deepslate&r, and Spawners!
quest.24C0619EB4A13CA3.title: Laying the Veins
quest.24E124F12CFF2A50.title: &l&7The Slider
quest.24F3E90C14BFD1B4.quest_desc:
&7&lModern Industrialization&r is a mod as big as its name! 

It has multiple tiers of machines and thankfully we don't need to go to the last one for the &6&lStar&r. 

Infact now, it is entirely optional! If you'd rather play with &6&lCreate&r to create (get it?) the &6&lATM Star&r you can!
quest.24FCFF18296ED907.title: &9Soul-Touched Sculkshelf
quest.252A24CED69C1882.quest_desc:
The Thermoelectric Generator, which I am going to just be calling a Thermo, is a unique Generator. 

On its own it won't do anything, what we'll need to do is place Blocks or Fluids of differenting Temperatures on different sides of the Thermo. 

The bigger the difference in Temperature the more Energy it creates!
quest.257893DD23BF5017.quest_desc:
