To get &3Rogdorium&r we'll need to visit the Depths beneath Y Level 0. For that you'll need a &aForgotten Pickaxe&r or &6Allthemodium Pickaxe&r. 

You'll also need the same Tier Pickaxe to Mine &3Rogdorium Ore&r. This Spawns anywhere in the Depths. 

You can also use a &aForgotten&r or &6Allthemodium Axe&r to Mine &3Rogdoric Ancient Root&r. These are much more common but will only give a &3Rogdorium Nugget&r compared to the full version the &3Ore&r gives.
quest.257893DD23BF5017.title: &3Rogdorium
quest.2580135392DEF522.quest_desc: Ever feel like the standard Hydroponic Bed is too laggy? Can't fit enough Soul Surges? Allow me to introduce the Simulated Hydroponic Bed. This will use a Hydroponic Simulation Processor and a seed/sapling to grow any crop of your choice...virtually. You don't even need &9Water&r and &bEther Gas&r for this one. On top of this, Hydroponic Simulation Processors get better over time as they grow more crops, though the rate at which it scales is slower in a Simulated Hydroponic Bed.\n\nDon't even bother trying to maximize the Processor. It will take an unfathomably long time. Much longer than what it would take for me to make the quests for Ender IO, for sure.
quest.2583E4890619044E.title: &6Thermal Springstone Sword
quest.2598273041353196.quest_desc:
When building the &aReprocessor&r, you will need at least one &eCollector&r and &9Waste Injector&r.

The &eReprocessor Collector&r must be placed in the center of the bottom face of the structure.

The &9Waste Injector&r must go in the center of the top face, which is where you'll pipe in or insert waste like &9Cyanite Ingots&r.
quest.25A3E30F722B38B6.title: &eGold Generator
quest.25ACB08E4F12CE79.quest_desc:
The &cNetherite Ministrosity&r is a Pet given to us by &4&lCataclysm&r! 

First, you'll need to Craft a &cNetherite Effigy&r. 

Then, we can kill the &c&lNetherite Monstrosity&r for the &cLava Power Cells&r. 

Finally, place down the &cEffigy&r and feed it a &cPower Cell&r to tame him! 

Once tamed he can be Shift Right Clicked to edit whether he is following, staying, or wandering. 

You can also Right Click him to open his Inventory, aka cracking open his entire head like a Rock Monster from Lego Power Miners. He has an Inventory of 15 Slots. 

He also has 960 &4Hearts&r and I can't find a way to heal him...
quest.25B45E8FBC9705B3.title: &dStarlit Diamond Axe
quest.25D4406CB86C8CBB.quest_desc: Now that we are collecting some &9waste&r from our reactor, part of the progression requires you to "Fluidize" some of the ingots you get. You know what that means?\n\nWe need to make a &aFluidizer&r! The main component is the &aFluidizer Controller&r. Once built, you can right-click on this to open up the interface. Here, you can turn it on or off, see what's inside, and the current power level.
quest.25D4406CB86C8CBB.title: The Fluidizer
quest.25E782DB4309A1B8.title: &3Aurora Deer Antlers
quest.263860CADB3D76C6.quest_desc: Powered Spawner is the Mob Spawner made using EnderIO. First, you'll need a filled Soul Vial and a Broken Spawner. (Technically you only need the Soul Vial to change the Spawner but that's whatever). Once you have a Broken Spawner you like, craft the Powered Spawner with it! Then, place it down, give it a Capacitor, and power it. Boom! now you are spawning mobs with EnderIO.\n\nYou can also make this Spawner fill Soul Vials directly, without the need of a Clicker.
quest.263C9A0FC04472AB.quest_desc: This one can either eat &cLava&r like no other, or be used for the &6&lStar&r. \n\nThis one's a hard one, I like seeing &cLava&r disappear instead of my stuff disappearing into &cLava&r.
quest.267A357B28228694.quest_desc: &#4DB85ERandom Access Memory&r is made in a &#5EC7E6Chemical Reactor&r with &#A1A1A1Styrene-Butadiene Rubber&r, &#D15EE6Argon&r, &7Antimony Dust&r, &#5ED2E6Aluminum Dust&r and &#5D76C2Silicon Wafers&r.
quest.268EA2DEC8840D13.quest_desc: When working on &4Computers&r, especially Quantum ones, the Hammers and Pliers on the Crafting Table won't be able to craft us what we need, we'll need a &bCrystal Assembler&r. \n\nFor this one we'll need a whole bunch of &9Singularities&r!
quest.26BEA64C80ECE1A6.quest_desc: Each &3Logistic Frame&r can be used for different types of automation.
quest.26D6FC091B7A8B38.quest_desc: The &eSilver Key&r! \n\nThe Treasure Chest opens up beneath the &e&lQueen's&r Throne.
quest.26D6FC091B7A8B38.title: &eSilver Key
quest.26F9DB31A835B69C.quest_desc:
&nFoundry&r: &aCheck&r 
&nLiquid Metal in Foundry&r: &aCheck&r 

Now how do we get it out? 

Remember our friend from earlier? The &c&lFoundry&r &bDrain&r? We'll need to acquaint him with our new friend, the &c&lFoundry&r &7Tap&r. 

Place the &c&lFoundry&r &7Tap&r on the &bDrain&r, now we can place Blocks beneath it to drain the &7Liquid Metal&r into... 

Blocks like the &8Casting Bin&r, which will turn about 900mB of &7Liquid Metal&r, into the full &7Metal Block&r. 

Or the &8Casting Table&r which is what we'll need in order to make...
quest.26FADB78B04F592B.quest_desc:
&l&aBuilding Gadgets 2&r is a Mod that adds a few very helpful Items. 

All for of course, building! 

Each requires &cEnergy&r to work and has a Menu which is pulled up by default &lG&r.

You can even link these to an AE2 network by putting it into a Wireless Access Point!
quest.271A112ABDD923A6.title: &9Banyin Trees
quest.272CF280BAE6870E.title: &6Allthemodium Mage Armor
quest.2748ACEAB96A5F60.quest_desc: Iron Furnaces (Don't be confused with each of the titles with &lIron Furnaces&r being the mod name and an Item name) work even faster than Normal and Copper Furnaces. They take 160 Ticks to work, or 8 seconds.\n\nThese can be crafted from either a normal Furnace or &6Copper Furnace&r! And they can be made into either a &7Silver Furnace&r or &eGold Furnace&r.
quest.27826D74ADC73556.quest_desc: Cooking &#ED8C61Copper Dust&r with &#90F0E7Oxygen&r in a &#E3CE54Kanthal EBF&r will give you &#E87848Annealed Copper Hot Ingot&r. This can be cooled down in a &#4CBBD9Vacuum Freezer&r to get &#E87848Annealed Copper Ingot&r. These ingots can be macerated for the &#E87848Annealed Copper Dust&r.
quest.27D8E62556F7CE8D.title: &6Thermal Springstone Hoe
quest.27F62C4B42B16015.quest_desc: Just place a 4x5 &eGlowstone Rectangle&r, just like a &cNether Portal&r and pour &9Water&r in it to make the &eAether Portal&r? \n\nYeah right, I'm not 7, I'm not falling for that again!
quest.27F62C4B42B16015.title: &eAether Portal
quest.27FC0C092EE00532.title: Can this Liquid: The ME Canner
quest.282AEEC832FFC8D7.title: &4Amaramber Axe
quest.2837E05AD0B67189.quest_desc: Swabs are my favorite way of getting Spawn Eggs, you'll need to use Mob Grinding Utils for it. Simply right click a mob with the Swab then craft Chicken Feed with it, seeds, and a bucket of any kind of &aXP Fluid&r. I don't care which type of &aXP Fluid&r you use for this. Once you have that, feed a Chicken it. Unfortunately the Chicken won't survive the procedure but hey, Spawn Eggs!
quest.2837E05AD0B67189.quest_subtitle: A way to get Spawn Eggs
quest.285656AF1F870AF8.quest_desc: 1 of the 2 Basic Tier Infusions but don't underestimate the Draconic Chest. It holds more space than a double chest, it can smelt and craft items, and best of all it can change colors! Easily my favorite Chest in any mod!
quest.285656AF1F870AF8.title: Draconium Chest
quest.2872C4229702B077.title: &bGlacite Pickaxe
quest.2897FA291E5A38D8.quest_desc: The &bSpatial Anchor&f is a companion device from the Spatial IO lineage that simply functions as a chunk loader. When connected to an ME network, the Anchor will force-load all the chunks occupied by the ME network across all cables and devices, excluding subnetworks, as long as the network remains powered.
quest.28BF66D1B8CD4D44.quest_desc:
&dBrooms&r can be made using Broom Parts. Every Broom is made up of 3 parts: a Rod, a Cap, and a Brush.

Each part can be crafted by combing the bare part with certain items to give them specific modifiers. As there are too many modifiers to type out, make sure to check the guide book for more info!

To craft your Broom, simply place each part into the crafting table. The Broom will require Blood to function properly.
quest.28BF66D1B8CD4D44.title: &cBlood &dBrooms
quest.28DB59B20109D0D4.quest_desc:
&6&lOritech&r is a Tech Mod (go figure!) known for lots of &lMultiblock Machines&r, Dangerous Blocks, and Colorful Titled Blocks! 

You'll need a bunch of Machines, many different Alloys and Materials, and lots of time. 

You'll need a &6Magnetic Coil&r to start, and good luck!
quest.28DB59B20109D0D4.title: &6&lOritech
quest.28E99A6E17E86709.quest_desc:
Moving &bFluids&r is an essential part of &8&lIE&r, just think of the Creosote Oil and Plant Oil! 

&bFluid Pipes&r are our basic ways of moving &bFluids&r, if you want them faster check out &bFluid Pumps&r. 

&bFluid Pipes&r, like Energy Connectors, are determined where to &9Input&r and &6Output&r from what they are connected to. Some Machines need &4Redstone Signals&r to &6Output&r to &bFluid Pipes&r, like the &b&lTank&r! 

We can use an &6Engineer's Hammer&r to change what the &bPipes&r connect to, plus we can use &8Steel Scaffolding&r on them to cover them, or Dye to dye them!
quest.28FEB4C11AD1AE7C.quest_desc: &bDiamonds&r are usually expensive... for Vanilla, but this is modded you'll have enough for atleast 1 &bDiamond Generator&r. Still uses normal Furnace Fuel.
quest.28FEB4C11AD1AE7C.title: &bDiamond Generator
quest.290FAB3DE8FD04E7.quest_desc:
Holding right click will charge up the Mace to do an AoE attack using &cBlood&r. Sneak-right clicking will change the power level.

The higher the power level, the more damage it will do at a higher cost of Blood.

You will need a fully charged one to craft the &6ATM Star&r.
quest.29283BF1B6ED3634.title: &7Mechanical &3Crossbow
quest.295EB6CFEC029AE2.quest_desc: Before you get here first you need an item that needs OP in it: Wyvern Bow, Chaotic Capacitor, Staff of Power whatever. Then you need an Energy Module in the item, that determines the OP storage in the item and that's what the item will use to power up. Once you have that, make and place the Energy Transfuser, get OP in it, then place your item into it! You'll know it's working when the OP in it lights up and moves.
quest.2982D38BD5EE6349.quest_desc: You can find these bees roaming around Warped Forests. Its nest can also be obtained from growing Warped Fungi, at a 2% chance.
quest.2982D38BD5EE6349.title: Warped Shroombee
quest.298458E916F65407.quest_desc: We burn Spiritus in the &cVas Maleficum&r and the chunk's air thickens with will. Whatever we release into it, we can read back later — a hidden reservoir capped at &e100 per Aspect&r.
quest.298458E916F65407.title: The Aura Between Worlds
quest.298963543B99734E.title: Coral Blocks
quest.298A7BED5C2C7582.quest_desc:
&aInduction Cells&r are placed within the &a&lEnergized Induction Matrix&r and will increase the amount of storage it has. 

And yes, their totals will stack on each other! 

&aBasic Induction Cell&r: will hold 3.2GFE each. 

&cAdvanced Induction Cells&r: will hold 25.6GFE each. 

&bElite Induction Cell&r: will hold 204.8GFE each. 

&5Ultimate Induction Cell&r: will hold 1.6TFE each.
quest.29D28983E0200A3C.quest_desc: &l&dArs Nouveau&r is all about using Glyphs in Spellbooks to be able to cast them as Spells!
quest.29E6EFC8C19912BD.quest_desc:
&7Sentries&r are a hybrid of &aSlimes &fand &aCreepers&r. 

They bounce like &aSlimes&r and EXPLODE like &aCreepers&r! 

If you Kill them before they blow up, they'll Drop &7Carved Stone&r.
quest.29E6EFC8C19912BD.title: &7Sentries
quest.29EC143D7E0347DE.quest_desc:
The &8Dagger of Hunger&r is made with the &8Teeth of Hunger&r. No, I am not saying Tooths. 

The &8Dagger&r has a Hunger Value. When you hit Mobs it will go up, when it's inactive it will decrease. When it gets to 100% you'll get boosts. And if it goes to 0% it will start killing you. 

When you hit Mobs (or Players) it will also give the Hunger effect. 

I don't blame it, I get angry when hungry too.
quest.29EC143D7E0347DE.title: &8Dagger of Hunger
quest.2A032EC573B5316C.quest_desc:
To get the &lWorld Tier: &2Frontier&r, you'll obviously need &9&lHaven&r done, but also need a few &eAffixed Items&r! 

How many? You need a full set of &eAffixed Armor&r plus an &eAffixed Tool &for &eWeapon&r. 

Now &aUncommon&r &4Invaders &fand &aGems&r are most abundant, with the rest following in order: &8Common&r, &9Rare&r, and also &5Epic&r. 

The Player with &lWorld Tier: &2Frontier&r will get a 35% Experience Boost, 20% Luck, and &a45 Max Eterna&r in total! 

Hey, not everything will be easy though, now &4Monsters&r will gain 4 Armor Points extra.
quest.2A14A47E40A97329.title: &aAlchemist Mask
quest.2A20000FAEC2E16A.quest_desc:
To extract power or items from your reactor, or even input fuel, you'll need these &crequired&r blocks.

The &cPower Tap&r provides a way for you to "tap" into the power that a &9passive&r reactor makes. You can attach pipes and cables to extract the power from it.

The &aAccess Ports&r are required for every reactor, and allows you to both input fuel from the reactor, or extract waste. It's usually a good idea to have 2 per reactor, one for each job.
quest.2A2041098C069772.title: &7Denizen
quest.2A26CE0E88B62002.title: &4Eye of Cyclops
quest.2A444F4CCC72545D.quest_desc:
The easiest Item we'll need for the &6&lATM Star&r from &4&lCataclysm&r is the &5Abyssal Sacrifice&r. 

The most basic Items needed is the Blocks of Ingots and Amethyst which are just &2&lVanilla&r Items. 

Then, you'll need a Nautilus Shell and a Heart of the Sea. These are &2&lVanilla&r Items which are rare to get... unless you kill &5Deeplings&r which can drop them! 

You'll also need an Athame which is a weapon used by &5Deepling Warlocks &fand &5Priests&r and dropped by them on death. 
The last part gives us a choice, either Crystallized Coral or Coral Chunk. Both are drops from &5Coral Golem&r and &5Coralssus&r.
quest.2A72B262AF4F11C9.title: &6Socotra Dragon&r Sapling
quest.2A976D41F79C34B1.quest_desc:
&e&lPipez&r do have their own way of Filtering Items, you need atleast an Advanced Upgrade to get it though. When an Advanced Upgrade is in you can click the Add button to add Filters. 
Then you can add: Item, Tag, or NBT in the Filter. 

There you can also add the set Destination Filter. To set it, Shift Right Click an Inventory with it. 

You'll also have to set it to either Whitelist the Filter or Blacklist, so only the Filter or everything but the Filter.
quest.2AAE61752728EA8D.title: Mining Stabilizer Module
quest.2AC7BC448C007BDB.quest_desc: Reinforce the Kivi with Aluminum and you'll get Machine Frames which are needed to craft machines.
quest.2AEBE3F28996A6ED.quest_desc:
With our new metals, we can upgrade our Furnace using the mod &aIron Furnaces&r!

Iron Furnaces (Furnaces from the mod itself, not just the Iron version) allow you to add &aAugments&r to upgrade a Furnace's speed, change its function, and much more!

These Furnaces make automation easier by allowing you to auto-pull or push from the sides using the config on the left of the interface.
quest.2B0C3AAAA6D0B0D2.quest_desc:
&aUranium Quad Fuel Rods&r are a combination of multiple different Blast and Radiactive proof Alloys and of course radioactive Materials. 

These will all come together to make a wonderful fuel for a reactor! Or &c&lPhilosphers Fuel&r!  

Or you can just use a &cBlaze Burner&r... but come on that's no fun!
quest.2B31E6C1707D8195.quest_desc: The next thing to make to allow for wireless network access is the &bME Wireless Access Point&f. The Access Point is used to open the network to wireless access via a &ewireless terminal&f, and has a set (finite) range depending on how many &bWireless Boosters&f are inserted into the access point.
quest.2B50E9FC93812730.title: &eDesert Temple
quest.2B57C8D2F98A9279.quest_desc:
&l&7Pocket Storage&r is a mod that adds simple handheld storage. 

Right Click to open it and you can put Items in. They will have a max count that it can hold, and anymore Items put in past it will be voided. It will also vacuum up Items on the ground that are the same as in it. 

There's also ways you can dump it into Chests or take out of Chests quickly. 

The different Tiers the higher the Slots and Max Items will be.
quest.2B5E14A47062F83C.quest_subtitle: The R in Roy G. Biv
quest.2B6D71DAF72EAFA4.title: Wyvern Capacitor
quest.2B857941D7BBA0B8.quest_desc:
Can be found in structures in the &6&lBumblezone&r or traded for with the &5Bee Queen&r! 

Ever hate getting stuck on &6Honey Blocks&r? Or even when &ePollen&r slows you down? Well there's no need to fear for the Honey Bee Leggings are here! They will help you move better through those Blocks. The more Bee Armor you wear, the easier travel will bee! 

Also you can Shift through &ePollen&r to collect it!
quest.2BB5769119BA2472.quest_desc:
This Quest has been authored by &6AllTheMods Staff&r, or a &2Community contributor&r for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all &6AllTheMods&r packs are licensed under &eAll Rights Reserved&r, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by &6AllTheMods Team&r without explicit permission. 

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.
quest.2BCB788924BBD849.title: &bThe Incinerator
quest.2C04B3BA507D5673.quest_desc: &bPatterns&f are what hold an encoded recipe to be fulfilled by a Pattern Provider. To encode a recipe onto a Pattern, the &bME Pattern Encoding Terminal&f must be used.\n\nPatterns can be set to hold either a regular &ecrafting&f recipe, which will require the use of a &eMolecular Assembler&f on the face of its Provider, or a more general '&eprocessing&f' recipe, wherein any input items can be sent out by the provider into some other machine block or specialised processing plant.
quest.2C04B3BA507D5673.title: Patterns
quest.2C0DF8D6ED259E5F.quest_desc:
Another &cInfernal Forge&r type Weapon. This time needing you to combine the &cInfernal Forge&r with &9Astrape&r. 

&cBron&9tes&r is still a Pickaxe, just also a much more powerful Weapon! A Pickaxe with the same Mining Tier. 

You can hold Right Click with &cBron&9tes&r and release to throw it! This will Hit Mobs and summon Lightning zaps around where it hit. 

It reminds me a lot of a certain Weapon used in Norse Mythology... I doubt there's any relation though.
quest.2C0DF8D6ED259E5F.title: &cBron&9tes
quest.2C4299D33D419AA0.quest_desc: Place the Teleport Pad in the &2&lOverworld&r to go to the &7&lMining Dimension&r.
quest.2C4ECA4F5B1639F4.title: &fLight Field
quest.2C7D62231AD6406A.quest_desc: XyCraft has a great Fluid Tank mulitblock!
quest.2C9C4BFF1D89EF82.title: &3Abandoned Village
quest.2CB69634F6A6E53E.quest_desc:
&0Dark Temples&r are hard to miss, considering they have a massive beam of light coming from the center.

In the center of the &9Dark Temple&r is a &aEnvironmental Accumulator&r.

We can use this to empower and create several items that we'll need along the way, including &dLightning Bombs&r!
quest.2CB69634F6A6E53E.title: &l&0Dark Temples
quest.2CC56A4F06E53307.title: Charging with UVs
quest.2CECCA9D05D3EF12.quest_desc:
The &2Eternal Stella&r is quite expensive. You'll need a Tier 3 Forge first! 

Then, you'll need &7Stellarite Piece&r which you can mine for. And you have to get 3 &aXpetried Orbs&r which you can no longer mine for. Instead you'll have to feed a Black Hole &aEXP&r to get it! 

Finally, you'll need an &6AllTheModium Ingot&r to get the &2Eternal Stella&r. It makes sense why it is so expensive as it can be combined with any Tool to make it Invincible!
quest.2CECCA9D05D3EF12.title: &2Eternal Stella
quest.2D00F85379A4D591.quest_desc: The Item Loader is the most basic dispenser from RailCraft. It has to be above the &6Track&r and can be configured to what you'll want loaded onto your &7Carts&r below.
quest.2D08BCF993B241B8.title: &7Scroll of Immunity Exchange
quest.2D474F8075E9DBD0.quest_desc:
First you need to place down the Casting Altar and Standing Stones in the pattern specified in JEI. 

Then, you'll need to put a Diamond Block, a Stick, and Blaze Powder into the Altar. 

After that, place down 4 Incense Blaziers around the Altar, put the Block of Coal in one, Acacia Bark in another, Verdant Bark in the third, and Birch Bark in the last. And light them all up with a Flint and Steel! 

Then Shift Right Click the Altar to start the Ritual! If it didn't work check the pattern the Standing Stones are in.
quest.2D592669F4D41793.quest_desc: Just like the Reactor, the frame must be built out of &dCasings&r, but the walls can be &9Turbine Glass&r instead!
quest.2D64EF8D803AF9DA.quest_desc:
The most expensive Portal we can make. First for &dDragon Eggs&r you don't have to keep milking the &dDragon&r you can use &l&bHNN&r or &l&2MA&r to get them or an Extrator to make more! 

Then, you'll need &dInfused Dragon's Breath&r from Enchanting. 

There you'll need &9Soul-Touched Sculkshelves&r to Enchant it and to make the Portal. 

If you are wondering why the Portal won't work, it's because you are already in the &2&lOverworld&r! Just kidding you can't use it!
quest.2D69B48F1EFCC9A5.quest_desc: &3Sturdy Boots&r will let you walk over Powdered Snow. \n\nThat's it.
quest.2D69B48F1EFCC9A5.title: &3Sturdy Boots
quest.2D8026E10FBA7A72.title: &6Allthemodium &5Alloy &3Pick
quest.2D8A7065F8CDDDDD.quest_desc: Swabs are my favorite way of getting Spawn Eggs, you'll need to use Mob Grinding Utils for it. Simply right click a mob with the Swab then craft Chicken Feed with it, seeds, and a bucket of any kind of &aXP Fluid&r. I don't care which type of &aXP Fluid&r you use for this. Once you have that, feed a Chicken it. Unfortunately the Chicken won't survive the procedure but hey, Spawn Eggs!\n\nNot all mobs can be swabbed, though.
quest.2DA8CE213AC3869B.title: &bStarlight &dCrystals
quest.2DD5F0693780B10A.quest_desc: Used with the Extruder MK2, blocks extruded will mimic the actual blocks. Redstone Blocks will emit Redstone, Glowstone will emit light, Grass will act transparent. But only with this Augment! \nDoesn't work with Block Entities like Furnaces or Enrichment Chambers.
quest.2DE2E5A1275E4B20.quest_desc:
Can be found in structures in the &6&lBumblezone&r or traded for with the &5Bee Queen&r! 

&6B&8e&6e&8s&r have quite an interesting way of finding and communicating with each other. I don't know how they do it so I'm just going to guess their Antennas give and receive radio signals. 

While wearing the Stingless Bee Helmet you can Shift to highlight all &6B&8e&6e&8s&r around you. 

Also while wearing it, poison and nausea will go away quicker.
quest.2E0275C21D3F0DA3.quest_desc: Not to be confused with a Draconic Bee.
quest.2E05F4FB1A1FDE2D.quest_desc:
&9Blue Swets&r have 6 &4Hearts&r. 

They won't Damage you... well by themselves. Instead they'll capture you and leap high into the air bringing you with. 

When captured the only way to free yourself is to Hit them. 

On Death &9Blue Swets&r will Drop &9Swet Balls&r and &bBlue Aeroclouds&r.
quest.2E05F4FB1A1FDE2D.title: &9Blue Swet
quest.2E22A601DC126B7B.title: Crystals from Nothing
quest.2E68E1D96B25336D.quest_desc: After fighting through a few Demon Possessed Zombified Piglins summoned by &6Odus' Open Convocation&r, you can use the Demonic Meat dropped by them to craft some Pink Chalk.
quest.2E85D6E2CFCC356E.quest_desc: The &3Vibranium Furnace&r is even better than the &6Allthemodium Furnace&r!
quest.2E88CCBC7B97A1F0.quest_desc: If only that giant portal in the Ancient City did something! Oh wait with &9&lDeeper and Darker&r it can! \n\nYou only need a...
quest.2E88CCBC7B97A1F0.title: &9&lDeeper and Darker
quest.2E9D3DA2DF3E3AC9.quest_desc:
The &5Petal &bScythe&r gives Poison to all it Hits. 

JEI says it can make Farmland but in game it won't... 

When Hitting &9Water&r a bunch of Particles will come up. 

I don't think this Item is finished.
quest.2E9D3DA2DF3E3AC9.title: &5Petal &bScythe
quest.2EDE91023F7924FB.quest_desc: Place the Teleport Pad in &d&lThe End&r to go to &5&lThe Beyond&r.
quest.2F37E284BB83BFF6.quest_desc: The Wrench is used to rotate or destroy certain blocks, shift right-click in the air to change modes.
quest.2F5263A4166BFCD6.quest_desc:
This Pylon prevents you from accidentally destroying certain Blocks/Mobs in the selected Chunk radius.

You can use a Mob Filter to prevent killing a certain Mob with the Pylon, or a Block Filter to prevent destroying a certain block.

You can stack multiple Mob and Block Filters to prevent multiple different Mobs/Blocks from being destroyed.
quest.2F76D074AEA84A4D.quest_desc:
By Right Clicking an &dEnder Dragon&r with an empty &bData Model&r, you can make the &dEnder Dragon &bData Model&r. 

The Quest needs any version of it, but the &d&lDragon Soul&r needs the &bData Model&r to be &6Self Aware&r. 

In order to get it &6Self Aware&r you need to keep killing the &dDragon&r or make a crap-ton of &a&lTraining&r simulations!
quest.2F9B0C642A6BE30C.title: &fIron Backpack
quest.3029E1E133B91ED8.quest_desc:
The &6Mechanical Drill&r can be used within a &aContraption&r or without. The without will need &dRotational Power&r but still does the same task. 

The &6Mechanical Drill&r will Mine any Block in front of it (that it can). 

It will Mine as fast as the &dRotational Power&r will give. And if there is an Inventory connected to the &aContraption&r, the Mined Block will be put into it, instead of on the floor. 

Yes, the &6Drill&r has a limit, it only has Diamond Tier for Mining. So, no Mining &6AllTheModium&r!
quest.30582B5FBED35FD1.quest_desc:
&cUtheric Clusters&r and &cShards&r can be Dropped by multiple different Mobs, especially the &cRot&r Monsters. 

9 &cShards&r make 1 &cCluster&r. 

We will then need to use an Infuser to combine &3Rogdorium&r and a &cUtheric Cluster&r to Craft &cUtheric Crystal&r.
quest.306A5B38B52F65F3.title: &4Amaramber Pickaxe
quest.30700E99091B712A.quest_desc:
The &cRegulator Upgrade&r allows you to maintain a certain amount of items within a block or machine. A great example of this is telling your network that you want to keep 64 Coal within a Furnace. You'd place the upgrade in an Exporter attached to a Furnace, then set it to 64. Your system will then try to keep the Furnace full of fuel!

But what if you need an item that is crafted? The &6Crafting Upgrade&r does exactly this. If you have the recipe inside of an Autocrafter, adding this upgrade to an interface will let it know to craft it if you run out.

Using our example from before, let's say we have a &aMystical Agriculture&r farm going and have Coal Essence. We can then put the Coal recipe in an Autocrafter connected to our system, then place this upgrade in the same Exporter that is keeping the Furnace fueled. If you run out of Coal in your system, the &6Crafting Upgrade&r allows your system to craft some more!
quest.309B0B2898893B4E.quest_desc:
&b&lSteve's Carts&r is all about upgrading... well your Carts! 

What sort of upgrades? Pretty much everything but the kitchen sink! 

From Drills, to guns, to arcade machines! What more could you want with your Carts?
quest.309B0B2898893B4E.title: &l&bSteve's Carts
quest.30CC20E33EFA2EDA.quest_desc:
The &cBlaze Burner&r is actually probably one of the easiest &6&lStar&r Ingrediants! 

First, we'll need an &cEmpty Blaze Burner&r. These are just 4 &7Iron Plates&r and a single &cNetherrack&r. 

Then, take your &cEmpty Blaze Burner&r and find a &cBlaze&r. You should know where they spawn but incase you don't: &cBlazes&r spawn in Structures in &c&lThe Nether&r. Just Right Click the &cBlaze&r with the &cEmpty Blaze Burner&r to capture it! 

Once captured, it can be used in exchange for the &aUranium Quad Fuel Rods&r to make the &c&lPhilosopher's Fuel&r.
quest.30D6924003C6E273.quest_desc:
&7Denizen&r Camps can be found within the Depths. You'll need to mine below Y Level 0 past the Dreadrock. 

Dreadrock needs a &aForgotten Pickaxe&r to be Mined. That is the same Tier as the &6Allthemodium Pickaxe&r. 

Here a bunch of &7Denizens&r will spawn, plus Mysterious Totems and Chests! Rarely a Chest might spawn a Mysterious Mask, the same the &7Denizens&r wear. 

Wearing a Mysterious Mask near &7Denizens&r is like wearing &eGold&r in front of Piglins. They will be Neutral unless someone is hit (or something is done to aggravate them).
quest.30EB438C66324213.quest_desc: A Rune of Solitude will do part what the Spawner Upgrade Runes do but much better. Players no longer need to be near the spawner. As long as its chunk-loaded it will spawn.
quest.30ED5FF9DF7B34CF.quest_desc:
By either Looting a Denizen Camp or Crafting this, we can use the Mysterious Totem! 

Uhhh... how do we use it? 

Simply Place it down and every couple of Seconds it will give you &bPurity&r for 10 Seconds. 

&bPurity&r will cleanse you from the &cRot&r.
quest.31094CC16E710040.quest_desc:
The &4Crowbar&r is the main tool of RailCraft. 

When used on a &5Locomotive&r it will change the direction it's facing. 

When shift clicked you can connect &5Locomotives&r and &7Carts&r. 

When just used on &7Carts&r they give them a slight push. 

And when used on special tracks they change their mode. 

The different &4Crowbars&r just give different looks and damage.
quest.310969B8FE0A94DE.quest_desc: Another game change Apotheosis brings is to Spawners. Remember being able to mine Spawners with Silk Touch? Well it's back thanks to Apotheosis! There's also many new Modifications you can add to Spawners by right clicking any of these items.
quest.311F43D48B9C26FF.quest_desc: The &dObsidian Generator&r is slower than the &aEmerald&r and &5Netherite Generators&r but it has more upgrades than all of those combined!
quest.311F43D48B9C26FF.title: &dObsidian Generator
quest.3124D945A54938C2.quest_desc: Swamp Silver used to Spawn in the &9Swamps&r but it has been promoted (or demoted I don't know) to Spawning everywhere and now in the &9Swamp Malarite&r will Spawn.
quest.3124D945A54938C2.title: &9Malarite
quest.3145B847A15F97F2.quest_desc: You can combine the Essences from &2&lMystical Agriculture&r to make... &8Coal&r. \n\nObviously it works as an amazing Fuel source but &5Insanium Coal&r seems a little too insane for me.
quest.3145B847A15F97F2.title: &5Insanium Coal Block
quest.315F1CB8158DFB92.title: &5Aethersent Hood
quest.3181D07337DEFD14.title: &lThe Ominous Dead King
quest.31A2B9C5C0962160.title: &cFlaming Sword
quest.31AD9826FB036C98.quest_desc: &7Runes&r can spawn from Bedrock to Y Level 2. That includes near &9Darkstone&r! \n\nThey're more useful than &2Stellarite&r but less useful than &bArcane Crystals&r.
quest.31B0267C47DB9D98.quest_desc:
This Quest has been authored by &6AllTheMods Staff&r, or a &2Community contributor&r for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.

As all &6AllTheMods&r packs are licensed under &eAll Rights Reserved&r, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by &6AllTheMods Team&r without explicit permission.

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.
quest.31DDEA54B6E81EEE.title: &7Deepsilver Helmet
quest.31FD9EA513E0D010.quest_desc:
&cEvilCraft&r is a magic mod based on somewhat evil things. Collect the blood of your enemies and harness the power of an ancient source of evil!

Everything in this mod can be found in the guidebook, the &aOrigins of Darkness&r.

To get started, find yourself some &9Dark Gems&r.
quest.31FD9EA513E0D010.title: &aWelcome to &cEvilCraft&r!
quest.321C15EBBE2D3D30.quest_desc:
When you blow up a Spawner, it will become highly unstable, spawning a large amount of its respective mob, and leaving Spawner Chains behind.

How many chains, you might be wondering? At the time of writing, 48-57.

You'll need these Chains for...
quest.321C15EBBE2D3D30.title: Blowing up Spawners
quest.321F16645640C462.quest_desc: Enderpearls are a fun way of travel! (Helpful for the Bumblezone, I wonder if we'll get a Quest chapter for that Mod!) But don't you hate that the Enderpearl gets consumed on use and takes 2 Hearts of damage with each use? \n\nWith &9Warp Drive&r that all goes away, clearly making Enderpearls the greatest transportation! Hunger gets consumed instead of the Enderpearl and no longer take damage from using an Enderpearl. When all Hunger Bars are depleted it will go back to consuming Enderpearls.
quest.3227846235A60B58.quest_desc:
The best way to automate the &aFluid XP&r and &4Blood&r in order to fuel our &c&lAutomatic Forge&r we'll need a Spawner! 

We'll need a Spawner that gives the best bang for our buck, I recommend using Piglin Brutes as they give a ton of &aXP&r and have a lot of &4Health&r. But whatever you use is up to you! 

Also don't forget to give them No AI with a &dChorus Fruit&r so they don't escape. 

Feel free to use Fans or Entity Conveyors to move the Mobs who get spawned.
quest.3235FBD9CE21D5EE.quest_desc: Check out the Modules to learn more on how to use and upgrade the DE items! I know what you fellow Player really care about the Wyvern Shovel. You don't need to spend anymore sleepless nights because now you know, the DE Shovels can make pathways.
quest.3235FBD9CE21D5EE.title: Wyvern Shovel
quest.325483DEB0C602F8.quest_desc:
This Quest has been authored by &6AllTheMods Staff&r, or a &2Community contributor&r for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all &6AllTheMods&r packs are licensed under &eAll Rights Reserved&r, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by &6AllTheMods Team&r without explicit permission. 

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.
quest.326452FFA7F5C6CA.quest_desc:
&eGolden Swets&r act like &9Blue Swets&r. Same Health, same Attack. 

Just these guys can survive higher Jumps, which means they'll Jump more times and higher than &9Blue Swets&r. 

&eGolden Swets&r will Drop &eGlowstone&r! Helpful for recreating the &ePortal&r.
quest.326452FFA7F5C6CA.title: &eGolden Swet
quest.326C63F7DC713E71.quest_desc:
The Distributer is the half siblings of the Sender Modules. (The MK3 to be exact, on the MK2 side). 

Instead of sending to 1 Inventory it will send to multiple that are selected. 

It can send in multiple modes: Round Robin, Random, Nearest First, or Farthest First. Round Robin does an even amount to each in a row, like a dealer in Poker. Random will randomly choose an inventory to feed. The others are determined by the distance from the Router.
quest.32ABE5D734703B9C.quest_desc:
&7Elytra&r or &a&lMekaSuit Bodyarmor&r... 

&7Elytra&r or &a&lMekaSuit Bodyarmor&r... 

Why not both?
quest.32ABE5D734703B9C.title: &7Elytra Unit
quest.32C3E14578D48E6C.quest_desc: Just like regular &3Pressure Tubes&r only these can hold 10 bars of pressure.
quest.32D2CE292E088939.title: &cFire&r Upgrade Orb
quest.3311B79A8F6C6ADD.quest_desc:
The &6&lEnchanting Table of the Raven&r is a powerful upgrade to the &5Enchanting Table&r, allowing you to customize the &aEterna&r, &cQuanta&r, and &5Arcana&r values of the &5Table&r, without the need for shelves.

This can allow you to achieve any &d&lInfusion&r with ease.

Gems of the Royal Family can be obtained in the Overworld.
quest.3311B79A8F6C6ADD.title: &6&lEnchanting Table of the Raven
quest.332A3C7BA261DBFC.quest_desc: Using a &eDowsing Rod&r from &dArs Nouveau&r will help you find the exact location of a &eMeteorite&r once you've used the &eMeteorite Compass&r to find its general location.
quest.3331EBE1BB4BF64D.quest_desc:
Nuclear Reactors can be pretty scary to some especially with the dangerous effects of them! 

Luckily the only thing scary about &a&lExtreme Reactors&r is how confusing it can be to follow the recipes! 

Not the explody part they don't do that.
quest.33415CB421F7620A.title: &b&lPurification Chamber
quest.33436ED0D9F128BD.title: &4Augment&r: Smoking
quest.337D376BE2653F0F.title: &bGlacite Boots
quest.33882172DA8021F6.quest_desc: Keeps the player's inventory stacked up from items inside the Backpack.
quest.33F4A7613764A016.quest_desc: Works like Importers do, only they export instead.
quest.340CDF4357E22A43.quest_desc: Iron has blessed us with a very fun Exploration and Magic Mod! Fighting with and for Magic! Nothing is cooler than that! \n\nIt has a Quest Page which you are welcome for.
quest.340CDF4357E22A43.title: &e&lIron's Spells and Spellbooks
quest.34119FC1728B75B9.title: &4Amaramber Helmet
quest.3417FF406CF0479E.quest_desc:
&2Skyroot&r is the only Tree we find besides &eGolden Oak&r. 

There's also Crystal Trees but those also use &2Skyroot Logs&r so same difference! 

&2Skyroot&r like any Logs can make Blocks, Tools, ETC.
quest.3417FF406CF0479E.title: &2Skyroot Trees
quest.342EEB042DEC2B8C.title: Magma and Geysers
quest.34D7CA6F99B29C87.title: &2Air Sac Mask
quest.34F7325C2AFA6DA7.quest_desc:
This Quest has been authored by &6AllTheMods Staff&r, or a &2Community contributor&r for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.

As all &6AllTheMods&r packs are licensed under &eAll Rights Reserved&r, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by &6AllTheMods Team&r without explicit permission.

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.
quest.34FBB18ADA647010.quest_desc:
The Cloud Staff will summon 2 Cloud Minions that orbit you when you Right Click. 

If you Left Click after Spawning them they both will shoot Ice Crystals at where you aim. 

Once you're tired of them, just Shift Right Click to get rid of them.
quest.34FBD04361657724.title: The Crystals of Space and Time: Entro Crystals
quest.35FA55BE8DF49EE8.quest_desc: Using the power of a slain &9Vengeance Spirit&r, we can use the Blood Infuser to create &dGarmonbozia&r.\n\nThis is &dPain&r and &dSorrow&r materialized. It's also the high-end crafting material for powerful tools and items in EvilCraft.
quest.35FA55BE8DF49EE8.title: &dGarmonbozia
quest.360B150190A5C894.title: &5&lRunic Enchanter
quest.362F529D5E7C37A4.quest_desc: If you stand in &9Water&r with &6Phoenix Armor&r you'll get &5Obsidian Armor&r. \n\n&5Obsidian Armor&r gives up the Fire Protection for an extra 4 Armor Toughness.
quest.362F529D5E7C37A4.title: &5Obsidian Armor
quest.3666C6DA23E15F78.quest_desc: A Bow that sets all Arrows on &cFIRE&r!
quest.3666C6DA23E15F78.title: &6Phoenix Bow
quest.36926B5EBFF6E55A.title: Making &cMercury
quest.36ABE142039E712B.quest_desc:
This one works like normal infinite energy storage, just this one can connect to your system though! Never have to worry about if your System has enough Power! And that includes the &5Quantum Armor&r. 

You'll need 4 &dSuperdense Cells&r and an &6&lATM Star&r. Each &dSuperdense Cell&r needs 8 &dDense Cells&r, each &dDense Cell&r needs 8 &dEnergy Cells&r. 

256 &dEnergy Cells&r... plus a lotta energy!
quest.36ABE142039E712B.title: &5&lCreative &dEnergy Cell
quest.36D9FB96D3557266.quest_desc:
&9Moa's&r are big friendly Birds. 

They have 17 and a &4Half Hearts&r and Drop Feathers. 

Randomly they'll Drop &9Moa Eggs&r which is how you'll be able to Tame them. Check out the &c&lIncubator&r to find out more!
quest.36D9FB96D3557266.title: &9Moa
quest.36DAFC3FECC67406.title: Chaotic Capacitor
quest.36DEA17CBB696CC7.quest_desc:
If you right-click on the Plug, you'll see the Flux Network UI. On the far top-right corner, click on the + button to create your first network. You'll need to set a password to create the network, but you can also set a color!

From here, you can go to the Network Selection tab to activate your network on the Plug. If the Plug is attached to a power source, you can now harness that power anywhere in your system using a Flux Point!

Pro Tip: You can create multiple networks if you want to have different power sources powering different parts of your systems!
quest.36DF0D83EBC2B6A9.title: &3&lImprobable Probability Device
quest.36EB83BB41A9E621.title: &b&lTank
quest.36F123B2A6B52A01.title: Draconic Energy Relay Crystal
quest.371A34B297C8A8EF.quest_desc:
PneumaticCraft is all about Pressure! These quests won't go over everything the mod has, but will still go over a lot! Please remember to check JEI, read the tooltips and read the PCB:R, they are all very useful.

To get started, you'll need to craft some &3Compressed Iron Ingots&r! The easiest way to do this is to make a hole in the ground, throw in some iron ingots (or blocks) and then blow it up with some TNT!

Some might get lost in the explosion, but that's a risk we'll have to take!
quest.372B5BF416CA83A4.quest_desc:
&5&lMekanism&r is one of the most popular Machine and Technology Mods. Quite frankly I have a hard time summarizing it as it has so much in it! 

It has so much we even had to make 2 Quest Pages for it! 

The stuff we need for the &6&lATM Star&r is in the Reactors page but you'll need to get through the Mekanism page to get there.
quest.37355F60E45777FE.title: &3Orb of Prophecy
quest.373CA701008A9584.quest_desc: The &4Wilted Crossbow&r needs both the &9&lLunar Monstrosity&r and &b&lStarlight Golem&r killed. \n\nThe &4Wilted Crossbow&r is like a normal Crossbow, just every Arrow will deal Wither and Slowness.
quest.373CA701008A9584.title: &4Wilted Crossbow
quest.377D6CF86BC1C64F.quest_desc:
The &8Tome of Scrapping&r will only take off half the &5Enchantments&r, while the &8Tome of Superior Scrapping&r will take every &5Enchantment&r off the Item! 

Both of these &8Tomes&r will break the Item in use though. 

To &d&lInfuse&r our &8Tome of Scrapping&r into a &8Tome of Superior Scrapping&r you can use 3 &9Echoing Sculkshelves&r and 15 &7Basic Bookshelves&r.

Or, if you want this &8Tome&r on &2&lFrontier&r, you can use 8 &bCrystalline Seashelves&r.
quest.3781DB4807A89375.quest_desc:
The&5 Zanite Sword&r is around Iron Sword Damage... until it losses Durability. 

Yep, the &5Sword&r will deal more Damage the less Durability it has! 

The &5Axe&r will chop &2Trees&r faster the less Durability it has.
quest.3781DB4807A89375.title: &5Zanite&r Weapons
quest.378A7484CF999F03.quest_desc: These would be perfect for tiny underwater dollhouses! \n\nIf there's even a single other person in history who thought of that as an idea...
quest.378A7484CF999F03.title: &dSpiral Kelp
quest.378C95C18798D413.title: Tool Belt
quest.37DB7871590921CF.quest_desc:
&bHippocampus&r can be Tamed! By Feeding it Kelp. 

Once Tamed, we can Right Click them with a Saddle, to be able to Ride them like a Horse. 

They can Crawl slowly on land or Swim quickly &9Underwater&r. When &9Underwater&r on their Back, you'll get &9Water Breathing&r! 

They can even Jump! Just not too high...
quest.37E49A1A6BA0E28D.title: &5Aethersent Cape
quest.37E556B4A730E5AA.quest_desc:
You might have noticed that your &aEterna&r refuses to go above &a30&r, even if you used &4Hellshelves&r or &bSeashelves&r. This is because &lWorld Tiers&r determine your &aMax Eterna&r now.

On &9&lHaven&r (the first &lWorld Tier&r), it's &a30&r. On &2&lFrontier&r, it's &a45&r.

Check out the Apotheosis Gear chapter or the linked quests in the &lWorld Tiers&r section of this chapter to learn more about &lWorld Tiers&r.
quest.37E556B4A730E5AA.quest_subtitle: Why is my Eterna capped to 30?
quest.37E556B4A730E5AA.title: The &2&lFrontier&r Calls
quest.3804364077F4BAD4.quest_desc:
Very rarely &dPixies&r might lose their &dWings&r on Death. They won't need them anymore, they're Dead... but you should still feel bad for Killing them! 

Or instead of grieving the loss of innocent life you can Craft a Weapon with their remains! 

Man, you are such a monster. 

The &dPixie Wand&r will use up &dPixie Dust&r to Shoot a &dPixe Beam&r! These will Damage and give Levitation and Glowing to whatever they Hit.
quest.3813F5C1760C3A79.quest_desc:
Piglin Brutes being here might cause controversy but I consider them Minibosses. 

They spawn in Bastions with regular Piglins but these are Hostile not Neutral. Personally I hate that, especially since if you hit them all Piglins will turn Hostile on you. 

They have 50 Hearts and a Golden Axe to hit you. Usually Golden Axes barely do any damage, but when they use it, it is god tier somehow! 

They drop nothing and act more like an obstacle for Bastions!
quest.383F7F715C60252B.title: Tier II: The Second Ring
quest.3887FD4B14BB993D.quest_desc: &cRegeneration Stones&r will constantly Heal you when worn. \n\nYou can actually hold two of them and they will stack Healing!
quest.3887FD4B14BB993D.title: &cRegeneration Stone
quest.38954551309F42A7.quest_desc:
Sender Module MK2 works similar to MK1 but with less restrictions. 

MK2 doesn't need direct line of sight or to be on same XYZ axis. 

Will have to be in the same Dimension though, unless you have...
quest.38A1295878B68F83.title: &6Kandar's Opened Conjure
quest.38AD547C36BDF4C4.title: Draconic Projectile Accuracy Module
quest.38ADDF7FF4E4892D.quest_desc:
The &7Glass Sword&r deals 40 hearts of damage, but only has 1 durability.

You can make it indestructible if you want to use it.

These are rarely found in loot chests in the &bAurora Palace&r.
quest.38BFF6F845EA479E.title: Bottom Left &6&lATM Star&r part
quest.38CF9E6E7490BD50.title: &6Thermal Springstone Hammer
quest.38E3ABEEFCE6A0B9.quest_desc: The &9Shield of Repulsion&r, when worn, will deflect Projectiles away from you and back at whoever threw them. \n\nIt has Durability though...
quest.38E3ABEEFCE6A0B9.title: &9Shield of Repulsion
quest.39647A2473F6F7D7.quest_subtitle: Put some Demon Dust™ on it!
quest.396CEB9D05700927.quest_desc:
To get into the &l&6Bumblezone&r you'll first need a &eBeehive&r. Normal &eBeehives&r and &eAdvanced Beehives&r it's not picky! 

Then you'll need to either throw an Enderpearl into it or have a Piston push you into it! 

And you'll get into the &eHive&r and enter the &l&6Bumblezone&r!
quest.3971FF7D044D1FE5.quest_desc: Armor abilities can be configured and toggled in the configuration menu. Use a JDT tool or wand to open the menu and click on your armor to configure the abilities of that armor piece.
quest.3972EE0ECB215843.quest_desc: Extended and Advanced AE are addons for Applied Energistics 2. Both of them focus on improving your experience, adding improved versions of various devices, and more.
quest.3972EE0ECB215843.title: Extended \& Advanced AE
quest.39796595B42BB41E.quest_desc:
The &7Energy &bBoomerang&r is a unique Weapon made of &8Golem Steel&r. 

To use it, just Right Click. This will Throw it. 

Like every other Boomerang, except for the ones I've thrown, it will return to you. It will come back after around 10 Blocks or if it Hits a Block. 

If it Hits a Mob it will Deal Damage and set them on Fire.
quest.39796595B42BB41E.title: &7Energy &bBoomerang
quest.39865681B03CABAA.quest_desc: Water is a little viscous, or atleast more dense than air. Because of that Mining Underwater is slower. You can use the Enchantment of Aqua Affinity, or use this Module. Your choice!
quest.39865681B03CABAA.title: Aqua Adapt Module
quest.39B4F361EF611927.title: &l&8Wither's Compass
quest.39BED5DD9D24F98E.quest_desc:
&3Sculk Grime&r is &3&lDeeper and Darker's&r version of Clay! 

You can find it within a few Biomes and when you mine it you'll get &3Grime Balls&r. 

These can then be made back into &3Sculk Grime&r or made into &3Grime Bricks&r.
quest.39E1211455224291.quest_desc:
&bZephyrs&r are angry Clouds. 

With only 2 and a &4Half Hearts&r they'll shoot Airballs at you. Like a Ghast, that shoots Breezeballs. 

When Killed they'll Drop Cold Aeroclouds.
quest.39E1211455224291.title: &bZephyr
quest.39E822440E7D2E04.quest_desc: Mob Grinding Utils is all about Mob Farming so of course it has a Spawner! The Entity Spawner! It'll need 3 things to work though: a Spawn Egg, XP Jelly Babies, and a Redstone signal. XP Jelly Babies are made by processing XP through a XP Solidifier with the XP Mould Jelly Baby. They can be eaten or used as Fuel in the second slot. Once you have the Spawn Egg in the top slot, XP Jelly Babies in the Second, and a Redstone signal it'll start spawning the mobs!
quest.39F9C825B03DA317.quest_desc: &8Aerial Interface&r works as a link between it's own internal storage and your Inventory. Basically whatever goes in it, goes to you. \n\nYou'll need a whole assembly line to craft it, the Quests should help you!
quest.39F9C825B03DA317.title: &8Aerial Interface
quest.3A33514BD62CD7D9.title: &bGlacite Axe
quest.3A4C17878FC8315B.quest_desc: The &6Allthemodium Furnace&r is pretty much the same as the Netherite Furnace. You will need this to craft the &3Vibranium Furnace&r.
quest.3A4C17878FC8315B.title: &6Allthemodium Furnace
quest.3A6C912577A615EE.title: &dStarlit Diamond Sword
quest.3A8AF52A5AE7C6CB.title: &7Iron Bubble
quest.3ADCAD65EA6900BA.quest_desc:
&2Achaeology&r allows players to find items inside of &aSuspicious&r blocks like Sand and Gravel.

These blocks can be found in various structures like Warm Ocean Ruins, Desert Pyramids, Desert Wells, and &eTrail Ruins&r.

To uncover an item from a Suspicious block, you need to create a &aBrush&r to brush away the block to unveil an item.
quest.3AFEE53B4276F8CA.quest_desc:
Finally, a Tool! 

The &3Underminer&r is a Pickaxe. Its gimmick is that the lower your Y Level, the faster it Mines. 

How does it know how low it is though?
quest.3AFEE53B4276F8CA.title: &3Underminer
quest.3B3BD39BA02DCA13.quest_desc: With the &6Pocket Piston&r your Attacks will hit your Enemies much farther! \n\nI wonder which wins, &6Pocket Piston&r or &7Steadfast Boots&r?
quest.3B5DEB942752B3BF.quest_subtitle: Automatic Hephaestus Forge does not work without upgrades
quest.3BAF4078F5776809.title: &6Thermal Springstone Chestplate
quest.3BB0926C4C00BE1D.quest_desc:
Don't you hate when you run out of Energy in your Jetpack? Well you'll neever need to worry about that again! 

You might need to make every Jetpack before it, an &6&lATM Star&r, plus more expensive Items but hey it is worth it! 

Just put it on and use it as normal, just with less charging.
quest.3BC0A50886A3222B.quest_desc: ATM10 is a kitchensink pack that allows you to explore the world of modded Minecraft in your own way!\n\nIf you have any questions or issues, feel free to join the ATM discord!
quest.3BDB94F17765EE77.quest_desc: If you're looking to generate a ton of power, you can start by scaling up some of the options from the &9Mid Game Power&r section. Make your &aReactors&r bigger. Upgrade your &9Thermo Generators&r to Nitro. Go wild.\n\nHowever, you may need even more power.
quest.3BDB94F17765EE77.title: End Game Power Options
quest.3C37018123D3653C.title: &2Air Sac Boots
quest.3C3FE45CEF5E242B.quest_desc:
While the other &aReprocessor Parts&r have a mandatory spot when building, these three parts can be placed on any vertical face as long as they aren't on the frame!

The &cPower Port&r is used to give power to the multiblock machine to process waste.

The &9Fluid Injector Port&r is used to inject the liquid needed, which will depend on the type of waste injected. For Cyanite, that means water!

The &aOutput Port&r is used to output the reprocessed material. You can right click it to grab the material out by hand, or pipe it out for automation.
quest.3C54C36CE97A48DC.quest_desc:
Droppers drop,
Dispensers dispense, 
And Flingers fling! 

Instead of nicely setting down items from the Buffer, the Flinger Module will throw them? How far? You determine that!
quest.3C5734448FEC128B.quest_desc: The cheapest Divination Rod, the Glass Divination Rod. \n\nIt can find all Ores that a Stone Pickaxe can mine. So Copper, Coal, and Iron. Nothing higher.
quest.3C62EDBB44D83A41.quest_desc: The &5Nature Staff&r works with Tamed &9Moas&r. \n\nWant them to Sit? Use the &5Staff&r.
quest.3C62EDBB44D83A41.title: &5Nature Staff
quest.3C74DAE7EC844A98.title: &3Lunar Berries
quest.3CA324BE8531F253.title: The Weak Blood Shard
quest.3CB7884B7B32CF00.quest_desc:
Getting your first &bEther Gas&r might be a little bit scary.

&bEther Gas&r is made from drilling a Wither, using a Fluid Drill with a &5Purple Lens&r.

But don't worry about the Wither, Industrial Foregoing has a machine just to help you with that task. The &4Stasis Chamber&r is a machine that freezes in place anything that is on top of it in a 3x3 area, including the Wither.

&cHope you don't run out of power, because if you do... I hope you're ready to fight the &0Wither&c. Because of this, I recommend using some kind of Wither-Proof Glass, such as Tinted Glass from Mob Grinding Utils, or Crystalix Glass with Reinforced Mode enabled.&c
quest.3CFD27F273B97FDD.quest_desc: The &5&lApothic&r mods have multiple cores, each changing different parts of &2&lMinecraft&r.\n\nThe Attributes and Enchanting mods are what you'll need to follow to get the &6&lATM Star&r!
quest.3D2B4BF905CB606F.quest_desc: Awakened Draconium Seeds require an Awakened Draconium Crux placed below in order for them to grow.
quest.3D2B4D9FD2086B9B.quest_desc:
The &2Fission Reactor Logic Adapter&r ,which I will be calling &2FRLA&r, is used to monitor and configure the &2&lFission Reactor&r with &4Redstone&r. 

First, place the &2FRLA&r in one of the walls of the &2&lFission Reactor&r like you would with the &2Ports&r. 

Then, we can Right Click the &2FRLA&r to configure it. 

Disabled: won't interact with &4Redstone&r. 

Activation: will turn the &2&lReactor&r on when given a &4Redstone Signal&r, and when there is no longer a &4Signal&r it will turn off. 

High Temperature: will send out a &4Redstone Signal&r when the &6Temperatures&r reach a dangerous Level. 

Critical Waste Level: will give a &4Signal&r when there is too much &8Nuclear Waste&r. 

Damage Critical: will, like the others, will give out a &4Signal&r when the &2&lReactor&r is just about to blow up! 

Insufficient Fuel: will give a &4Signal&r when it is running out of &2Fissile Fuel&r.
quest.3D31B94CC42BCE43.quest_desc:
The &8Tome of Extraction&r is the &8Tome&r we are looking for! It will take off all &5Enchantments&r and leave the Item alone!

To make it we'll need to &d&lInfuse&r our &8Tome of Superior Scrapping&r. 

We can just use our previous &9Sculkshelf&r setup for this.
quest.3D4032E7119AF8B7.title: &5Sonar Bomb
quest.3D4D88B8BE881351.quest_desc:
If you want to cast better spells, you'll need a &6Scribe's Table&r to unlock new glyphs for your spellbook. 

There are 3 tiers of glyphs to unlock, and each one requires some experience and items. 

The Scribe's Table is also used to attach spells to Spell Parchments. To do this, place a Spell Parchment on the table, select the spell in your Spellbook, then sneak right-click the book on the table. 

To create a Glyph, right-click on the Scribe's Table with your spellbook. Search for the glyph you want to make, then click Select at the bottom. Right-click the table with the items required, and the glyph will be created. Use the glyph to learn it. 

Note: The table can pull items from nearby inventories.
quest.3D78D9F4E8A60EDB.quest_desc: Currently a pretty simple recipe, only needing 4 &dSource Jars&r, 4 &dSource Gem Blocks&r, and a &6&lStar&r. Don't worry this will be changed to be even harder! \n\nThis jar is always full of &dSource&r and can be linked to anything needing &dSource&r. Including the &6&lATM Star&r multiblocks.
quest.3D78D9F4E8A60EDB.title: &5&lCreative &dSource &fJar
quest.3D7CEED6B974ED8C.title: &5Aethersent Boots
quest.3D819550074CA376.quest_desc: The item will need to be placed here before getting picked back up.
quest.3DB036804AD70497.quest_desc: The &7Bronze Key&r! \n\nThe Treasure Chest is below where the &7&lSlider&r was sitting Dormant.
quest.3DB036804AD70497.title: &7Bronze Key
quest.3DCD38634176BD92.quest_desc: Combine the &6Allthemodium&r &eSpell Book&r with a Vibranium Ingot and Template in a Smithing Table.\n\nThis template can be obtained from Brushing Suspicious Soul Sand in a Bastion.
quest.3DD27DED791C6A0B.quest_desc: To process ores using &5Oritech&r, you need to use a &aCentrifuge&r with a &6Fluid Addon&r and a &aPulveriser&r or &6Fragment Forge&r.
quest.3DDB0DDA7571B2C1.title: ME Level Emitter
quest.3DDF87A1E5F5D009.title: The &9Energizing Orb
quest.3DE14F16F3109229.quest_desc:
By combining 8 Planks of any Wood, with a &7Bucket of Creosote Oil&r, we'll get Treated Wood! 

Treated Wood is used in almost every single Item &8&lIE&r gives us, plus most of the simple Machines. 

Most important is the &6Engineer's Workbenches&r! These will give us a ton of new Recipes.
quest.3DE14F16F3109229.title: Treated Wood
quest.3E1A3BC8642390B3.quest_desc: 'I'm Marry Poppins ya'll!' \n\n&4The Umbrella&r is a very useful tool added by &l&3Artifacts&r! It can be held infront of you to work as a Shield, by holding Right Click. Or it can be used to slow your fall by just holding it!
quest.3E32450DBB7529AA.title: &eItem Batcher
quest.3E3CBDCEAB0FF28F.quest_desc:
The &9Deep Learner&r is one of the core components of HNN.

With this item, you can right click to open up a HUD and store &6Data Models&r to gather data while killing mobs.

Each Learner can hold 4 Data Models, and as long as you have the Learner anywhere in your inventory, it will collect data for the models placed inside!

Note: You can have multiple Deep Learners in your inventory, and it will count the kills for all Data Models inside all of the Learners.
quest.3E3DF8E967D95DB0.quest_desc: When using a 64k storage component or higher, the Matter Condenser becomes able to condense significantly more to produce a &bSingularity&f. A single singularity requires 256000 items to be voided. That's exactly &o4000 stacks&r!\n\nSee what happens when you throw this singularity on the ground with a piece of &eEnder Dust&f. You'll have to deal some damage to the surroundings while you're at it, but thankfully AE2 offers its own &bTiny TNT&f to minimise that.
quest.3E3DF8E967D95DB0.title: Hyper-Condensed Matter
quest.3E6706BC4C318A40.quest_subtitle: Fresh from the Manure Field, your spookiness
quest.3E75AFE3482834C5.quest_desc:
&lRailCraft&r is an entire mod based off &5Trains&r!

Infinity Tools, so called because of their ability to be charged near-infinitely. Increasing the tier of the tool can give said tool special perks. Having &5Biofuel&r in them will make them more efficient, by consuming the fuel instead of power when used.

There are 7 tiers:
Poor
Common
Uncommon
Rare
Epic
Legendary
Artifact

To learn more about each Infinity Tool, check out Industrial Foregoing's Manual (so that I don't have to cover so many infinity tools in one quest)!

quest.4211F29561F21643.quest_desc:
The way the &9&lTurbine&r works is it takes in Steam via the &9Ports&r and that Steam will move the &9Blades&r on the &9Rotors&r. 

Oh wait I should probably tell you how to create the &9&lTurbine&r insides! 

The &9Rotors&r will be placed from the floor up within the exact center of our &9&lTurbines&r. Each &9Rotor&r can hold 2 &9Blades&r. 

The more &9Blades &fand &9Rotors&r the wider it will get. We won't be able to use 5x5 Base with bigger insides. 

On top of our highest &9Rotor&r we'll place the &9Rotational Complex&r. Trust me it is important!
quest.42746659C66CF17F.quest_desc:
The &6&oLibrary of Alexandria&r is a better &5Enchantment Library&r. 

It can hold higher Levels of &5Enchanted Books&r, but it will still need the Level of &5Book&r to get taken out at that Level. 

It will also hold more Points. The &5Enchantment Library&r can hold 32768, while the &6&oLibrary of Alexandria&r can hold 1.1 Billion Points of each &5Book&r! 

To obtain it, we'll need to &d&lInfuse&r the &5Enchantment Library&r. 

Use 4 &9Soul-Touched Sculkshelves&f, 4 &9Echoing Sculkshelves&f, 1 &dDraconic Endshelf&f, 5 &6Geode-Encased Bookshelves of Stability&r, and a Skeleton Skull.
quest.4274E777FB60BA28.title: &a&lChargepad
quest.427BBEB1F24E9DEE.quest_desc:
Most of the &5Corrupti Dust&r is easily automated. 

&4Nether Wart&r can be made with any auto-farm. &cBlaze Powder&r and &3Enderpearl Fragments&r can be made from &b&lHNN&r. And &bArcane Crystals&r are shown in another Quest. 

Just &5Obsidiansteel&r will need to be automated from the &b&lRunic Crucible&r.
quest.429785E8F64929CE.quest_desc:
In order to get to the &9&lStarlight Dimension&r you'll need to find &7Portal Ruins&r in the &2&lOverworld&r. 

There you will find a &7&lGatekeeper&r, Right Click to initiate a conversation and challenge them to a duel! Careful, they are very tough. 

The Gatekeeper will also deem you worthy if you have defeated the Ender Dragon, and allow you to skip the duel.

Once you win the duel you'll be gifted a few Items, the &3Orb of Prophecy&r being one. Right Click the &7Portal&r with the &3Orb&r to activate it! Then, walk in to get to the...
quest.429B5A81DF6C43FE.title: &6Odus' Open Convocation

You can make &2Blastproof Alloy&r by combining the three strongest Metals available. &5Tungsten&r, &dTitanium&r, and &7Stainless Steel&r. Yes, stains matter apparently. 

With these you can combine them to make the &2Casing&r. 

For the &3&lImprobable Probablity Device&r we'll need either 2 &2Blastproof Casings&r, or 2 256M Portable Item Cells, or we can use a mix of both!
quest.42CB494F72FA1FD1.quest_desc: Craft 6 &eBeehives&r or &eBeenests&r. This includes &l&6Productive Bee's&r &eHives&r as well!
quest.42D7C8CD8E6F5CD7.quest_desc: By using a Rune of Stupor on a Spawner you suck the souls out the mobs that will be spawned, only leaving a hollow husk of what they used to be. The mobs will lose all AI so they will do basically what an armor stand does. They can't hit you, can't teleport, can't move on their own. They sit there ready to be killed, how exciting!
quest.43008E93B34F4F06.title: &9Tide Arrows
quest.4393ADF3E4C8B0D4.quest_subtitle: Any one aspect proves the craft.
quest.4393ADF3E4C8B0D4.title: The Five Aspects

Same tier as Wooden Tools so it can't break Iron or &5Zanite Ore&r. 

But Each &2Skyroot&r doubles Drops. 

&2Skyroot Pickaxe&r doubles Ores, &2Shovel&r doubles Dirt, and &2Hoe&r doubles Plant Drops.
quest.4394AEF0823FB4D2.title: &2Skyroot&r Tools

quest.4415C9F8DA2D7E68.quest_desc:
With Cyanite, we can create the heart of the Turbine, the &9Turbine Controller&r.

Turbines are multi-block structures, just like Reactors! They input vapors like &7Steam&r made by &dActively Cooled&r Reactors to create TONS of power! We'll need a few other pieces to be able to build our first one.

Note: Basic Turbine parts can only be used to build a max size Turbine of 5x5x10. To build a bigger Turbine, you must use &aReinforced Turbine Parts&r.
quest.441C0659ED28D935.quest_desc: Tier 1 Glyphs require 3 levels of experience to be made.

quest.44881E39AB1D62AA.quest_desc: The &3Autocrafter&r is how we store Patterns for our network to know how to craft items. Once a recipe is placed into the machine, you'll be able to 'Request' an item to be crafted from your &3Grid&r. You can do this by pressing Control + Shift whilst clicking on the item you have a recipe for to bring up the crafting interface.\n\nThis block can also be placed facing a machine to use &6Processing Patterns&r. For example, if you point the &3Autocrafter&r at a Furnace, you can put a recipe inside for a recipe you need a Furnace for, like smelting Raw Processors. As long as the &3Autocrafter&r is attached to your system and the Furnace has an Importer attached to it, the Crafter will allow you to request the smelted version of the Processor!
quest.44881E39AB1D62AA.title: &3Autocrafter
quest.44D5EDB8711EC7A0.title: &6Allthemodium Mace

quest.45084D3A3E5DB63B.quest_desc:
Trolls can Drop a dozen different Items! These are mostly determined by their Biome. 

But all Trolls will Drop Tusks, their Leather, and their Weapons they hold. 

The Tusks and Leather are both used for Troll Leather Armor.
quest.45084D3A3E5DB63B.title: &8Troll Leather &fand &8Tusks
quest.450EDE68EC992A5A.quest_desc: Interfaces &cread&r whatever they're looking at. You can think of this like an &bAE2&r Storage Bus.\n\nYou don't know what that is? Well here's an example: A chest with 100 Cobblestone in it has an interface on it, this means your ID network has 100 Cobblestone in it's system, pretty simple, right?

quest.4597D3B3BDC2BED5.quest_desc:
The &bMolecular Assembler&f is AE2's equivalent of an automatic crafting table, required to fulfil any and all &ecrafting&f pattern jobs.

Molecular Assemblers are capable of transferring power and channels to other ME devices connected to it, but will not themselves take up a channel. Up to 6 MAs can be connected to a single Pattern Provider (if employed) to allow for more crafts to be done in parallel.

MAs also each have their own dedicated slot for a single crafting pattern, allowing them to function standalone when powered. When operated in this way, any matching items inserted into the MA will be automatically crafted into the result of the pattern.
quest.459BA85E48B343AE.quest_desc:
&aRadial Chasis&r work similar to &aLinear Chasis&r in connecting to other &aRadial Chasis&r but everything else changes. 

You can connect other &aRadial Chasis&r on the top or bottom of other ones and they will automatically connect. 

Then, &aGlue&r the sides of the &aRadial Chasis&r to &aGlue&r every Block within a set Radius of the &aChasis&r. BTW Radius means circle! 

You can change how far the circle goes with a &6Wrench&r to the &aRadial Chasis&r.

&0Tamed Cockatrice&r will not Hurt you when you look in their &0Eyes&r, actually they'll defend you!

quest.486B5A605D79EA10.quest_desc:
The &cManhattan &aModule&r is a complicated Recipe. It needs &cTNT&r, &dPlutonium Pellets&r, and &5Heisenberg Compensators&r. Okay maybe 2/3 of it is complicated. 

To make &dPlutonium Pellets&r, start by Energizing &5Amethyst Shards&r. This will make &5Fluxite&r, which can be used with &aUranium Dust&r in a &l&5Particle Accelerator&r to make &dPlutonium Dust&r. 

&dPlutonium Dust&r can be Crafted with Plastic Sheets and an Ingot to make our &dPellets&r. 

The &5Heisenberg Compensator&r has 2 Recipes we can use. Each will need the &c&lAtomic Forge&r to &cEngrave&r them with &bAdamant Ingots&r. 

1. Is with &bUnholy Intelligence&r. Which is created by filling a &2Dubious Container&r with &5Strange Matter&r. &5Strange Matter&r is found by putting &cLava&r and an &3Enderic Compound&r through a &d&lFluid Refinery&r with 2 Extra Chambers attached to it. 

2. Is with the &eSuper AI Chip&r. AI in &2&lMinecraft&r? Yes, and it requires a Recipe Tree of &cEngraving&r, with the &c&lAtomic Forge&r, in order to Craft. Lots of &8Silicon&r for sure.
quest.487C70679535DDDB.quest_desc:
Don't you hate those stupid limitations on your Quantum Catcher? Can't put Wardens in your friends base! 

Well now there is no worries for we can upgrade our Quantum Catcher with 3 &2Stellarite Pieces&r and a Nether Star to make the Boss Catcher. 

Now we can transport our Bosses wherever we want!
quest.48C68664319B0294.quest_desc: To obtain this special Spell Book you'll need to slay the &4&lDead King&r! \n\nIt has 10 &3Spell&r Slots but 4 are taken up already. &4Blood Slash&r, &4Blood Step&r, &4Ray of Siphoning&r, and &4Blaze Storm&r come on it already and can't be taken off.

quest.4974F265003DAEC9.title: &eValkyrie Tools
quest.4985F82E0D300C6D.quest_desc:

With 4 Depthrock, 4 &7Cloggrum Ingots&r, and a &aForgotten Nugget&r you can Craft the Crumbling Catalyst. 

The Crumbling Catalyst works just like the normal Catalyst in activating a Portal.
quest.499CF9F39CED8899.quest_desc:
&bIntegrated Dynamics&r (ID) is a logistics mod that can be used for storage, item/power/fluid transfer and more!

Menril trees can be found in Meneglin biomes.

These quests will cover some of the basic concepts of the mod, read the guidebook given as a reward for this quest if you want to go further in depth.
quest.499CF9F39CED8899.title: &bIntegrated Dynamics
quest.49D1EA8E812A12F6.quest_desc:
It's just a neat plant. 

You'll need a Sickle to collect it! 

I don't know why, I've never cared about plants, but Reeds are cool to me. Maybe it's the being by &9Water&r, or Cattails looking like Corndogs. I don't know but I like them.
quest.49EE6D2A3684A510.title: &bIce Bow

We can use either or both &2Blastproof Casing&r or 256M Portable Item Cells to Craft the &3&lImprobable Probability Device&r. 

Wait did I say either or both? 

Yes I did! We can use 2 &2Blastproof Casings&r or 2 256M Portable Item Cells or one of each.
quest.49FDD8666356A3E7.title: Either or &2Blastproof Casings&f and 256M Portable Item Cells
quest.4A03A671757B2EBF.quest_desc:
Durability, Fluid Level, Energy Level, Enchantment Level, and Food Value are all categories we can use with Inspection Filter.

Then we select if we want it Greater than, Lesser than, Equal to, or a mix of those with the Numbered Amount.

Next we give it a Numbered Amount and hit the Plus Button to add it to the Filter.

This can be used to only keep Tools with high Durability or Food with high Food Value.
quest.4A06CCE1FE0F333C.quest_desc: The &#74C3DBAir Intake&r when put in a &#46CAF2Vacuum Freezer&r will yield you &#B5E7F7Liquid Air&r.

quest.4A198E875A6B0A64.quest_desc: The &bUltra Autocrafter&r has 36 Pattern slots, works 5x faster, and has a &eStack Upgrade&r integrated.
quest.4A198E875A6B0A64.title: &bUltra Autocrafter
quest.4A54288FD22C903D.title: &2Velvetumoss &fand &4Red &fversion
quest.4A564E8FE587C7E4.quest_desc:
The best way of getting Souls is via the Soul Extractor! 

For a few Nether Items and Blocks and an Utrem Jar (which does need Edelwood to craft) you can get your tool to Soul-Finding! 

Hold Right Click with it on Soul Sand and it'll extract the Souls from it. 

Leaving it as Sand... no wait it is Soulless Sand... what the heck is Soulless Sand?!?!?!
quest.4A5937F6E5D06BE1.quest_desc: A simple liquid fuel generator that runs off the liquid fuels added by JDT.
quest.4A5EA948F5DCEB73.quest_desc: &7Deepsilver&r used to be called Swamp Silver and only Spawned in &9Dark Swamps&r. \n\nNow it is found everywhere underground... that is probably why they changed the name!
quest.4A5EA948F5DCEB73.title: &7Deepsilver
quest.4A6B585C2394A89A.quest_desc:
The two Items we need via &5&lRunic Enchanter&r is &dInfused Dragon's Breath&r and &5Mending Books&r. 

&dInfused Dragon's Breath&r is pretty simple, just &aFluid XP&r, &dSource&r, and &dDragon's Breath&r! 

&dDragon's Breath&r can be farmed pretty easily with &b&lHNN&r or even better, an Extractor from &l&9X&cy&aC&8r&aa&cf&9t&r. 

&5Mending Books&r can be automated with &aFluid XP&r, &dSource&r, &9Lapis Lazuli&r, &4Supremium Enchanting Base&r, and the hardest part the &aExperience Rod&r. 

&9Lapis&r can be from &2&lMA&r, &6&lBees&r, or even just Quarries. 

&aExperience Rod&r will need two alloys from &a&lEnderIO&r: Soularium and Energetic Alloy. Both can be made from Alloy Smelter. As well as Suspicious Seeds. These are obtained by setting Bedrock on Fire. You can Automate this with Item Clickers from &3&lJDT&r with Flint and Steel and something to Pick them up. 

The &4Supremium Enchanting Base&r is a new Item made for the &5&lRunic Enchanter&r, you'll need to use tons of &aEXP Essence&r and Tiered Essences to get from a Book and Quill (which can be automated via &b&lHNN&r) to the &4Supremium Enchanting Base&r! 

There are other ways of farming &5Mending Books&r instead of using the &5&lRunic Enchanter&r. You can use &6&lCreate's&r &6Printer&r to combine &aExperience&r and a Book with another &5Mending Book&r to Print more. There's also &a&lMystical Agriculture's&r Enchanter which can transform 3 &0Wither Skeleton Skulls&r and 256 &aExperience Essence&r into a &5Mending Book&r.
quest.4ABACE222E647E2C.quest_desc: The Sacrificial Altar is another tool Ars Ocultas offers, this time, focusing on the automation of Sacrifices.\n\nThis Altar goes under your central bowl, and will allow for Sacrifices to be substituted with Source from a nearby Source Jar, if a Containment Jar containing the would-be sacrifice is also nearby.
quest.4AE0C2D2D8D145F6.quest_desc: The standard key opens the Endless Realm's common doors, but there's a &cMine Key&r cut specifically for the entrance guarded deep within — the one the Foreman doesn't let go of easily.
quest.4AE0C2D2D8D145F6.title: Deeper Locks
quest.4AE8D8826F894EC7.quest_desc:
&l&5Domun Ornamentum&r is sort of like &l&6Framed Blocks&r and &l&bChipped&r put together! 

Using the Architects Cutter we can make tons of different Shapes and Variations of Blocks. 

When making a Block first choose which Group: Doors, Lights, ETC. 
Then, choose a Variant. 
After that, we need to add our Blocks we want it made of! Some Blocks will need two different Blocks of choice while others only take one.
quest.4AED9EF9E0F68483.quest_desc: The &7Holystone Pickaxe&r can Mine &5Zanite&r but not &dGravitite&r. \n\nAll of these Tools will randomly Drop &eAmbrosium Shards&r when Breaking Blocks.
quest.4AED9EF9E0F68483.title: &7Holystone&r Tools
quest.4AFDC9ACAC926654.title: &0Rotten Egg
quest.4B097031A3EE930B.title: &bGlacite Hoe
quest.4B12425E74C5E511.quest_desc: The &cExplosive Mycelial Generator&r does an amazing job at soaking up Explosions. \n\nWe could use that for a &d&lPulsating &8Black Hole&r!
quest.4B12425E74C5E511.title: &cExplosive Mycelial Generator
quest.4B13835110F1FE82.title: &7Deepsilver Sickle
quest.4B2146C9527C54E7.title: &6&lAllthemodium
quest.4B3F20E5C7E3BCFB.quest_desc: Primal Coal is a new material added by JDT. Primal Coal is acquired by performing Goo Spread on Coal Blocks using tier one goo or higher. Primal Coal Ore is affected by fortune.
quest.4B62AF0405F68041.quest_desc: Adds a filter that allows you to tell the Backpack which items it should keep stocked. Shift right-clicking an inventory will refill it.
quest.4B76FE0348DB0E45.quest_desc: The Quantum Bridge Card is an alternate method to get wireless interdimensional access to your Applied Energistics system. You will need a Quantum Bridge connected at your base and a Quantum Bridge Card in your terminal. These tunnels are then bound together with a Quantum Entangled Singularity to gain access wherever you go.
quest.4B7840F1A8CF1378.quest_desc: Fusion Crafting is how most (atleast the fun items) will be made. To get started you need a Fusion Crafting Core, place it down about a block above the ground. The Core is where recipes can be autoplaced in from JEI, where the middle item goes, and where the end item will be put. It will need the Injectors put a few blocks away from it looking toward the Core on two sides of it. Check next Quest to find more on those. The Injectors will also need Energy which will be explained more in the Crystal Binding Quest.
quest.4B7D387CEFF9667E.quest_desc:
Finally! &6&lCreate&r has been updated and it is definitely worth the wait! 

&6&lCreate&r is all about rotating and using Rotational Power... well for practically everything! Crafting, crushing, mixing, brewing, ETC. 

If it has been so long that you don't remember how to use &6&lCreate&r, you can use &7&lModern Industrialization&r to Craft the &6&lATM Star&r.
quest.4B9E9497E44D0096.quest_desc:
To build a reactor, you'll need to start by making &6Reactor Casings&r.

These make up the frame and walls of your reactor, although the walls can be replaced by &9Reactor Glass&r if you'd like to see inside of your reactor.

For future reference, when a part says "Basic", this means that it can only be used with other basic parts. The Basic parts can also only be used to build smaller reactors, as it has a certain size limit. Keep this in mind!
quest.4B9FF9E972B0E530.quest_desc: The better the Energy Link or Tunnel obviously the more OP it can transfer, but also you might have noticed something missing with the Energy Link. It doesn't work between Dimensions! Thankfully the better ones can, just make sure the other side is chunkloaded.
quest.4B9FF9E972B0E530.title: Quantum Energy Tunnel
quest.4BD203AD481DDE8F.quest_desc:
The &4Meat Shredder&r is made from &4Witherite&r, which is a Drop from &4&lThe Harbringer&r. 

You'll need to find the &4Ancient Factory&r which lies deep underground in the &2&lOverworld&r. 

Then you'll find the powered down &4&lHarbringer&r, to power it up we'll need to feed it a Nether Star! 

Then, after a very difficult and long boss fight, you can Craft the &4Meat Shredder&r!
quest.4BD203AD481DDE8F.title: &4Meat Shredder
quest.4BE209D5DAF1F321.title: &bAureal
quest.4BF7F82F1C8680B9.title: &7Bronze Dungeon
quest.4C0EAB9F795686D0.title: &eAdvanced Deposit Upgrade
quest.4C23D7E3DC8327C2.quest_desc:
In order to kill the &9&lLunar Monstrosity&r you'll need to set it on Fire! 

You can use Flint and Steel or a &eSaltpeter Matchbox&r. 

Personally I think the &eMatchbox&r is more fitting!
quest.4C3B7BAEA653587B.quest_desc: These can be found in chests inside Desert Pyramids.
quest.4C72D2BB6785CC78.title: &cStarfire Shovel
quest.4C77ABCD41383F32.quest_desc:
&cBlaze Cakes&r can be used to &bSuper-Heat&r &cBlaze Burners&r! A Heat that has never been seen before! 

But how do we Bake them? 

First, we'll need to make the &4Blaze Cake Base&r. To get it, process an Egg, Sugar, and &4Cinder Flour&r in a Mechanical Press and Basin. 

&4Cinder Flour&r is created by Crushing &4Netherrack&r through two Crushing Wheels. 

Then, once we have our &4Blaze Cake Base&r, we can fill it with &cLava&r from a &bSpout&r to make our &cBlaze Cake&r!
quest.4CB488E5CF10F3A4.quest_desc: Only the most powerful and expensive Generator from &c&lGenerator Galore&r. \n\nYou'll need an &9Echo Shard&r, a &bConduit&r, and a ton of Netherstar Generators!
quest.4CD2ADD3601B8191.quest_desc: Want your Shield to come back and not just when you almost die? Then, you'll need Recovery Modules. The more Modules the faster it recovers.
quest.4CFE097D0A8683C8.quest_desc:
The &5Obsidian Skull&r is a Helmet that when worn can protect you from Fire/Lava damage! 

Overtime it will wear down to which you'll need to repair it with &5Obsidiansteel&r. 

That is also how you craft it, a Skeleton Skull with 8 &5Obsidiansteel&r.
quest.4D0B50731FED3CEE.quest_desc: To get the Cresant Spear you will need to either craft it from Items dropped by the Lunar Monstrosity and the Tangled Hatred, or have it dropped from the Lunar Monstrosity. (You'll have to kill him regardless basically). \n\nYou can use the Spear like a Trident and just smack Mobs or you can hold Right Click to be sent flying forward with it. If you hit any Mobs with the second attack, any Mobs nearby will also take damage.
quest.4D0B50731FED3CEE.title: &bCrescent &5Spear
quest.4D4152032F0410D2.quest_desc: The Logic Programmer lets you set the value of variables. This can be set to to items and fluids for filtering, or even values. \n\nLet me give you a simple example: Select &bItem&r from the left side, place an item of choice into the center slot of the GUI that pops up, and place a &bVariable Card&r in the bottom right slot. If you then put that variable card in an importer/exporter, it will only import/export that block!
quest.4D53D9BBD8279282.title: &3Lunar Trees
quest.4D7D4C718837BCA5.quest_desc:
The main part of the recipe for the Miniature Nether Portal is the &3Hellshelf of Masterful Sight&r. Usually it is used to see what Enchantments you'll get but we're here for the &6&lATM Star&r not for Enchantments. 

You'll only need to enchant to an &4Infused Hellshelf&r which you can get from just a few Shelves. Then you need to craft with it to upgrade it even more! 

After that you can craft the Miniature Nether Portal, which no you can't walk through you're too big!
quest.4D822D92492E1F53.quest_desc:
The &3Aptrgangr&r is the mini boss within the &3Frosted Prison&r. 

They have 480 &4Hearts&r and will attack you with their giant Axe. 

They can swing their Axe like normal, or they might smash it on the ground near you. When they do that, lasers will spawn damaging all in their path. They also have a charge attack similar to the &eKobolediator&r!
