On death they will drop Black Steel Ingots and Nuggets, and Rotten Flesh and Bones.
quest.4DA0725E089D7C91.quest_desc: Find the &cQ&6u&ee&2s&3t&9i&5n&cg &6R&ea&2m&r, for it bestows wealth to those who give it &cR&6a&ei&2n&3b&9o&5w &6W&eo&2o&3l&r (16 colors).\n\nHint: There's a Dispenser above your head in the ruins where the Ram is. It might prove useful.
quest.4DA0725E089D7C91.title: &cR&6a&em&2i&3f&9i&5c&ca&6t&ei&2o&3n
quest.4E014B495668A601.quest_desc: Now that we have our &aExperience Holder&r collecting &aXP&r, we can just pipe the &aXP Fluid&r into our &c&lAuto Forge&r!
quest.4E27182763DA83DC.quest_desc: Upgraded version of the Wyvern Chestplate.
quest.4E27182763DA83DC.title: Draconic Chestplate
quest.4E28B67554CBDAB7.quest_desc: Second in damage of all Swords. The first in damage does Infinite, and there's no competing with Infinite.
quest.4E28B67554CBDAB7.title: &6Allthemodium &5Alloy &3Sword
quest.4E3355FDCB65BB63.quest_desc:
&aEvokers&r are known as being a powerful and deadly Miniboss of Minecraft. So of course &lIron&r added an even more powerful and deadly version! And yes this &eBook&r is a rare drop from both! 

It has 10 Spell Slots but 3 are occupied. &aFang Strike&r, &aFang Ward&r, and &aVex Swarm&r all come with the &eBook&r and can not be moved. 

Also gives a boost to &a&lEvocation&r!
quest.4E3355FDCB65BB63.title: &aGrimore of Evokation
quest.4E847B0288265DA3.quest_desc:
&dCockatrice&r look like &9Moas&r just with Glowing Eyes and Feathers. 

These feathered foes Spawn in the Dark only. 

They'll spit at you, when it Hits it'll give you the &5Inebreviation Effect&r. Look at the &5Aechor Plant&r for a better description of that Effect. 

&dCockatrice&r have 10 &4Health&r and Drop Feathers when slain.
quest.4E847B0288265DA3.title: &dCockatrice
quest.4E8C32CD6057A1AB.quest_desc:
To make the &c&lPhilospher's Fuel&r we get a choice of whether we want to use &cBlaze Burners&r or &aUranium Quad Fuel Rods&r. 

Whichever you find easier to Craft! 

(AKA the &cBlaze Burner&r!)
quest.4E8C32CD6057A1AB.title: &cBlaze Burner&f or &aUranium Quad Fuel Rods
quest.4EA2DB12E8F0068F.quest_desc: &l&aOh The Biomes We've Gone&r is a continuation of &l&aOh The Biomes You'll Go&r which is a pun off the Dr. Seuss book "Oh the Places You'll Go".\n\nIt adds tons of gorgeous new biomes! With new plants, rocks, and of course trees!
quest.4EAFE7B240AF0A4D.quest_desc: Just can't reach what you need to? Try Ranging Up! \n\nWith this everything will do their actions but farther. Vacuum has higher range for picking up items. Energy goes farther. Flinger flings with more strength!
quest.4EBC5B191A7B12D9.title: Blank Runes
quest.4ED01E04D55999D9.quest_subtitle: Pour Molten Uru over a BeeBee Spawn Egg
quest.4ED36AA3766E842B.quest_desc:
Instead of building the smallest Turbine at this point, it's better to build a Turbine based off of the design of your &9Reactor&r.

For starters, you want to build a Turbine that can handle the &9Vapor Production Rate&r of your reactor. To get the most power out of it, it'll need to maintain either 900RPM or 1800RPM as well. This takes a lot of experimenting with different coils, # of blades, and overall size of the Turbine!

Note: To complete this quest, you'll need to create a &dTask Screen&r of any size. Once placed, you can right-click the screen and select this quest as the requirement, then output power into the task screen block to fill it up and complete the quest.
quest.4EE10B8E194F5CA9.quest_desc:
&6&lCreate&r 1.21 also now comes with Trains included with the base Mod. 

First, you'll need &5Sturdy Metal&r! 

Crush &5Obsidian&r to get &5Obsidian Dust&r. Then, use a &bSpout&r to place &cLava&r into the &5Crushed Obsidian&r. 

After that, Press it twice with &6Mechanical Presses&r and you'll get &5Sturdy Metal&r. 

&5Sturdy Metal&r can then be applied to a &eBrass Casing&r to make &5Train Casings&r.
quest.4EE580588CC10C4E.quest_desc: We dig out the veins the Foreman used to guard. &cDemonite&r is the only real source of Hellforged metal, the material that carries the altar's final tiers.
quest.4EE580588CC10C4E.title: Demonite
quest.4EE6824A970EEB35.quest_desc:
Spawner Runes are used to craft various Spawner-modifying items. Infused Spawner Runes are required for the more powerful modifications.

We'll need at least &a70 Eterna&r, &c30% Quanta&r, and &550% Arcana&r. 

To get that, we can use either of the following:

14 &9Deepshelves&r, that aren't &9Dormant&r!
13 &4Glowing Hellshelves&r and 2 &9Deepshelves&r!
12 &bCrystalline Seashelves&r and 2 &9Deepshelves&r!
quest.4EE6824A970EEB35.title: &d&lInfusing&r Spawner Runes
quest.4EFFE300EC781C3E.quest_desc: Modules are very important to our DE items. So important they don't work without them! Most Modules are made from a Module Core or a previous Module. Hold an item and press Shift and C to open the Module Menu. There you'll see some slots and buttons! The Slots are where Modules will actually go and the Grid is what determines how many Modules can go. When a Module says 1x1 it'll only take 1 Slot, while one that says 2z2 will take uo 4 slots. The lowest button on the right will show what Modules can be applied to the Item you are holding. The rest just change the look of GUI.
quest.4F03B152479C4AC0.quest_desc: The &bStaff of Riches&r uses aura to highlight all storage containers in a 64 block raidius for about 1 minute.\n\nThis can be very useful if you're looking for loot chests or if you put a chest in a mine somewhere.
quest.4F2DB9CDE2BACB69.quest_desc:
This Quest has been authored by &6AllTheMods Staff&r, or a &2Community contributor&r for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all &6AllTheMods&r packs are licensed under &eAll Rights Reserved&r, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by &6AllTheMods Team&r without explicit permission. 

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.
quest.4F6A9F1AEFD535F5.title: Draconic Large Shield Capacity Module
quest.4F77EDCEB49EB67F.quest_desc: With luck, we pull Intricate &cHellforged Parts&r from deep in the dungeon. Paired with Netherite Scrap, upgrading any rune with one doubles the value it already gave our altar.
quest.4F77EDCEB49EB67F.title: Doubling Down on Runes
quest.4F7F0A5162D70082.quest_desc:
Don't be confused there is a full and empty &5Creative &aEnergy Cube&r. 

&aEmpty Cubes&r work as an Energy Trash Can, voiding any Energy coming into it. 

&aFull Cubes&r work as an infinite energy storage. You'll need &aempty Energy Cubes&r to make it though... and those are expensive! 

Energizing 4 &aempty Energy Cubes&r with an &6&lATM Star&r you can get the full one.
quest.4F7F0A5162D70082.title: &5&lCreative &aEnergy Cube
quest.4F7F8F4ED1CA0550.quest_desc: A Rune of Immolation used on the spawner will have the mobs spawn on fire. Perfect for a nice Steak.
quest.4F870252E9FB1A41.quest_desc: Reactor can be fueled by Fuel Rods, these are the most basic ones you can craft.
quest.4F89C04CEBF812F9.title: Ingots
quest.4F9D6109EEA5D26A.quest_desc: Breaking &eGolden Leaves&r has a high chance to drop a &eGold Leaf&r, which is needed for &eGold Powder&r.
quest.4F9D6109EEA5D26A.title: &eGold Leaves
quest.4FA7774D89171BB3.quest_desc:
Want another pet from &4&lCataclysm&r? Then the Remnant Skull is what you need! 

It's a confirmed drop from the &eAncient Remnant&r and when used will spawn a Modern Revenant. 

This one is much smaller and nicer than the &eAncient&r one. You can tame it by feeding it a Sniffer Egg then it will act like a dog. 

Attacking what attacks you or what you attack. It also has 3 modes: follow, wander, and stay. Follow it will... well follow you. Wander will have it walking around a certain area. And stay will have it lay down in one spot. 

They have 1500 &4Hearts&r and I've learned you can feed them &eKoboleton Bones&r to heal them! 

Enjoy your new dino!
quest.4FCC20D9F8F87B2F.quest_desc: The &3Pneumatic Wrench&r is used to move around or break your machines and tubes.
quest.5003365C2A7B4B53.title: &cStarfire Sword
quest.501A0AEEC73C0790.quest_desc:
&6Piglich&r is a Boss added by &6&lAllthemodium&r which lives in the Ancient Pyramid in &l&bThe Other&r. 

On death he'll drop 1 of his Hearts! You'll need 9 of them dead to make a Block of it... 

Thankfully there are ways to farm them!
quest.501C6B7580453410.quest_desc: The &aFluidizer&r is a customizable multiblock that has a minimum size of 3x3x3. Just like the other multiblocks, the frame will need to be made out of Casings, while the faces can be made out of Glass.
quest.501C6B7580453410.title: Fluidizer Construction
quest.5021D159A5EC2315.title: Draconic Energy Module
quest.50326B1D6EE8FA0B.quest_desc:
&cAccumulators&r are &8&lIE&r's version of batteries. 

They hold &cEnergy&r with &6LV&r holding 100kFE, &eMV&r holds 1MFE, and &5HV&r holds 4MFE! 

By default they have a top slot which only allows &9Input&r, but any side can be changed with the &6Engineer's Hammer&r to &9Input&r, &6Output&r, or Neither.
quest.5034A9137E0F3D3D.quest_desc:
This Quest has been authored by &6AllTheMods Staff&r, or a &2Community contributor&r for use in AllTheMods Modpacks.

As all &6AllTheMods&r packs are licensed under &eAll Rights Reserved&r, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by &6AllTheMods Team&r without explicit permission.

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.
quest.503AC506720FC59E.quest_desc:
For more advanced modifications to Spawners, you'll need to &d&lInfuse&r your Spawner Runes.

\We'll need at least &a70 Eterna&r, &c30% Quanta&r, and &550% Arcana&r in an &5Enchanting Table&r. 

To get that, we can use either of the following:

14 &9Deepshelves&r, that aren't &9Dormant&r!
13 &4Glowing Hellshelves&r and 2 &9Deepshelves&r!
12 &bCrystalline Seashelves&r and 2 &9Deepshelves&r!

Check out the &5&lApothic Enchanting&r chapter to learn more about these mechanics.
quest.5040B3D29F238BC0.title: &dBunny Hoppers&r
quest.50EC8F8CD04D9598.title: &5Rage of Stars
quest.50F23B2688D7E699.quest_desc:
With 1,000mB of &dAntimatter&r processed through a &5&lChemical Crystallizer&r we can make 1 &dAntimatter Pellet&r. 

That means it takes 1,000,000mB &aPolonium&r or 1MmB &aPolonium&r. 

For all that &aPolonium&r you'll need 5,000,000mB &8Nuclear Waste&r and &2Fissile Fuel&r to make the &8Nuclear Waste&r. Only 5MmB &2Fissile Fuel&r... only! 

But finally, we have it! The most valued &eItem&r in all of &5&lMekanism&r! The &dAntimatter Pellet&r. 

We can now make our MekaSuit, more storage for the &e&lQIO&r, and even the &6&lATM Star&r!
quest.511144EF336BFAF5.title: Smog Spires
quest.511562EA5811306B.title: Diamond Fishing Rod
quest.51236544BFEF487B.quest_desc:
It is time to find &eMeteorites&r that contain &bSky Stone&r. They are found buried underground, typically near the surface, and contain a &bMysterious Cube&f in its center.

This cube contains all of the different &ePresses&r used in the Inscriber to make AE2's special crafting components.

The easiest way to locate a meteorite is by crafting a &eMeteorite Compass&r by placing a compass inside of a Charger.
quest.51538F4DCE24E3E7.title: &l&5Multi&f-&2Piston
quest.516AC1F0E0BCAE55.title: &bFrozen Tubes
quest.5180CDD196518F64.title: &6Strap Iron Tracks
quest.51A57E142C686C8F.quest_desc: The fifth and final MEGA tier of storage component, providing &e268435456&f (262144k) bytes of storage.
quest.51B1AF28328FFBAD.title: &cSpiral Kelp Forest
quest.51B24CC5E9332C1E.quest_desc:
Sometimes when you kill a mob, a &dVengeance Spirit&r will spawn.

Their &dEssence&r seems to be useful in crafting more advanced items within EvilCraft.

Not finding many Spirits? Make a &9Vengeance Ring&r and toggle it on to attract more Spirits during your battles.
quest.51B6D203E28D92BE.quest_desc:
Hate waiting for &5Meteor Showers&r? Why not start one yourself! 

The &5Aetherstrike Rocket&r will act like a normal Firework. Flies into the air, gives a pretty show, just this one also summons a &5Meteor Shower&r. 

Yep, it will start a &5Meteor Shower&r where it was fired from. 

It does have a Cooldown though.
quest.51B6D203E28D92BE.title: &5Aetherstrike Rocket
quest.51E2728C5E35A152.quest_desc:
Froststeel spawns in the Frozen Biomes: Frostfields, Frosty Smogstem Forests, and probably Icy Seas. 

It spawns in Shiverstone which replaces Depthrock in these Biomes. The Shiverstone will act similar to Ice as in it is slippery and slows you down a little. 

You might also find some Nuggets in Munchers bellies!
quest.51E554305FFEBA1D.title: &4Blazing Hellshelf
quest.51EA6B1452883AB2.quest_desc:
Linear Chasis work like Puddy in real life, only connecting to each other. 

Linear Chasis, which are facing the same way, will automatically connect as if they were Glued. Other Linear Chasis or ones facing different ways, will not stick together. 

You can then use Glue on the Top and Bottom of the Linear Chasis to connect a line of Blocks from it. So all Blocks on top of those will be Glued to the Linear Chasis. Very helpful for saving Glue! 

With the Wrench you can set how many Blocks get Glued on the Top or Bottom of the Linear Chasis.
quest.51EA6B1452883AB2.title: &aLinear Chasis
quest.52007C01B52F7295.quest_desc:
&eValkyries&r spawn in the &eSilver Dungeon&r. 

You'll need to beat 10 of them in order to fight the &e&lValkyrie Queen&r. 

They have 50 &4Hearts&r each and are Neutral until you Hit them. Thankfully they'll fight one at a time.
quest.52007C01B52F7295.title: 10 &eVictory Medals
quest.521656D425E2FDBA.quest_desc: Goes even faster than Tier II.
quest.5218DAE147AC9F44.quest_desc:
The Blade Quiver allows you to hold more &8Blades&r or &8Blade like Items&r on the &2&lBuzzsaw&r. 

To switch between the &8Blades&r (or &8Blade like Items&r) Hold Shift and Scroll. 

This is useful for replacing broken &8Blades&r or even switching to &8Grinding Disks&r!
quest.52472667678E10D1.quest_desc:
&2Stellarite&r spawns between Y Level 42 and -44. 

You'd think, with having such a huge radius it'll be easy to find! It isn't, it is very rare! 

Be careful when Mining it though, when broken it will EXPLODE!
quest.52472667678E10D1.title: &2Stellarite Pieces
quest.525517F1625A9BCB.quest_desc:
Did a mob hit the floor too hard and get its &cBlood&r everywhere? Oh no!

You can use a &cSanguinary Pedestal&r to absorb that precious &cBlood&r for later use!

Want to automate collecting blood? Place a &9Spiked Plate&r on top of the Pedestal, then have a mob stand on it.
quest.5282190D0C0C2AA9.quest_desc:
&dStarlit Diamonds&r Spawn far Underground everywhere in the &9&lStarlight&r. 

Around Voidstone is where you'll find it. 
Judging by the Diamond in the name, yeah it is very good for Tools and Weapons.
quest.5282190D0C0C2AA9.title: &dStarlit Diamond
quest.52D3697F1F5625C7.quest_desc: &3Etching Acid&r is made in the Pressure Chamber with Molten Plastic...and some other stuff. Used in the Etching Tank.
quest.52E59FCB39D66BCF.quest_desc: One of the best options for "Passive Power", the &9Thermal Generator&r will produce FE when placed over a &cHeat Source&r and given a steady supply of water.\n\nThere are currently 3 blocks you can place this over: a Magma block which produces the lowest, a lava source block which is a little better, or a &cBlock of Blazing Crystal&r, which provides the most heat.
quest.53149C516E544FE9.quest_desc:
&5Creteors&r and &5Mini Creteors&r can come from &5Meteor Showers&r. 

&5Creteors&r are Neutral, you'll need to Hit them first. They have 8 &4Hearts&r. 

When Hit they will roll at you and start flashing. They will Hit you for a little bit of Damage, but they will also explode! The explosion takes awhile to happen so you get time to run but when they do they will Spawn... 

&5Mini Creteors&r! These guys are much less friendly then their bigger counterparts. 

&5Mini Creteors&r will fly at you and explode. These guys only have 2 and a half &4Hearts&r. 

When Killed (not by exploding) both will Drop &5Aethersent&r and &5Creteor Hide&r.
quest.53149C516E544FE9.quest_subtitle: Mobs from out of space? Aliens?
quest.53149C516E544FE9.title: &5Creteors
quest.5316DF321B45D2CA.quest_desc:
Welcome to &dOccultism&r!

This mod aimes to help the player in many different ways by enlisting the help of &c&mDemons&r &bSpirits&r! Don't worry, most of them are friendly. &oMost&r.

To get started, you'll need to get some &aDemon's Fruit Seeds&r.
quest.535525EA4DF4AB59.quest_desc: The &cPlayer Transmitter&r will supply energy to anyone with the Binded Card. That includes energy to all armor, tools, and items in their inventory. \n\nThe &cNitro Tier&r is needed for the &6&lStar&r, which is of course the last and hardest one to get.
quest.535525EA4DF4AB59.title: &cNitro Player Transmitter
quest.538E28637FF76912.quest_desc:
This Quest has been authored by &6AllTheMods Staff&r, or a &2Community contributor&r for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all &6AllTheMods&r packs are licensed under &eAll Rights Reserved&r, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by &6AllTheMods Team&r without explicit permission. 

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.
quest.53B58FC3958750E7.quest_desc:
Did you play around with the Placer too much and need to Break those Blocks? 

Its Tier and Enchants are determined by the Pickaxe its Crafted with. 

Now set the area and hopefully put a Filter and let it run! 

Can be used with a Placer to do stuff like turning Ores into Items.
quest.53C167AF34694F8F.quest_desc: Mixing together &#40B36AYttrium&r, &#DBA146Annealed Copper&r, &#33CC3ANeodymium&r and &#D6D290Iridium&r Dusts will make &#5EDEE0SuperConductor Dust&r. This can be cooked in a &#E3CE54Kanthal EBF&r to be cooled down in the &#4CBBD9Vacuum Freezer&r.
quest.53DEA3DFEDC4809E.title: &4Tibira's Attraction
quest.540B857F043C24D5.quest_desc: The Bioreactor produces &5Biofuel&r with &9Water&r and a bunch of different materials (check JEI for all valid Bioreactor Inputs). The more types of materials you provide, the more efficient the Bioreactor is at producing &5Biofuel&r.\n\nThe Biofuel Generator uses &5Biofuel&r made from the &5Bioreactor&r to generate FE.
quest.5424A0E1292B13EE.quest_desc:
Around the &9&lStarlight&r you might find Hot Ponds. 

(These aren't a biome or structure so you'll need to just look around to find them!) 

Within them you can find &6Thermal Springstone&r.
quest.5424A0E1292B13EE.title: &6Thermal Springstone
quest.542AD6FD1927C3E6.title: Draconic Undying Module
quest.542C6D76B579886C.quest_desc: Using our Enchanting Apparatus structure, we'll want to craft our first seed, the &5Magebloom Seed&r. \n\nThis will be used to create us some magical clothing!
quest.5436157FDFC9633E.quest_desc: With the Infused &dPatrick &aStar&r, 5 &6Star Fragments&r, &5Corrupti Dust&r, &cMundabitur Dust&r, and the Lens of the &4Killer&r we can rebuild &6&lATM Stars&r, 100% automated! \n\nNow these &5Creative&r Items will be a breeze to craft!
quest.54AB11938676D4C7.title: Alchemy of Ore
quest.54BAF833344F0AAE.quest_desc:
This ones a 2 parter! First, you'll need a &8Dark Tank&r. Simple recipe only needing &8Dark Gems&r, Iron, and Glass. 

Next, you'll need &7Eclipse Ember Fuel&r. That's not so simple... 

To get it you can start, drop an &7Eclipse Ember&r into &3Liquid Voidflame Fuel&r to make it &7Unrefined Eclipse Ember&r. Then, you'll need &9Shadowpulse Goo&r to spread to it to make &7Eclipse Ember Fuel&r. 

By the way you'll need 16 Buckets worth!
quest.54BAF833344F0AAE.title: &8Dark Tank&r full of &7Eclipse Ember Fuel
quest.54DE8AAAE2181F18.quest_desc: The &dMoonring Greatsword&r no longer needs Drops from both Bosses, now it only needs you to Kill the &9&lLunar Monstrosity&r. \n\nIt works like a normal Sword, just before 1.9. It can block attacks like a shield, but it can't be spammed for full damage.
quest.54DE8AAAE2181F18.title: &dMoonring Greatsword
quest.54F0C5C48CFC94D0.quest_desc:
With Logistics we need Filtering. There's two different Filters: List and Attribute. 
List Filter you add Items into it and change whether it's whitelist or blacklist, and whether it respects NBT Data or not. 

Attribute Filter takes a reference Item then Filters off a selected Attribute. This includes tags and other things like whether it can be used as Furnace Fuel or can be pathwayed!
quest.54F7AD64A403C9BF.quest_desc: These Catalysts can be added as pillar toppers to your &2Natural Altar&r. They allow you to turn more items into other items or to break them down.\n\nThe Crumbling Catalyst allows you to turn each Gold Leaf into 4 Gold Powder instead of 2!
quest.55160BAFFD9E2988.quest_desc: The quintessential &9Macaw&r Mod, &9&lMacaw's Furniture&r! \n\nIt adds everything you need! Chairs, Tables, Bookshelves, and even Drawers!
quest.552CA2ABE659A507.title: &cMagmatic Generator
quest.552F0B9B00F4F914.quest_desc:
This Quest has been authored by &6AllTheMods Staff&r, or a &2Community contributor&r for use in AllTheMods Modpacks. 

As all &6AllTheMods&r packs are licensed under &eAll Rights Reserved&r, this Quest is not allowed to be used in any public packs not released by &6AllTheMods Team&r without explicit permission. 

This quest is intentionally hidden, if you're seeing this, you're in editing mode.
quest.553220A2CD7CAFE4.quest_desc: During Christmas all the Chests look like Presents... but the Furnaces just stick out like a sore thumb! Now that can be changed with the Wrapping Paper! You can Right Click it onto any &lIron Furnace&r and it'll be all set for the holiday season! And after the season is over you can Shift Right Click it to unwrap it!
quest.5560F303C452E110.quest_desc: The Extruder pushes blocks and entities by why not push it some more! \n\nThe entities not the blocks.
quest.55702BE0151D33FE.quest_desc:
&aInduction Ports&r are how we'll get our &aEnergy&r in and out of our &a&lEnergized Induction Matrix&r. 

Like in what seems to be every single Multiblock, you'll need to place the &aPorts&r within the Walls of the &a&lInduction Matrix&r. 

I don't believe the &aPorts&r have limits besides what the &a&lInduction Matrix&r has, so you won't need more than 2 unless you're taking from different sources!
quest.5577F49A93ADB19C.quest_desc:
&lProductive Trees&r is a sister Mod to &lProductive Bees&r.

In order to get the different Trees you will need Pollinated Leaves. To get Pollinated Leaves you need Pollen. For Pollen you need Bees.

Bees flowering near the Trees will automatically Pollinate Leaves, or you can use a Pollen Sieve Upgrade in the Hive to get and use Pollen yourself! Have one on the house!
quest.55820773BDD5319D.quest_desc: &bIndustrial Foregoing&r (IF for short) is a tech mod that adds many machines with various different uses.\n\nTo get started, craft a &aPity Machine Frame&r.
quest.55BF254B1831359B.quest_desc:
&5Galadorian Drills&r are the greatest Drills we can attach to our Carts. 

Because of its greatness, that also means crafting it will be more difficult... 
Let's just say you'll need a lot of &3Stabilized Metal&r! Follow the recipes!
quest.55BF254B1831359B.title: &5Galadorian Drills
quest.55D7CD0FA8F1AE48.quest_desc:
The reason we're all here, &5Trains&r. The mod is called &l&7RailCraft&r don't act surprised. 

There's 2 different main &5Trains&r and 1 special mining &5Train&r. 

These &5Trains&r all by themselves can get a little boring, so why not attach &7Carts&r to them! Connecting &7Carts&r with &7Carts&r and with &5Trains&r is called Coupling, and to unconnect them is to Decouple. To Couple &5Trains&r and &7Carts&r use a &4Crowbar&r or a &6Track&r with the Coupling &cTrack Kit&r.
quest.55DCA040C84DCEF3.quest_desc: If you want to get your hands on the product the &aFluidizer&r makes, you'll need an &aOutput Port&r on one of the faces.\n\nThe &aFluidizer&r will need power to operate, so a &cPower Port&r is required to complete the structure.
quest.55DFC96B4CDBFA7D.quest_desc: The Quantum Computer Core is the heart of the Quantum Computer. It has 256M crafting storage and 12 co-processing threads by itself. It is also the only block capable of forming a Quantum Computer by itself, when powered through the Up or Down sides, where the connectors are. However, if used to create a multiblock, a much more powerful computer can be created.
quest.55E321EFBE8956DE.quest_desc: If you want to be cheap with Fermenting Recipes then Fermentation Starter is perfect for you. \n\nVery cheap replacement for other Items in Fermenting.
quest.5608C74936CA9E81.quest_desc:
The &6Mechanical Arm&r is a very confusing but also very helpful Machine from &6&lCreate&r. Thank God, I don't need to explain how to use them, only how to Craft them! 

First, and simplest is the &8Andesite Alloy&r. That is just 2 &8Andesite Blocks&r and 2 &7Zinc/Iron Nuggets&r. 

Next, is the &eBrass Plates &fand &eCasing&r. Both obviously require &eBrass&r which is an Alloy made of &6Copper&r and &7Zinc&r! 

Last, is definitely the most difficult of these, the &ePrecision Mechanism&r. You'll need a whole set up of &6Deployers &fand &eBelts&r to keep moving our &eGold Plate&r to add more Items to it. 

1st step: is using the &6Deployer&r to add a &dCogwheel&r to our &eGold Plate&r. 2nd: is using similar to add a &dLarge Cogwheel&r to it. 3rd step: has us adding an &7Iron Nugget&r with the &6Deployer&r. 

We'll need to repeat this 5 times to hopefully get our &ePrecision Mechanism&r! Yep, there is an 20% you won't get the Item in the end! 

Hey, if you don't like all this work, you can always Craft the &6Large Advanced Motor&r.
quest.5608C74936CA9E81.title: &6Mechanical Arm
quest.561B5FB009744D2B.quest_desc:
To get &aInsanite Blocks&r you'll need 8 &aInsanite Ingots&r and 1 &cBlock of Inanite&r. Yes, I know it's confusing with only a single letter difference. 

To get &aInsanite Ingots&r you'll need to reprocess &bBenitoite&r with &4Rossinite&r in a Reprocessor. 

&bBenitoite&r needs to be Mined in &c&lThe Nether&r. 

&cInanite Blocks&r are made by combining 8 &cInanite Ingots&r with a &cBlock of Netherite&r! &cInanite&r not &aInsanite&r. 

To get Inanite Ingots you will need to reprocess &dRidiculite&r with &4Rossinite&r in a Reprocessor. 

&dRidiculite&r is another chain of recipes that quite frankly I'm tired of looking at!
quest.562B280928897E0D.title: &dStarlit Diamond Boots
quest.562BD37539EE318E.title: Tier: &cBlazing
quest.564AD8763F753C74.title: Bottled Effects
quest.564F0343B1704CE8.title: &cStarfire Crossbow
quest.5660E81BBEED6DC3.quest_desc:
The &dSoul Binding Crystal&r is the most difficult one to craft. 
&3Ender Pearl Fragments&r can be crafted from &3Ender Pearls&r which can be farmed from &5Endermen&r. You can use an Extractor to get infinite &5Amethyst&r. Quartz can be farmed from &2&lMA&r. 

Now we need to focus on the Souls. To start we need normal Souls! Which we usually use a Soul Extractor on Soul Sand to take the Soul out of it. 

But that's from using an Item, and it changes the Soul Sand... First, we can replace ourselves by using a Clicker from &3&lJust Dire Things&r! 

Now we just need to replace the Souless Sand with Soul Sand, which can be used with Block Breakers and Placers, also from &3&lJust Dire Things&r. 

Now we can combine Souls with &5Corrupti Dust&r and Trapped Souls (farmed Items from &5Lunar Guardian&r) to get Corrupt Souls. 

Finally, combine Souls with Liquid Aureal and the Holy Hand Grenade to make Enchanted Souls. The Holy Hand Grenade is from a line of recipes from &c&lReliquary&r.
quest.5671D301C5264C7F.title: &cStarfire Pickaxe
quest.56B80A7EBFE21428.title: &eAdvanced Pump Upgrade
quest.56BF647EA84FFF7E.quest_desc: Shows which crafting recipes are happening at any time.
quest.56DB53F255100136.title: &a&lMekaSuit Pants
quest.56DDCB2865CEB9D3.quest_desc: The &cSpiritus Aura Gauge&r shows the local concentration of will nearby. Sneaking while holding it gives us exact numbers per Aspect, from &e0 to 100&r — handy when we're deciding where to grow our next crystal.
quest.56DDCB2865CEB9D3.title: Reading the Aura
quest.56F4E4845B8F12BB.title: The Blank Slate
quest.5716E84828EC0C23.quest_desc:
Plastic Construction Bricks are Blocks made through &l&7PneumaticCraft: Repressurized&r. 

Just like their real life counter parts they hurt to step on! 

So either wear Shoes or smooth down the Bricks.
quest.5716E84828EC0C23.title: Plastic Construction Bricks
quest.573C2242EAB85B49.title: &l&8Coke Oven
quest.57545837046F552B.title: &2Mysterious Pots
quest.575E405B270BBCBC.quest_desc: In the &9Twilight Forest&r, there are a bunch of new creatures to discover.\n\nOne of the worst of these creatures is the Cicada. I suggest killing this for this, but killing any Twilight Forest mob will work.
quest.5785D68A5F1ED2D2.title: The Tau Harvest
quest.5791F3000D18E2C9.quest_desc:
The &8Wither&r has a tendency to break and blow up Blocks. 

Most players do not enjoy this, so the &8Witherproof Bricks&r are just what you are looking for! 

They are just like &8Witherproof Blocks&r, just with a better design!
quest.5791F3000D18E2C9.title: &8Witherproof Bricks
quest.5792CC9E3AFAB229.quest_desc: We also have the mod called &aGenerators Galore&r! This mod adds unique generators that use coal or other items.
quest.57940981E8DE55D4.quest_desc: It's easy to get lost in the &9Twilight Forest&r. In your travels, you'll run into &5Obsidian Pillars&r.\n\nThese pillars will have &8Ravens&r around them. Kill them and they'll drop their feathers, which you can use to create a map for the &9Twilight Forest&r!
quest.57C4A0BAE739E903.quest_desc: The Dissolution Chamber is used to craft more advanced machines.\n\nYou will need to put a certain fluid in it along with the items needed for what you are crafting. Check JEI.
quest.57DD886985DBFD97.quest_desc:
When opening Chests in Dungeons you may come across a fearsome fake, the &4Mimic&r. 

&4Mimics&r have 20 &4Hearts&r and deal a ton of Damage. 

Don't worry about your Loot you might have gotten from the Chest, when Killed the &4Mimic&r will Spawn similar Loot!
quest.57DD886985DBFD97.title: &4Mimic
quest.57F107892FFA1F52.quest_desc: To grow Nether Star Seeds you'll need a Crux below the Farmland. Yes growing Nether Stars needed to be made more expensive! \n\nTo make the Nether Star Crux you'll need &7Withering Souls&r which have a 1/3 chance drop from &8Withers&r.
quest.58006FC06C34F6CA.quest_desc: &5Zanite Armor&r gives a total of 15 Armor Points. \n\nNothing special about them, they're just Armor!
quest.58006FC06C34F6CA.title: &5Zanite&r Armor
quest.58248AF507380501.title: Enchantment Salvaging
quest.5825892699A8DCB7.quest_desc:
Wow, it worked... 

Welcome to &e&lThe Aether&r one of the Modpacks from all of our childhoods! And yeah, it is just as we remember! 

&e&lThe Aether&r is a Sky Dimension, flying high above the &2&lOverworld&r. There's floating Islands and structures and clouds! Lots and lots of clouds. 

Here you'll also find new Items, Mobs, and even Dungeons.
quest.5825892699A8DCB7.title: &l&eThe Aether
quest.5844DD2BEE5EC3DC.title: Mercury
quest.5869E198DA416346.quest_desc:
Late Game &5&lMekanism&r is just insane. For 1 &5Antimatter Pellet&r you need to crystallize 1,000mb &5Antimatter&r. 

For 1mb of &5Antimatter&r you need to power 1,000mb of &3Polonium&r through the SPS. 

To get 1mb of &3Polonium&r you'll need to activate the Neutrons of 5mb of &2Nuclear Waste&r. 

And &2Nuclear Waste&r you get from processing &9Fissile Fuel&r through a Fission Reactor!
quest.586D5DE28EEC8014.quest_desc:
&cQuanta&r helps to mix up the &5Enchantment&r Pool, making it easier to get a whole bunch of different &5Enchantments&r. 

&cQuanta&r can work against you though, the more you have it, the more common weaker &5Enchantments&r will get. 

Before we used &eRectification&r, instead we now use &6Geode-Encased Bookshelves of Stability&r! 

Default &cQuanta&r is &c15%&r and its max is &c100%&r.
quest.5895B7FA5497BD68.title: Draconic Axe
quest.58B5EF8EB72934C2.quest_desc:
The &cJetpack &7Unit&r will act as if you are wearing the &5&lMekanism&r &cJetpack&r and your &a&lMekaSuit Bodyarmor&r. 

The &cJetpack&r uses the same Controls, and will need &7Hydrogen&r as fuel. 

You can fuel it with &7Hydrogen&r in 2 ways. You can place it in a &5Machine&r that has &7Hydrogen&r in it. Or be under &9Water&r while your &a&lMekaSuit Helmet&r has &9&lElectrolytic Breathing&r. 

You won't be able to use this &7Unit&r while you have the &dGravitational Modulating &7Unit&r on.
quest.58BD1063A19777DC.quest_desc: Once you've unlocked the &2Highland&r biome, head over and find some Trolls to kill.\n\nThey can drop some &9Magic Beans&r. You'll also find chests that give you Uberus Soil, which is needed to grow the Magi Beans.
quest.58C2ABED43B2EA61.quest_desc:
&9Model Frameworks&r are the starting point for creating Data Models.

To start collecting data on a specific mob, you'll want to make one of these then &9right click&r the mob you'd like to gather data on. When done properly, the Model Framework will turn into the Data Model of the mob you clicked on.

To gather data for that mob, place the newly created Data Model inside of a &aDeep Learner&r, then start killing that specific mob with the Deep Learner in your inventory.
quest.58C2ABED43B2EA61.title: &9Modeling Mobs
quest.58CC2E563F92B4C5.quest_desc:
The &cEssence of Raging&r when in your Offhand will act like a bounty system. 

It will highlight 4 Mobs and when they are killed you'll get Strength and the more you kill the higher it goes! 

To a max of 16. 

Once used it will have a cooldown of 30 Minutes though.
quest.58EC47584C773B82.quest_desc: Using our Enchanting Apparatus structure, we'll want to craft our first seed, the &5Magebloom Seed&r. \n\nThis will be used to create us some magical clothing!
quest.5900ADCC247CD5F9.title: &eSilver Dungeon
quest.59036A2741E7A8AA.quest_desc:
Want to create a Spawn Egg from the spirit you have trapped in that box?

The &9Spirit Reanimator&r does exactly that. Give it a lot of &cBlood&r and an Egg, and of course a &9Box of Eternal Closure&r with the Spirit you want to create the Spawn Egg from, and it will attempt to create the Spawn Egg!

Note: Some mobs cannot be used to create Spawn Eggs.
quest.5914D015D8543875.quest_desc:
The &aFluidizer&r can operate in one of 3 modes: Solid to Fluid, Combining 2 Solids into a Fluid, or combining 2 Fluids into a new Fluid. This all depends on the type of &aInjectors&r you use for the multiblock.

For example, if you want to convert &dBlutonium&r into a fluid, you can use 1 &aSolid Injector&r.

If you want to combine two solids together into something new, you'll build the multiblock with 2 &aSolid Injectors&r.

If you want to combine two fluids, you'll use 2 &9Fluid Injectors&r.

This might seem confusing, but is important for progression. For example, you'll want to convert Magentite into a fluid in the Fluidizer first, then send it to a &aReprocessor&r with Ludicrite to create Ridiculite.
quest.5932B5AD48F6AB74.quest_desc: Use power with a &5Pipe Booster&r to boost extraction speed of &2Oritech&r pipes.
quest.594BBD31461F212D.title: Draconic Shield Recovery Module
quest.59613CCE59689263.quest_desc: &2Rookfish&r are cute Chess-piece-shaped Squids who Swim around in the &9&lStarlight&r. \nThey have 5 &4Hearts&r and will Drop themselves and their Airsacs on death.
quest.59613CCE59689263.title: &2Rookfish
quest.5979DE0E2BA3DAE5.quest_desc:
&7Train Tracks&r are... well what you'll use to move &5Trains&r! 

You'll need to &6Deploy&r 2 &7Iron Nuggets&r onto a &8Stone Slab&r, then &6Press&r it with a &6Metal Press&r to get 1. 

These will be the first Block you place in order to get &5Trains&r as it will be needed to place &5Train Stations&r. 

They have some limitations though, they can't go at steep angles to turn, or elevate. You'll need 4 Blocks of space to get up a Block with &7Train Tracks&r. To turn it is even worse! Let's just say, if you want a perfect circle with &7Train Tracks&r, it'll need a diameter of 18 Blocks.
quest.59B6C6BF0550D13D.quest_desc: New types of Glass that can be used with your Trains! Or bases, \n\nI can't make you use it for anything specific.
quest.59EC02C1FBCF14EA.quest_desc:
You can upgrade your &5Obsidian Generator&r into an &3Ender Generator&r. 

Then, it can use &3Ender Pearls&r or &3Eyes of Ender&r to make Energy! 

Or make the &6&lStar&r, your choice.
quest.59EC02C1FBCF14EA.title: &3Ender Generator
quest.5A011CE8EEA3F9D8.quest_desc:
Aura can be bottled up by right-clicking in the air with a Bottle and Cork. Aura takes different forms depending on where it's collected.

In the Overworld it is bottled as &aSunlight&r, in the Nether it's &4Ghosts&r and in the End it's &0Darkness&r.

If the area you used the Bottle and Cork in has a severe lack of aura, you will get &0Bottled Vacuum&r.
quest.5A1DCD6C7F712A78.title: Neptunium Fishing Rod
quest.5A26738AC904DC39.title: &6Allthemodium Spell Book
quest.5A2A718C569F3C19.quest_desc:
By Smelting &0Coal&r in a &lCoke Oven&r we can get &0Coal Coke&r! Or as I will call it, just &0Coke&r! 

It pretty much is just &0Coal&r but has more uses in &8&lIE&r. 

You can combine it with Iron to get &7Steel&r, Crush it to get &0Coke Dust&r which will be needed for &0Graphite&r, or use as Fuel for a Blast Furnace.
quest.5A5D4DFE4175FB42.title: &cGold Dungeon
quest.5A615BB74A5CD332.quest_desc: Using the &aReprocessor&r, we can combine everything we've made so far to make a few new ingots.\n\nNote: You might need a &9Fluidizer&r to complete this step!
quest.5A615BB74A5CD332.title: Ludicrite \& Ridiculite
quest.5A6831E0BD2F6AB5.title: 2 &4Piercing Vengeance Focuses
quest.5A6FF0D4BA894306.quest_desc:
The poster child of &6&lForbidden \& Arcanus&r, the &aEternal Stella&r. 

For 1 &6Allthemodium&r Ingot, 3 &aXpetrified Orbs&r, and a &2Stellarite Piece&r we can make one of the most overpowered Items in this Modpack! 

You can use the &aEternal Stella&r with an Item and an Apply Item Modifier to make Items lose their Durability. No, wait I mean lose their need for Durability! Basically Indestructible Items. 

This can be used on almost every Item with Durability from &bDiamond Axes&r, to Fishing Rods, to even &eRefined Glowstone Armor&r! 

There are some limitations, it only works with Items with Durability not uses: like Infusion Crystals or Energy: like Meka-Tool!
quest.5A6FF0D4BA894306.title: &aEternal Stella
quest.5A955C0F53AED3ED.quest_desc:
The &bChain of Souls&r works similar to a Grappling Hook. 

You can Right Click for it to send a &bChain&r which will drag you toward the Block you shot it at. You can Right Click again to release it. Plus it has a Range of 90 Blocks give or take a few. 

To make it you'll need a &bTrapped Soul&r, 2 &5Tenacious Vines&r, and a &9Tenacious Petal&r. 

You can get these mobs from killing a &9Lunar Monstrocity&r.
quest.5A955C0F53AED3ED.title: &bChain of Souls
quest.5A9B2246E33065A5.quest_desc:
Affects the amount of combs you receive whenever a bee produces honeycombs. There are 4 levels of this: &aNormal&r, &9Medium&r, &dHigh&r, &cVery High&r. &cVery High&r is what we are after.

It is found on KamikazBee and BeeBee. BeeBee can naturally be found in The Other, and is an EXTREMELY lethal bee. If you'd rather not risk dealing with an exceptionally lethal bee, you can also rely on KamikazBees.

To get a KamikazBee, you need a Bee Nest Helmet. Get attacked by mobs (or shoot yourself with an arrow) while wearing the helmet for a 30% chance of having a KamikazBee emerge. It is quite fast, and will sting the aggressor (unless it's you), so better catch it quickly or use the Catcher.
quest.5AA17C1657E8E5DE.title: Wear It In
quest.5ACB4565C6B2466C.title: Coaxing Crystals
quest.5AD80D3242DD3F60.title: &dInsanite Block
quest.5AEA705D6A64A982.quest_desc:
If you have a small &2&lFission Reactor&r primarily for &aPolonium&r then we should use this as a simple fail safe! 

&aPolonium&r is made with the &e&lSolar Neutron Activator&r. You can probably tell it needs &eDaylight&r to work! 

So, in order to stop bottle-necking (which can be deadly when we are talking about &2&lReactors&r) we can turn off our &2&lReactor&r when it is Nighttime! 

First, set your &2FRLA&r to Activation. This will turn on the &2&lReactor&r when it has a &4Redstone Signal&r and turned off when it doesn't. 

Now we can place our &eDaylight Sensor&r and connect it to the &2FRLA&r with &4Redstone&r. 

Then, boom, it is ready!
quest.5AF0E903DB670D65.quest_desc:
With some Dreadrock, &3Rogdorium&r, and a &cUtheric Cluster&r, we can make the Infuser! 

This is a Block we can use to Craft and Infuse certain Items. Right now there isn't too many Recipes but I bet we will see more! 

The main usage will be to Craft &cUtheric Crystals&r and Infuse Armor with &3Rogdorium&r. 

If Armor is Infused with &3Rogdorium&r, it will protect you from getting the &cRot&r disease.
quest.5B2FD54E425D5C9D.quest_desc:
Now this ones hard to get... we'll need to kill 2 Bosses and a Miniboss to get everything for the &dVoid &cForge&r. 

First, we'll need a &4Mechanical Fusion Anvil&r. To get it, visit the &4Ancient Factory&r which lies beneath the &2&lOverworld&r. 

Then, feed &4&lThe Harbringer&r a Nether Star to power it up and kill it! &4&lThe Harbringer&r will drop &4Witherite&r which can Craft the &4Mechanical Fusion Anvil&r. 

Next, we'll need the &cInfernal Forge&r. That is a Drop from the &c&lNetherite Monstrosity&r. 

Go to &c&lThe Nether&r to find the &cSoul Blacksmith&r structure. Then, fight and kill the &c&lNetherite Monstrosity&r to get your &cInfernal Forge&r! 

Last and probably easiest is the &dVoid Core&r. Thankfully it isn't dropped from a Boss, instead it is a Miniboss! 

Visit &5&lThe End&r to find a &dRuined Citadel&r, within you'll find the &dEnder Golem&r. This one will drop us our &dVoid Core&r. 

Once you have everything, use the &4Mechanical Fusion Anvil&r to combine the &cInfernal Forge&r and &dVoid Core&r to create the &dVoid &cForge&r.
quest.5B2FD54E425D5C9D.title: &dVoid &cForge
quest.5B36DE3826F26963.quest_desc:
&dRotational Power&r is the most important and confusing part of &6&lCreate&r. 

All Machines will need some sort of &dRotational Power&r to work, but what is it and how do we use it? 

&dRotational Power&r is simply our Machines moving. Blocks like Shafts and Cogs will move that &dRotational Power&r to our Machines. 

Talking about Shafts, that is our start to &dRotational Power&r. They can be placed in a straight line, next to each other. 

When one &8Shaft&r is moved, all &8Shafts&r connected to it (on the same axis) will move with it. 

Craft 2 &8Andesite Alloys&r to create 8 &8Shafts&r.
quest.5B46B5BF4ADB2BE9.title: &6Allthemodium &5Alloy &3Shovel
quest.5B737000D540ED48.title: &4Amaramber Sickle
quest.5B9F933ECD6B24FD.quest_desc: Allows you to jump higher than with Tier II.
quest.5BA84F6282D9CAF1.quest_desc: &6Allthemodium Armor&r but with buffs to &e&lIron's Spells&r Spells!
quest.5BA84F6282D9CAF1.title: &6Allthemodium Mage Outfit
quest.5BA986D7928BF09F.quest_desc:
The Piglich is a Boss added by &6&lAllthemodium&r. 

He has 9999 Hearts and currently has no attacks but trust me when he does they will be devastating! 

When killed he'll drop his Heart which will be needed for Alloys and the ATM Star! 

(Look into ways of farming them like with HNN or EnderIO!)
quest.5BB5EE00BB4F9691.quest_desc:
&7Flying Cows&r are Cows with wings! 

Not much new... 

5 &4Hearts&r, Drops Raw Beef and Leather, can be Milked. 

Just these will glide so they don't take Fall Damage.
quest.5BB5EE00BB4F9691.title: &7Flying Cow
quest.5BB887411B8B38FA.quest_desc:
As for wirelessly expanding the ME Network itself, the first step is admittedly somewhat unorthodox.

The &bMatter Condenser&f is AE2's take on a trash can, voiding any items inserted into it. When fitted with a &eStorage Component&f, however, the condenser can harness some left-over energy from the item being voided and store it to make two special crafting items out of enough concentrated energy.

The first of these two items is the &bMatter Ball&f, requiring at least a 1k storage component and 256 items' worth of voided material.
quest.5BB887411B8B38FA.title: Condensed Matter
quest.5BD22081ED81BCC6.quest_desc:
&9Urchinkin&r are small pests who for some reason live in &9Acropolis&r. 

They have 6 &4Hearts&r with no Armor. Thankfully pretty weak. 

They have a few Attacks, if they are near you they will Hit you. If there is some distance they will roll at you. When they roll, tons of their &9Spikes&r will be shot out, doing Damage to anyone they hit! 

On death they won't Drop anything unique. Besides more &9Spikes&r to Damage you, that's all.
quest.5BD5737703F3F077.quest_desc: Ferricore is a new material added by JDT. Ferricore is acquired by performing Goo Spread on Iron Blocks using tier one goo or higher.
quest.5C11E99FF201C3F9.quest_desc:
The &8Golem Steel Greatsword&r is a very fun Weapon. 

First, it can Block. Just Right Click to Block. 

Second, &bLIGHTNING BALLS&r! Whenever you Left Click 3 &bLightning Balls&r will be sent out of the &8Sword&r. &bLightning&r will connect between all 3 and will Damage anything they touch. They also bounce off Blocks. 

Plus, it's just a great &8Sword&r regardless!
quest.5C11E99FF201C3F9.title: &8Golem Steel Greatsword
quest.5C3EA8B4F5949406.title: The Hellfire Forge
quest.5C6BA6BBEC75EB71.quest_desc: The &cGold Key&r! \n\nThe Treasure Chest opens up behind the wall opposite of the entrance.
quest.5C6BA6BBEC75EB71.title: &cGold Key
quest.5C73247A48E72FB3.quest_desc:
If you want to remove a specific &5Enchant&r from &5Enchantment Pool&r, you can use this &bBookshelf&r in your &5Enchanting&r set up! 

Place an &5Enchantment Book&r, you want to Blacklist, in an empty spot in this &bSeashelf&r. 

Then, when you &5Enchant&r, this &5Enchantment&r won't show up on Items or Books.
quest.5CAC395680027354.quest_desc: The &bInterdimensional Wireless Transmitter&r is an upgraded version of the &3Wireless Transmitter&r that has infinite range, even across dimensions.
quest.5CAC395680027354.title: &dInterdimensional Wireless Transmitter
quest.5CBA8C89FE717B9C.quest_desc: With a &8Giant's Pickaxe&r, you'll want to head back to Troll Caves to find &5Giant Obsidian&r.\n\nUse the &8Giant's Pickaxe&r to break it, and you'll find some loot. Acquire the &6Lamp of Cinders&r to continue.
quest.5CD8D169181C7339.quest_desc:
These last three items are more or less some extra toys provided by AE2 and don't necessarily fit under any of these quest trees.

The &bCharged Staff&f is just a simple powered staff which deals 3 hearts of damage and consumes 300AE per hit. It also uses pre-1.9 combat mechanics, meaning that you can spam-click with this like in the good old days.

The &bEntropy Manipulator&f, when &oused&r on certain blocks in the world, will smelt them in-place, such as sand to glass and metal ores to metal ingots. If not, it will simply light a fire on the block.

Finally, the &bMatter Cannon&f functions similarly to the Color Applicator as a dedicated cell for holding 'ammo' items such as Matter Balls and iron/gold nuggets, which can then be fired out to deal damage to mobs or break blocks. Heavier 'ammo'Matter Balls in a Matter Cannon can be substituted with &bPaint Balls&f, which will apply a paint splatter effect on the face of whatever block being fired at. &bLumen Paint Balls&f are a variant of paint balls exclusively used by the Matter Cannon, whose paint splatters also give off some light once present in the world.
quest.5CF320E9C4C1B1E1.quest_desc:
ATM10 is a &aKitchensink&r pack, meaning you are free to explore and play the modpack any way that you want!

However, there is an endgame goal: Making the &6ATM Star&r!

This questline serves as a guide for all players, whether you are brand new to Minecraft or you've played through previous ATM packs.

Just like almost every modpack, gather some wood to get started!
quest.5D64250B940BC8FD.quest_desc: Compressed Iron can be used to craft &3Compressed Iron Armor&r, it's the same as Iron Armor but with better Armor Toughness and Knockback Resistance.\n\nThe armor can be crafted or can be found commonly in loot chests.
quest.5D6A4E574823446F.title: &8Trolls
quest.5D71589555637DB0.quest_subtitle: Feed Anglesite Ore to Draconic Bee
quest.5D71ED16FD4E725A.quest_desc: Makes Piglins Passive (same as wearing Gold Armor), you only need to put the Upgrade on one piece.
quest.5D74D73092ACD2F2.quest_desc:
&5Coral Golems&r spawn within the &5Sunken City&r and in oceans after you have defeated &5&lThe Leviathan&r. 

They are similar to their bigger counterparts: &5Coralssus&r but have less &4Hearts&r at 110 and can't be ridden by &5Deeplings&r. 

They have more attacks than their counterparts though! Like jumping at you and smashing the ground next to you. And it can smack you. 

On death they will drop Crystallized Coral Fragments, which can be crafted into Crystallized Coral. Those can be made into the &5Abyssal Sacrifice&r.
quest.5D87088E8D71DB9B.quest_desc: The IO Crystals work as blocks that can connect to each other and move power from one another. To link them Shift Right Click with a Crystal Binder to set one and then right click whichever Crystal you want connected. When you look at the Crystal it will say either Input from block or Output to block. Input is the one you want to take OP from and Output to where you want it to go.
quest.5D8E715CCB7ACCAC.title: &dStarlit Diamond Leggings
quest.5DC892BA79EB52EC.quest_desc:
The &6Mixer&r can do quite a few different Recipes but all will need a &8Basin&r below it! 

We can &6Mix&r, this combines &bLiquids&f and &eItems&f into new &eItems&r. Like Baking! 

&6Brewing&r can combine the right &bLiquids &fand &eItems&r to make Liquid Potions. These can then be scooped out into Empty Bottles to get Potions. You'll need Heat from a &cBlaze Burner&r to &6Brew&r though. 

Last is &6Automated Shapeless Crafting&r. To the normal Player this might be a confusing statement but trust me it ain't that bad. &6Shapeless Crafting&r is a Recipe that can be made with the ingredients in any pattern. 

Like Dying Wool, the Dye and Wool can be anywhere in the Crafting Table. Or even Silent Gear parts and patterns!
quest.5DC892BA79EB52EC.title: &6Mechanical Mixer
quest.5DE3F2A96715BA2E.title: &l&eSilo
quest.5DE45BC0258D1B0B.title: &dPearlescent Endshelf
quest.5DFE3CB5B0130A7A.quest_desc: There's plenty of plant life on top of the &3Shimmer River&r, some you can stand on!
quest.5DFE3CB5B0130A7A.title: River life
quest.5E090C9BB4DAA5D4.title: Tier: &aEnergized
quest.5E0D78B7B2CF1729.title: Draconic Core
quest.5E116409DC7D30BB.quest_desc:
You should know Logistics by know! This Quest will now be reserved to explaining the &3Configurator&r! 

By Holding Shift and Scrolling you can change the Mode of the &3Configurator&r. 

&dWrench&r: will Drop &5&lMekanism&r &5Machines&r and Blocks when used on them. 
&eRotate&r: will simply Rotate the direction of the Block. 
&4Empty&r: will make it work like a Gauge Dropper. 
The rest of them will make the &3Configurator&r interact with&5 Machines&r to change their Configs! 

If you use it on Pipes it will change if they Push, Pull, or Both. You can use it on Ports to set Inputs and Outputs. And even on Bins to set them to Auto-Export below them.
quest.5E4FE420B6D2C97F.title: &eAdvanced Compacting Upgrade
quest.5E6585F7627247E3.quest_desc: When applied as an upgrade to any supported device such as an Interface or Export Bus, the &bCrafting Card&f allows the device in question to automatically send out its own crafting requests for a required (filtered) item. Crafting CPUs can be set to respond only to these requests to prevent taking up CPUs meant for player-requested crafts.\n\nWhen the &eLevel Emitter&f is upgraded with the Crafting Card, it can be configured to emit redstone in order to directly facilitate in crafting, by emitting a signal either &owhile&r a crafting job for its given item is detected or specifically &oto&r craft the item. The latter would apply for cases where the only thing needed to make a given item is a redstone signal, without even requiring a crafting pattern.
quest.5E671F1F370DDE43.title: Draconic Auto Feed Module
quest.5E799B92358A8732.quest_desc: In the &cNether&r, you'll run into &6Ancient Debris&r. This can be smelted down into Scraps that can be combined with Gold to create &6Netherite Ingots&r, which is an endgame metal used to craft some of the strongest tools and armor in the game.
quest.5E7CCDE9229A646A.title: &6Allthemodium&r
quest.5E8A1D47CF3C7ACF.title: &aFlowglaze Shovel
quest.5EB488C393B084C4.quest_desc:
A continuation of &lChiseled&r, &4&lRechiseled&r! 

All of this Mod works within the Chisel Tool, Right Click with it to pull up its GUI. 
On the Left is where you choose the design and the Bottom Right is where you put the Blocks. 

Above it you can view the design in set patterns: just the 1 Block, 3x1 Blocks, or 3x3 Wall of that Block. You can also set the image to either spin or not spin by clicking the button! 

Next to where the Blocks go, you can click the Chisel, doing this will set the selected design, to every Block in your Inventory that can be changed. 

Also does not have Durability!
quest.5EB488C393B084C4.title: &4&lRechiseled&r
quest.5EC1B868720BF521.quest_desc: &8&lImmersive Engineering&r is all about Multiblock Machines, fun Tools, and of course engineering. \n\nDon't worry you won't need 4 years of college for this! But a Manual might help you get started.
quest.5ED0DA95BAE43D88.quest_desc:
The last of the Prisms, well this one's a &dCrystal&r but you get the idea! 

First, you'll need a &eDivine Pact&r Relic, which are found in &b&lThe Other&r. 

Then, you'll need &3Enderpearl Fragments&r, &5Amethyst&r, and Nether Quartz. Don't worry it gets harder! 

Now we'll need every type of Soul. I taught you how to get Souls and &9Corrupt Souls&r in other Quests now I'll teach you about &dEnchanted Souls&r. 

Find a Lost Soul flying around in your world, then toss a &bSplash Potion of Aureal&r at them! Then, they'll become a &dLost Enchanted Soul&r, kill them! 

With that you can now make the &dCrystal&r, which can be applied to Tools and Armor to give it Soulbound. This means when you die, you'll respawn with these Items in your Inventory still.
quest.5EE1DF1C8F0C1FF9.title: &5&lLightning Coil
quest.5F00A66CC1FE1F9F.quest_desc: Honestly the only difficult part of this recipe is the Bat Wing, how many times are you killing Bats let alone Farming them? \n\nThis one is pretty new and doesn't combine with Armor, it is only used for the end game!
quest.5F1218CF8EFC607B.title: &c&lLaser IO
quest.5F44BF9A1DAE8B99.quest_desc: &9Neptune Armor&r gives 15 Armor Points and 4 Armor Toughness. \n\nThis whole set will make you swim through &9Water&r quicker! That's it.
quest.5F44BF9A1DAE8B99.title: &9Neptune Armor
quest.5F4F7637044BD4F1.title: &l&2Fermenter
quest.5F834F8C607A8B77.quest_desc:
You have to either find these in structures in the &6&lBumblezone&r or you can trade with the &5Bee Queen&r to get one! 

While wearing it you can hold Space Bar to fly for a little. 

Except like a &6B&8e&6e&r the Wings are too small to keep your fat little body off the ground.
quest.5FBA199E0B7F1585.quest_desc:
The &9Octohost&r is actually 2 Mobs working together! To Kill you! 

It has the &9Symbiocto&r which controls the &9Drowned Host&r. 

&9Symbiocto&r has 8 &4Hearts&r and no Armor. When on its own, it will just Shoot &0Ink&r at you. On Death they will Drop &0Ink Sacs&r. 

The &9Drowned Host&r acts like a normal &9Drowned&r. They have 10 &4Hearts&r as well as 2 Armor Points. &9Drowned Host&r can Spawn with Armor and Weapons which they can use. 

When together, they will use their Attacks on you at the same time. The &9Symbiocto&r will Shoot you with &0Ink&r while the &9Drowned Host&r will use Weapons or Fists to Hit you.
quest.5FE507DAEE770507.quest_desc: Don't want to get a &9Marid Crusher&r for &bLight Blue Chalk&r? Then you can settle for a &aDjinni Crusher&r instead. &aOphyx' Calling&r is used for summoning &aDjinnis&r. This includes a Demonic Wife/Husband. &aDjinnis&r are able to crush ores more efficiently than Foliots, but not as efficiently as &cAfrits&r or &9Marids&r. They're also capable of crushing ice without melting it.
quest.5FE507DAEE770507.title: &aOphyx' Calling
quest.600F66B13B29708B.quest_desc: Either with the flesh of &aPlayers&r or &dWerewolves&r, you can create an &aInfinite Food Source&r using the power of Garmonbozia!
quest.601C719C8FD513F0.quest_desc:
3 &cNetherite Ingots&r, 3 Wireless Boosters, and a bunch of &2fancy &eGears&r we can get an Infinity Range Booster! 

The most confusing parts are the Gears. We can't make the Ingots directly we need to mix Dusts together then Smelt the result to get the Ingots.

This doesn't work across Dimensions sorry!
quest.602884068EC40EDB.title: Sentient Steel
quest.602C3E88D96F8843.quest_desc: Put a Charged Empty PCB into the Etching Tank with some Etching Acid and some heat and you'll get an &3Unassembled PCBs&r.
quest.603BEDD49070ECAD.quest_desc:
&bCondensating&r is to make from &bLiquid &fto &cGas&r. &cDecondensating&r is turning &cGas &fto &bLiquid&r. 

The &c&lRotary &bCondenstrator&r does both! 

&cGas&r will go in the Bar on the Left. They can be added from &cTubes &for &cChemical Tanks&r that you place in the Left Slots. 

&bLiquids&r will go in the Right Bar. They can also be added with &bPipes &for &bFluid Tanks&r placed in the Right Slots. 

When powered, &cGas&r will become &bLiquid&r, and &bLiquid&r turned into &cGas&r. They will switch Bars and can then be taken out with &cTubes&f/&bPipes&r or &cChemical&f/&bFluid Tanks&r.
quest.604F2B68B27885BF.quest_desc: There are a lot of different foods you can make from the &9Twilight Forest&r!\n\nTry them all!
quest.605A5AC65BC7E864.quest_desc: The Marine Fisher can fish automatically. Can catch fish, treasures, enchanted books, and some other stuff. Can't catch bees, though, you'll have to fish manually for that one.\n\nMust be placed above a 3x3 &9Water&r pool (or bigger).
quest.6063F4B7BE4D394C.quest_desc: The Sender Modules will move Items in the Router's Buffer Slot into another Inventory. \n\nMK1 will only move items into Inventories on the same XYZ axis as the Router and with direct line of sight. If there is a block in the way, the MK1 Sender will not send.
quest.606775701551F3EE.title: &4Carminite
quest.6076D1DB438EB997.quest_desc:
Very simple recipe, only needing &7Coal&r, &cBlaze Powder&r, and an &bArcane Crystal Block&r. 

&7Coal&r and &bArcane Crystal&r can be obtained via Quarries, &6&lBees&r, or &2&lMA&r. 

&cBlaze Powder&r can be gotten from the last two Mods mentioned, or Farms and &b&lHNN&r. There's too many ways of getting &cBlaze Powder&r.
quest.6076D1DB438EB997.title: &cSmelter Prism
quest.607D9B53C632DEDE.quest_desc:
&bPipe Valves&r work at helping sort and stop &bFluid&r flow! 

When used with &bFluid Pipes&r, they will make it so the &bFluid&r only goes in direction with the arrows on the &bPipe Valve&r. 

You can also send it a &4Redstone Signal&r to which it will completely stop &bFluid&r flow!
quest.607D9B53C632DEDE.title: &bPipe Valve
quest.609CA1ACFA981BD5.quest_desc: The &cRouting Kit&r is used with the passing tickets.
quest.60A4994078500F63.quest_desc: Celestigem is a new material added by JDT. Celestigem is acquired by performing Goo Spread on Diamond Blocks using tier three goo or higher.
quest.60C27206F1414DD6.quest_desc: Thanks to Newton we know for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction. Basically when an Arrow hits a mob the force of the Mob applies to the Arrow which will slow it down. Unless you have this Module. It doesn't act as if every mob was paper, it acts as if every mob isn't in the way. Arrows won't slow down after Piercing a target.
quest.60C27206F1414DD6.title: Projectile Immunity Cancellation Module
quest.60C8272DD1A2B262.quest_subtitle: Runic Star Altar does not work without upgrades
quest.60CECAAE2D43EC6E.quest_desc:
Deep within fractured places of the &eEnd&r, where time itself once broke, a strange relic can be found... the &5Clot of Time&r. 

 This &6mysterious fragment&r holds echoes of past moments, allowing its bearer to &6retrace&r their &6steps&r as if rewriting what just happened. 

- &lIt has 1 ability:&r 

 &dTransgression&r: 
 By &6holding&r the use &6key&r, you begin to rewind your movement through time, &6returning&r along your &6recent path&r for a &6few seconds&r. Once the rewind ends, the ability enters a &6cooldown&r equal to the &6duration&r it was &6used&r. 

- A &6relic&r that defies &dtime&r itself... for those quick enough to rewrite their own &5mistakes&r.
quest.60CECAAE2D43EC6E.title: &5Clot of Time&r
quest.60D9F04E91171D16.quest_desc: This can act as a Chest for your Variables, or can actually be used in an advanced network.\n\nIf you want advanced networks, make sure to read about them in the &eDynamics of Integration&r.
quest.6101AB772B0317F1.title: A Sense for Anima
quest.6112956E19017D2D.quest_desc: Logic Cables are different from other &e&lPipez&r or &5&lMeka pipes&r. The other Pipes act as hoppers, the items move from 1 Inventory, into the Pipe, then into the 2nd Inventory. Logic Cables just skip the middle man which also skips a lotta lag. \n\nThey are just for connecting Importers and Interfaces.
quest.61217D80BFF8A858.quest_subtitle: Nothing to do with Occultism I swear
quest.61419D230687CBB5.quest_desc: Velocity is the speed of an item at a certain direction. Since our Arrow aren't from Guardians of the Galaxy it basically just means the Speed of an Arrow. With each upgrade it takes less time from the Arrow to go from your Bow to your Target. Comes at a cost of a little inaccuracy.
quest.6144202A97C6CD1C.quest_desc:
The &bQuartz Cutting Knife&f, like the wrench, comes in both nether and certus quartz flavours and is a useful crafting tool to have on hand.

Cables can also be separated without needing to be coloured by attaching a &bCable Anchor&f between them, crafted using this knife and craftable up to 50 times with the same knife before it breaks.

Cable Anchors can also be used to craft &bCable Facades&f, allowing you to disguise cables within walls by covering them with the face of an arbitrary block. While facade recipes are hidden in JEI, you can still craft them by taking any regular block and surrounding it with 4 cable anchors in the crafting grid.

Aside from crafting anchors, the cutting knife also has another use: right-clicking with the knife will open a small GUI that allows you to craft &bInscriber Name Presses&f. When given a name, these presses can be used inside of an Inscriber to rename any input item with the name of the press. Two of these presses can be concatenated in the inscriber to rename the item to the name of the top press, followed by the bottom one.
quest.6149E5F1F9CF8DC6.quest_desc:
The Phyg! (Is it still pronounced as pig?). 

When Pigs fly is now! The Pigs got Wings now. So they'll glide like Chickens to avoid Fall Damage. 

They have 5 Hearts and will Drop Raw Porkchops and Feathers on Death.
quest.6149E5F1F9CF8DC6.title: &dPhyg
quest.616F9B78B16B42A5.quest_desc:
The recipe for the &6Tesla Coil&r might seem complicated, especially in a recipe tree, but we can break it down to be simpler!

The &7Aluminum Plates&r are very simple, just needing to use a Hammer on Ingots or the Metal Press Multiblock.

The &8Iron Mechanical Component&r is simple as well, just a few Iron Plates and a &6Copper Ingot&r.

&eElectrum Coil Block&r will need a bunch of &eElectrum Ingots&r cut up into Wires. &eElectrum&r is an alloy of &eGold&r and Silver.

The &6Advanced Electronic Component&r is a whole array of using the Engineers Workbench and &9Blueprints&r. It's Duroplast Sheet requires a lot of refining and fermenting with Multiblock Machines!

The last item, the &cHV Accumulator&r needs some simple Items like &8Steel&r, &7Aluminum Plate&r, &cRedstone Acid&r, and &4Treated Wood&r. It also needs a more complicated Item called &8HOP Graphite Ingot&r.
quest.61768CFEDA041E4D.quest_desc:
Once you enter the &6&lBumblezone&r you might need to return to the &2Overworld&r. Like incase you left your Stove on! 

To get out the &6&lBumblezone&r you can mine either down or up past the &eBeehive Beeswax&r in order to enter the Void. 

This Void won't kill you, instead it will teleport you back to where you were in the &2Overworld&r!
quest.618411DCC5C1A13C.quest_subtitle: Feed Plutonium Dust to Radioactive Bee
quest.6188A57F52F29D33.quest_desc:
Ever play Terraria? Remember the Life Crystals? These work pretty similar. 

When you use a &cLife Shard&r you'll gain an extra &4Heart&r! 

I don't know what the max &4Hearts&r is... when you find out let me know!
quest.6188A57F52F29D33.title: &cLife Shard
quest.618F1434757C8E69.quest_desc: &lGenerator's Galore&r adds very simple Generators. The most basic ones act like Furnaces with &3Augment&r: Generator. They'll take Fuel and make it into Energy! \n \nYes you have to start with &6Copper Generator&r.
quest.618F1434757C8E69.title: &6Copper Generator&r
quest.61B479079DC1C69C.quest_desc: Allows you to jump higher than with Tier I.
quest.61BE7882EE0E6FAF.quest_desc:
What rolls down stairs 
Alone or in pairs... 
Rolls over your neighbor's dog 
What's great for a snack 
And fits on your back? 
It's Log! Log! Log!
quest.61E11E4C358898D6.title: &dStarlit Diamond Helmet
quest.61F265D9A5713A4D.quest_desc: Each upgrade upgrades everything, from the amount it makes to how much it can hold to what it can transfer to other blocks! \n \nYou'll need a &6Copper Generator&r to make an Iron Generator, sorry &6Copper&r haters.
quest.61F265D9A5713A4D.title: &fIron Generator
quest.6220EDE42C813C1B.quest_desc:
The worst part about &eCharms&r is that they break! Why would these OP Potion Effects have to have Durability! 

Well don't you worry, &5&lApotheosis&r has a cure for that... with &d&lInfusions&r! 

You'll need &a100 Eterna&r, between &c8.5% &fand &c13.5% Quanta&r, and between &532.5% &fand &537.5% Arcana&r. 

You can use 10 &4Glowing Hellshelves&r, 4 &6Geode-Encased Bookshelves of Stability&r, 2 &dDraconic Endshelves&r, and a Skeleton Skull! 

Yes, some Skulls and other Items besides &7Bookshelves&r give stats!
quest.62A11EEC976DA5C5.title: &aAlchemist Robe
quest.62A262A706CFCAF0.quest_desc:
We won't be creating Dark Power Gems using pools of blood anymore.

Instead, we can make the &9Blood Infuser&r to do all of the messy work for us. This allows you to directly infuse items with blood!

These can be upgraded using &6Promises&r as well. This is one of the main machines used for progression!
quest.62A262A706CFCAF0.title: &aThe &cBlood Infuser
quest.62B44B688D09C939.quest_desc:
&aFlowglaze&r! 

By Rightclicking with &cStarfire&r in hand it will throw it. This can Effect Mobs with &cStarfire&r, or if it Hits Sand it will change the Sand into &aRaw Flowglaze&r. 

Just Smelt the &aFlowglaze&r and we can use that with the Upgrade Template to make Weapons and Tools.
quest.62B44B688D09C939.title: &aFlowglaze
quest.62B4A37CFDECA679.quest_desc: The Menril Resin will go to 2 sides of the Squeezer. Placing a Drying Basin next to the Squeezer will make the Drying Basin pick up the Menril Resin.\n\nAfter 7.5 seconds the Menril Resin will turn into a Block of Crystallized Menril.
quest.62C60FF24B2F7290.quest_desc:
&bArcane Crystals&r can spawn from Y Level 14 to -40. 

It is fairly common; but trust me, you'll need a lot of it, so be thankful! 

Like &bDiamonds&r there is a Y Level that it spawns most common at, for &bArcane Crystals&r that Y Level is -13.
quest.62CE0FFAF6352287.quest_desc: EvilCraft machines can be upgraded using &6Promises&r. Each Promise will have different effects, but first, we'll want to upgrade our Blood Infuser to unlock more recipes.\n\nTo do this, we need to create a &6Promise of Tenacity: Tier 1&r. Generally, this just increases the storage capacity of a machine. For the Blood Infuser, this will unlock more recipes!
quest.62DA302CF53B7C39.title: &6Thermal Springstone Boots
quest.62DDE5B1287BEB36.quest_desc:
Another part of the &6&lATM Star's&r juicy insides is the &6Awakened &5Unobtainium&f-&3Vibranium&r Alloy Block, which I am going to just called &6Awakened Alloy&r block. 
To get this you'll need a &6&lStar Altar&r multiblock, (check out Crafting the Star Quest for more info!) 

There you'll need to input the &5Unobtainium&f-&3Vibranium&r Block, 4 Unbreaking I Books, 4 &6Awakened Supremium Gemstones&r, and 4 &6Awakened Supremium Essence&r. 

You'll then need to give it 85 Million FE... After that, your Alloy should now be Awakened!
quest.62DF58D36B739EA0.quest_desc:
The &eWadjet&r is similar to the &eKobolediator&r as it lies within the &eCursed Pyramid&r waiting for a Player to come near. 

The &eWadjet&r has 450 &4Hearts&r and thankfully won't give you Mining Fatigue! 
She has many attacks, the most basic is when you are close she will swing her weapon at you. If you get farther she might throw a Sandstorm at you or drop Sand Blocks from the roof on top of you. 

I'm going to be honest, I don't know which attack is worse! 

On death they will only drop Ancient Metal Ingots.
quest.62F33BBE7BDFE404.title: &5Wand of &7Teleportation
quest.631796E7615C04FA.quest_desc:
The &2Amethyst Crab&r lives in the Lush Caves with the Axolotls. 

It has 1200 &4Hearts&r and is initially neutral. That means it won't attack first but it will hit you back. 

It has a few attacks one being just smacking you with its claws. It can also throw Amethysts at you and burrow under the ground. 

On death it'll drop its meat and shells. Its meat can be blessed in an Altar of Amethyst to be better. The Shells can be crafted together to make Bloom Stone Pauldrons which have similar stats to Netherite Chestplate but can do similar abilities as the &2Crab&r itself.
quest.635BA2C17458E9E6.quest_desc:
For such a simple recipe you actually get a pretty darn useful Machine! 

Simply place it down, (how you place it changes where it aims like a dispenser!) give it some Power, and set how it works with a &4Redstone Torch&r. 

If it's set to deactivate that means it will deactivate when a &4Redstone Signal&r is sent to it. On Pusle that means it will activate whenever a &4Redstone Signal&r is given to it. 

We are just looking to automate the &6&lStar&r so I won't go too in depth, we'll start with a Lens!
quest.63768C7B988ED22B.title: &d&lClarent
quest.63AE4568375DD1BF.quest_desc: With &dGarmonbozia&r, we can now create our own &aEnvironmental Accumulator&r.
quest.63C95FDAA447CA47.quest_desc:
The only recipe which needs &3&lTier 2&r, the &7Terrastomp Prism&r! 

You'll need &7Dripstone&r, &7Dripstone&r, and &8Flint&r along with a &bDiamond Block&r! 

Like the other Prisms this will need &3Elementarium&r Relic in order to be made. 
Like the &cFiery Prism&r, the &7Terrastomp Prism&r can be used with Tools. These Tools will be able to mine in a 3x3 Area, instead of only 1 Block Mined it'll mine 9!
quest.63D4621C06BA747C.quest_desc: Same Damage as Wood Weapons but &2Skyroot&r gives Double Drops. \n\n&2Skyroot Sword&r will give twice the Drops from Mobs and &2Skyroot Axe&r will give twice the amount of Logs from &2Trees&r.
quest.63D4621C06BA747C.title: &2Skyroot&r Weapons
quest.63DD7F5A4441ACE7.quest_desc: Tier 2 Glyphs require 5 levels of experience to be made. \n\nThey also require a &9Mage's Spell Book&r to create.
quest.63E4529AF8894018.title: &lModular Routers
quest.63F5314A1072FA05.title: &e&lSawmill
quest.63F6F4EBCEB914B0.quest_desc:
The &3Pressure Chamber&r is an important multiblock structure made up of &3Pressure Chamber Walls&r (The faces can be replaced with &3Pressure Chamber Glass&r). The Pressure Chamber can be as small as a 3x3x3 multiblock, or as big as a 5x5x5 multiblock. The blocks required for the 5x5x5 is what's needed to complete this quest.

To use the Pressure Chamber you will need to pipe pressure into a &3Pressure Chamber Valve&r using the &3Pressure Tubes&r you made earlier, remember to put a Security Upgrade into the Pressure Valve. &lDifferent recipes require different amounts of pressure&r.

You'll need to be able to input and output items to and from the Pressure Chamber, this is where &3Pressure Chamber Interfaces&r come into it. Blue on the outside means it's for importing items, while if gold is on the outside it's for outputing items, place one of each on any face.
quest.641C74BFA03BC01F.title: &bGlacite Shield
quest.6434796EAAF2A4EC.quest_desc:
After completing all of these Quests you can Right Click the &5Queen&r for the Essence of Bees. 

&lEat it!&r 

Now you can basically do anything here. You can safely take &6Honey&r from all &eHives&r, &6Honeycombs&r, and &6Honey Slimes&r. You can walk through Cell Maze without Wrath of the Hive, you can go into the &5Throne Pillar&r without Mining Fatigue, and you can walk over Ancient Wax without the horrible Effects. And when you enter &6Fluid Honey&r or Royal Jelly you'll get amazing Effects. 

The best part is that it sticks with you even after Death! Now you can enter the endgame!
quest.645380EA38544D3B.title: &bGlacite Shovel
quest.64860340A5BEBAB9.quest_desc:
&eTable Cloths&r can either be used to show off &eItems&r, or to sell off &eItems&r! 

To set up a Shop, do all the steps from the previous Quest: placing &eStock Links&f, &eStock Tickers&r, and a Mob on a Seat or &cBlaze Burner&r. 

Now use a &eTable Cloth&r to Interact with the Mob or &cBlaze Burner&r, this will bind the &eTable Cloth&r to that &eStock Ticker&r. 

Place down the &eTable Cloth&r and you'll be able to place the &eItems&r you want to sell on top, and the price below. 

When someone buys an &eItem&r, it will send a message to the &eStock Link&r, which will &ePackage&f the &eItems&r bought and take the price.
quest.649167FC31EB916E.quest_desc: &3Vegetable Oil&r can be made by putting either crops or seeds into a &3Thermopneumatic Processing Plant&r.
quest.64B6E1ABD471CF29.title: &7Deepsilver Boots
quest.64D0E66CB4FBEC82.quest_desc:
To get started, you'll need to craft yourself a &6Novice Spellbook&r! 

This is where you create and store your spells. 

Hitting the &9C&r key will open up the 'Create a Spell' page. On the left, there are several tabs, but the main 3 are: Spell Creation, Color Picker, and Familiars. 

This spellbook will only allow you to create and use Tier 1 Glyphs. To create better spells, you'll need to upgrade your Spellbook!
quest.64D34A6C3487C5DF.quest_desc: The &3Aerial Interface&r can be used to refill your pressurizable things with pressure. Now you can use your Pneumatic Armor without needing to recharge!\n\nYou will need one of these in order to craft the &6ATM Star&r.
quest.64E85274D24FE394.quest_desc: When connected to your system, the &9Storage Monitor&r will display the current number of an item within your network.
quest.6539582429A70EE8.quest_subtitle: Oritech can use power generated by most sources in this pack
quest.654F5C84114A31A1.quest_desc: Very simple and cheap &e&lIron's Spells&r Armor, helpful for early game!
quest.655FF7295B688354.quest_desc:
The &9Clawdian&r is the miniboss of &9Acropolis&r. 

They are huge lobsters who hold an even bigger Axe! 

They have 2250 &4Hearts&r and 12 Armor Points. 

They like to use their Axe and Feet to Attack you. From swinging their Axe at you to do moderate Damage. To smashing the ground with an Axe to unleash a Shockwave. To stomping on the ground to unleash an even bigger Shockwave and &9Waves&r at you! 

If you get too far they'll charge after you, Breaking Blocks in their way! 

If you can Kill one, they'll Drop their &9Claw&r! Kinda graphic but thankfully it's just fantasy violence!
quest.6581D4AF1A6DE230.quest_desc:
Demons like Candles. I think.

For almost every Ritual to summon our friends, you'll need some Candles. You can create the &aButcher Knife&r and kill some pigs, cows, sheep, horses, or even the Trader Llamas to get some &aTallow&r to make them. Matter of fact, you should definitely find the Trader Llamas. I hear they make good candles. &mI totally didn't just make that up&r.

Otherwise, Vanilla Candles can also work!

&9Spirit Attuned Crystals&r are also used in several Rituals, so might as well make some now!
quest.65A529C8238E89F1.quest_desc: Thanks to &5&lMekanism&r we can now make Armor out of &9Lapis Lazuli&r! \n\nIt kinda blows though...
quest.65BD73DA55BCC624.title: Welcome to Neo Vitae
quest.65C8A43FEDBA3835.quest_desc:
The &3Pattern Grid&r allows you to imprint recipes onto Patterns for your network.

The easiest way to create a recipe for a Pattern is to look up the item in JEI, then click the '+' button on the bottom right of the recipe. This will then place the recipe into the grid.

On the right side, the top slot is used for storing blank Patterns. With a blank Pattern inside, you should be able to click the Arrow underneath to imprint the recipe onto the Pattern.

You'll then want to put the Pattern into an &3Autocrafter&r!
quest.65C8A43FEDBA3835.title: &3Pattern Grid
quest.65D89991A45BC042.quest_desc: Place a Crafting Interfaces on a crafting table and right-click on it, this will give you some slots for &bVariable Cards&r. \n\nUsing the Logic Programmer, search for &eRecipe&r in the top left, and create one for autocrafting, then save it to a &bVariable Card&r. If a recipe &c&lrequires&r items that need to be crafted, create a recipe for each of those, then put everything in the Crafting Interface.
quest.65E2AF881709C896.quest_desc: One of the most important materials you'll be needing is &3Reinforced Stone&r, start by making 32 using Compressed Iron and some regular stone.
quest.65E98FCE27B552F4.quest_desc:
&aHydra Teeth&r are a common Drop from &a&lHydras&r. 

We can use them instead of Flint to instead of making normal Arrows we can make &aHydra Arrows&r. 

&aHydra Arrows&r will give the Mob they Hit, &aPoison&r, and will give you back some &4Health&r they took.
quest.65FA86357BC60573.quest_desc:
It's time to move stuff from one place to another. Here are the steps:

&l1.&r Place an interface on an inventory (like a Chest or a Tank)

&l2.&r Place an Importer or an Exporter on another inventory, depending on whether you want to pull or send stuff to it.

&l3.&r Hook the both up with Cables, place a Variable Card into the Importer or Exporter, and there you go!
quest.6601ACCDDF6CA5FF.quest_desc: The Reactor can only hold 1 Billion OP and while that may seem like a far number, it won't be for long. When Energy Saturation reaches 100%% it will increase Heat a ton which can lead to Meltdown. It will need 500,000,000 OP to activate and a Flux Gate will help limit how much OP comes in and out. (BTW 1 RF = 1 OP) They need Redstone to activate and can be used for both adding OP and taking out OP. You'll need Energy out to not Meltdown, try putting it in an Energy Core!
quest.66039B738CF0718A.title: &3Vibranium&r - &6Allthemodium&r Alloy Ingot
quest.661114AFCBBD5F28.title: &aGraveyard
quest.6616A62426ED4D15.quest_desc: The Injector needs to be on a different side of all the Stabilizers and has to share the same Axis as the Core. This is where OP will need to pumped in from! To activate and make OP the Energy Saturation needs to be raised up a bit. Energy Saturation is the stored Energy and soon to be made Energy.
quest.6647A9652EFDDCDF.quest_desc: To cool down the &#ADF0EEHot Stainless Steel Ingot&r simply put it into a &#56E3DFVacuum Freezer&r to turn it into usable &#ADF0EEStainless Steel Ingot&r.
quest.66536AAF9E98C3A6.title: &9Malarite Hoe
quest.666EA8B8F13EB292.title: &dEmpty Soul Gem
