quest.6674270897997BF7.quest_desc: Allows you to jump higher than usual and makes you springy, making for faster travel.\n\nYou can only have one level of these Upgrades in the Leggings at a time.
quest.66BAC2B478F9B119.title: Top &6&lATM Star&r part
quest.66DE7EF4AFCE4F7A.title: &7Deepsilver Shovel
quest.66E88F916B638B3B.quest_desc:
This one might be a bit confusing, there is quite a few &5Creative &eSpellbooks&r! But the one we want is from &d&lAllTheArcanist Gear&r. 

To make this one we need to craft the one from &l&dArs Nouveau&r. That &eSpellbook&r needs an &eArchmage Spellbook&r, &6&lATM Star&r, and a few extra Items. 

It has the same configs as an &eUnobtainium Spellbook&r but has infinite Mana and all Glyphs unlocked! 

All the Spell Power BWAHAHAHAHA!
quest.66FE4552E09B5EFF.quest_desc:
Prisms are important for many of &6&lForbidden \& Arcanus&r recipes and other Mods later! 

In order to craft them we'll need &3Elementarium&r, which is found in Jungle Temples, Desert Pyramids, and Underwater Ruins. 

I think it would be easier to tell us where you can't find it!
quest.671F7551CBDF462F.title: Highway to Hell
quest.67258590FA14BE44.quest_desc: For 250mB of &9Water&r and 2 &bArcane Crystal Dust&r, in the &b&lRunic Crucible&r, we can get 250mB of &bLiquid Aureal&r! \n\nYou will need 1000 &dLiquefied Source&r to get it started though...
quest.67258590FA14BE44.title: &bLiquid Aureal
quest.672AC964851832EB.title: &7Swamp Silver&r
quest.674E2690D66ECD6E.quest_desc:
When it's a thunderstorm, throwing in a &aWeather Container&r into the &aEnvironmental Accumulator&r will harness the power of the storm.

Using this, we can create items that allow us to control Lightning at will.

You will need a Lightning Bomb to craft the &6ATM Star&r.
quest.6754612E9AD4B9C0.title: Reactor (Blazing)
quest.677A701E06422CF3.quest_desc:
Hidden among the densest trees of &2Forest&r and &2Tropic&r biomes, the &5Leafy Mantle&r awaits the worthy adventurer. Woven from thousands of living &2leaves&r, it allows its wearer to move as if part of the &2forest itself&r. 

- &lIt has 2 abilities:&r 

1. &aCamouflage&r: 
 Move freely within tree leaves, land safely without &cfall damage&r, and &2regenerate&r &chealth&r &o&fslowly&r while in &afoliage&r. 

2. &2Gift of the Grove&r: 
 When facing &cfatal damage&r, the surrounding &2leaves absorb&r the &cblow&r, protecting the wearer from &cdeath&r. The amount of foliage consumed depends on the &cdamage&r received. 

- A &6relic&r of &2nature&r and &agrowth&r… where the forest itself fights for its &9chosen guardian&r.
quest.677A701E06422CF3.title: &2Leafy Mantle
quest.6797E67E0136D96A.quest_desc: &7Holystone&r is everywhere. It is the Stone of &e&lThe Aether&r. \n\nYou'll need a Pickaxe to Mine it, and you can make Tools or Blocks with it.
quest.6797E67E0136D96A.title: &7Holystone
quest.67C76EDD4BCCFF3F.quest_desc:
Through &bStrigeor's Higher Binding&r we can make an &bEmpty Soul Gem&r. 

These can be used to transport Mobs safely, or make the &d&lDragon Soul&r. 

Personally I think we should do both!
quest.67C76EDD4BCCFF3F.title: &bEmpty Soul Gem
quest.67CCEFEBA4D79429.quest_desc: &eDivine Pact&r is the most difficult to obtain, you'll need to search Piglin Villages and Ancient Pyramids in &b&lThe Other&r to find them! \n\nIt's used to craft the Soul Binding Crystal and the End Game Multiblocks!
quest.680D49E2B3929322.quest_desc: I can't tell you what Nature's Healing is.
quest.680D49E2B3929322.title: &eVitality Ankh
quest.68318811CCC28320.quest_desc: Combining &cHardened Blood Shards&r with &9Dark Power Gems&r will make Blood Infusion Cores.\n\n&9Blood Infusion Cores&r are the main crafting components of several machines in EvilCraft.
quest.68498ADEF9765F81.quest_desc: To make Crystallized Menril Chunks you first need to place some Menril Logs in a Squeezer. Jump on the Squeezer to turn them into Menril Resin.\n\nYou can empty the Squeezer by giving it a Redstone signal.
quest.6852BEFDD4DE4E4B.quest_desc:
&9Soul-Touched Deepshelves&r are an upgrade to &9Deepshelves&r. 

They are Crafted with a &bSoul Lantern&r and 3 &3Sculk Blocks&r. You'll need &5Silk Touch&r to pick up &3Sculk Blocks&r. 

Then, we can Craft our &9Soul-Touched&r version. These will give a ton more &cQuanta&r at &c15%&r! 

It also increases max &aEterna&r to &a75&r.
quest.6852BEFDD4DE4E4B.title: &9Soul-Touched Deepshelf
quest.687C51D915339086.title: &aFlowglaze Shield
quest.6884E25641A1020C.title: &5Enchantment Library
quest.68972BA647FDCF8F.quest_desc: If you know &l&6Productive Bees&r you should know LobsterJonn. He made &l&6Productive Bees&r and &lGenerator's Galore&r (along with many others). The &6Honey Generator&r is a good way of connecting both these mods! &6Honey Generator&r uses &6Liquid Honey&r to make Energy.
quest.68972BA647FDCF8F.title: &6Honey Generator
quest.6904EC449FBEE387.title: Cables
quest.69201157ECFBB426.quest_desc: I always hate when I have an &5Endermen&r Farm for either XP or Apotheosis Gems but end up with all these &3Ender Pearls&r (hehe end up, &3ender pearls&r). Now you can use those &3Ender Pearls&r for Energy with the &3Ender Generator&r. You can even make &aEyes of Ender&r for even more Energy!
quest.69201157ECFBB426.title: &3Ender Generator
quest.692183ACBB2AABF7.quest_desc:
Relics are rare finds around your &2&lMinecraft&r World! 

They can be used in your &6&lForge&r, in the squares around the center slot, these open up more the more you upgrade the Tiers! 

Or you can use them in the &l&bClibano&r. 

Some are Creative Mode only, don't worry we know how much you love your OP Items and will be looking into ways of adding them!
quest.69439426534EBDC4.quest_desc:
&bBlazing Grips&r are another Item we can make with &bIgnitium&r! 

It is a Curios Item that goes on your Hands. 

When worn, all attacks have a chance of giving the recipient &bBlazing Brand&r. 

This decreases Armor and Armor Toughness, and it sucks to get from the &b&lIgnis&r.
quest.695889817162EFC7.quest_desc:
&aEXP&r is very important for &5&lApotheosis Enchanting&r! Every &5Enchant&r requires it! (Why do you think I give it in every Reward?) 

With &d&lInfusion&r we can transform &6Honey Bottles&r into &aBottles O' Enchanting&r. Actually we get 3 different &d&lInfusions&r for it! It goes from 1 &aBottle O' Enchanting&r, to 8, to 32! 

First, is for 1 &aBottle&r and needs only 2 &9Echoing Sculkshelves&r. 

Second, is for 8 &aBottles&r and needs 5 &9Echoing Sculkshelves&r and 1 &9Soul-Touched Sculkshelf&r. 

Last, is for 32 &aBottles O' Enchanting&r and will need 5 &9Echoing Sculkshelves&f, 3 &9Soul-Touched&f, and 1 &dDraconic Endshelf&r!
quest.69763C2E2F454A73.quest_desc:
&c&lFire&r is obviously related to &cFire&r. Most of the Scrolls are with using &cFire&r to burn and hurt things. 

&c&lFire's&r Focus Material is &cBlaze Rods&r. You can craft &cFire Runes&r or get them from killing the &c&lPyromancer&r. 

Its &cScrolls&r are &cLight Red&r with &8Grey&r text.
quest.699C6DDE6B2D51C1.quest_desc: &2Jinglestem Trees&r grow underwater... I wonder if there's any Trees like that in real life? \n\nThey have &2Algaeleaves&r, instead of normal Leaves.
quest.699C6DDE6B2D51C1.title: &2Jinglestem Trees&f?
quest.69B5D716568AA9EB.title: &d&lCamol
quest.69B7DE2283B4EE6C.quest_desc: The &bCrafting Co-Processing Unit&f helps speed up crafting jobs by allowing pattern providers to either send items out to their connected devices faster or to work concurrently to make multiple required ingredients.\n\nThe base AE2 co-processor provides one co-processor 'thread' to assist this, while the co-processing unit from &dMEGA Cells&f provides 4 threads in a single such block.
quest.69EA17CEB4203C96.quest_desc:
This is a give and take situation. 

While wearing this &3Amulet&r you'll do 10% more Damage, but you'll lose 25% of your Armor. 

I wonder what happens if you aren't wearing Armor then?
quest.69EA17CEB4203C96.title: &3Berserker Soul Amulet
quest.69ECE13A6E5503CD.quest_desc:
With new updates we can now find smaller (and slightly less dangerous) Structures from &4&lCataclysm&r. 

There's only ones related to the &eCursed Pyramid&r and &3Frosted Prison&r for now. 

All of these Structures have new Accessory Items which only spawn at these Structures. 

Some are worn on normal Accessory parts, while others will need you to wear this Belt in order to equip them!
quest.69ECE13A6E5503CD.title: New Accessories
quest.69EE22CB4FF1E591.quest_desc:
&aContraptions&r are very difficult to understand but pretty much it is the art of combining different Blocks and &6Machines&r into one moving systems. 

You'll need &6Machines&r to actually move the &aContraption&r like &aLinear Chasis&r, you'll need the &6Machines&r you want to work like &6Drills&r, and you'll need &aGlue&r to hold it all together! 

Once it is all &aGlued&r it should move when &dRotational Power&r is given to the moving &6Machine&r of the &aContraption&r.
quest.69F7A0DE8D70AC44.quest_desc:
The &#DBA15ASteam Drill&r, despite being from &#A0DE45Modern Industrialization&r, will be your best friend for early game mining, only requiring a &#6E6D6DForge Hammer&r to be able to be crafted. It is able to do a &53 by 3&r mining area as well as have a &#EEF768toggle-able silk touch&r.

You can toggle &53 by 3&r mining by pressing the keybind "Toggle 3x3 Mining" which is default set to &7'Y'&r.

&#EEF768Silk Touch&r can be toggled by &7Sneak Right-Clicking&r the Steam Drill

To fill the &#DBA15ASteam Drill&r, you can hold the drill over a &6fuel&r in your inventory and &7Right-Click&r. &9Water&r can be either &7Right-Clicked&r in world or you can carry a water bucket around.
quest.6A1145678E80FB8E.quest_desc: There's so many useless &5Enchantments&r out there, why not get some Energy out of them! The &bEnchantment Generator&r uses &5Enchanted Books&r to make Energy. The Level and Rarity of &5Enchanted Books&r changes the amount of Energy you get from them.
quest.6A1145678E80FB8E.title: &bEnchantment Generator
quest.6A12188E50EAEB78.quest_desc:
The &zRainbow Furnaces&r will smelt a stack of Items at a time! 

To craft it you will need a &zRainbow Core&r which needs 2 &cNetherite Furnaces&r and all the colors of the &zrainbow&r in Glass! 

Then, you'll need &zRainbow Plating&r which you get from combining almost every other Furnace in the mod. You'll need 2 of them to craft the &3&lImprobable Probablility Device&r.
quest.6A1C0B17B22CE50F.quest_desc: The &9Amulet of Mana Boost&r gives a boost to max mana. \n\nThe &6Amulet of Mana Regen&r gives a boost to your mana regen.
quest.6A46A9F04D2A0748.quest_desc: Direwolf is a name synonymous with Modded Minecraft and &3&lJust Dire Things&r is one of his babies. \n\nIt revolves around Goo, yeah I know sounds enticing!
quest.6A46A9F04D2A0748.title: &3&lJust Dire Things
quest.6A715F4AE22D2439.quest_desc:
Within &c&lThe Nether&r lies the breach between the Physical and Spiritual World. The Ghostly Mantle. 

The Ghostly Mantle allows us to use the Supernatural to fight off enemies. From taking power from those who dare to look at us, to barely escaping Death. 

&l- It has 3 Abilities&r 

1. Grave Mist: 
Everywhere you Walk you'll leave a Mist. Any Mobs or Players in that Mist will start Suffocating as if they were stuck in Blocks. 

2. &bFrozen Gaze&r: 
If a Mob or Player looks at the wearer from 30 Blocks or closer, they'll start gaining Weakness. The longer they look, the worse it gets. 

3. &7Spectral Escape&r: 
Every little bit, an Attack that would Kill you gets negated and you'll enter a &7Spectral Form&r. You'll become Invunerable for few Seconds after. 

- A &6Relic&r where you Walk between Worlds for your own Protection.
quest.6A715F4AE22D2439.quest_subtitle: Ability to cross between Spiritual and Physical
quest.6A715F4AE22D2439.title: Ghostly Mantle
quest.6A962535CD68713E.quest_desc:
&e&lPipez&r move more! 

All Upgrades increase the amount the &e&lPipez&r move and also grant more options to use with the &e&lPipe&r. 

Basic Upgrade allows Redstone Activation with &e&lPipez&r, to change distribution either:Closest First, Farthest First, Round-Robin, or Random, and to add Filters.

Improved, Advanced, and Ultimate upgrades don't grant anything new they just move more!
quest.6ADDFD55AD0DF7D4.quest_desc: Combining &9Ridiculite Ingots&r with &cRossinite&r in a &aReprocessor&r will create &dInanite Ingots&r.\n\nWe can now use these to make a block of &dInanite&r.
quest.6ADDFD55AD0DF7D4.title: Inanite
quest.6B3328B6AE8704D2.quest_desc: &bLightning Knives&r are thrown projectiles that will summon Lightning wherever they Hit! \n\nThey'll be used up when thrown though so use them wisely.
quest.6B3328B6AE8704D2.title: &bLightning Knife
quest.6B40AF49F505A551.quest_desc:
Hidden in the vast stretches of the &2Overworld&r, the &cRoller Skate&r awaits the daring &2adventurer&r. Once worn, each step &cpulls&r the wearer forward, turning motion into &cunstoppable momentum&r. 

- It has 1 ability: 

 &bAcceleration&r: 
 While &crunning continuously&r, the wearer gradually gains &bmovement speed&r, reaching the &cmaximum bonus&r after a &2few seconds&r. The faster you go, the more &2slippery&r surfaces become, adding both &cthrill&r and &crisk&r. 

- A &6relic&r of &cspeed&r and &6momentum&r… where every &astide&r leaves a trail of &cfire&r behind.
quest.6B40AF49F505A551.title: &cRoller Skate
quest.6B5B01C612951BAF.title: &zGate Pearl - Endless Gateway of Apothic Invaders
quest.6B5BC33667C782EC.quest_desc:
The &dEnder Golem&r keeps guard of the &dRuined Citadel&r, well multiple of them do. 

Technically you don't need to fight them to fight the &dEnder Guardian&r but you definitely should to get the &dVoid Core&r. 

The &dEnder Golem&r has 3000 &4Hearts&r and will regenerate them when left alone. 

He has a few attacks like being able to punch you and smashing the ground. When he smashing the ground, &dVoid Runes&r will spawn, hurting any Player or Mob that touches them.
quest.6B747129A85AA768.quest_desc: Now even more like the Absorption Hopper! \n\nVacuum Module will now pickup XP Orbs as well as Items. Whatever you do with the XP is up to you!
quest.6B7C016407F7AE3C.quest_desc: Normal weapons cannot hit &dVengeance Spirits&r. So what can we do to kill them?\n\nWe fire a Piercing Vengeance Beam at them. Hold Right Click while holding the Piercing Vengeance Focus in either hand to fire the beam.
quest.6B7E13AB3BF2C5C8.title: &6&lThermoelectric Boiler
quest.6BA2BC09E23B34A9.title: &l&dTier 4 &6Forge
quest.6BD348735C27BB44.title: &b&lBottling Machine
quest.6BFF78D4218DF1F2.title: Stellarite Bee
quest.6C16670D16113DE9.quest_desc:
In order to automate &6&lATM Star&r crafting, we'll need &6Star Shards&r. In order to get &6Star Shards&r we'll need &6Starry Bees&r. 

And of course, to get &6Starry Bees&r we'll need &dPatrick &aBees&r! You can rarely get &dPatrick &aBees&r by fishing in Warm Oceans! 
If you don't wish to convert them, you can also farm &dPatrick &aStars&r with them.
quest.6C1F7A0B330B3F42.quest_desc:
The &a&lMekaSuit &f&mChestplate&r &a&lBodyarmor&r, will be an upgrade to &5Unobtainium &f&mBodyarmor&r &5Chestplate&r. 

It will need a few other &eItems&r in order to upgrade it though, like an &dAntimatter Pellet&r, &aPolonium Pellets&r, and even an &dUltimate Induction Cell&r! 

The &a&lMekaSuit Bodyarmor&r without &aEnergy&r will act just like a &cNetherite Chestplate&r. What about with &aEnergy&r? It might just block all Damage besides Magic Damage and will use &aEnergy&r instead of Health! 

We can toss it into a &7&lModification Station&r in order to add &7Module Units&r which can upgrade it! The &a&lMekaSuit Bodyarmor&r has the most &7Module Units&r of all the Armor, so definitely check them out!
quest.6C1F7A0B330B3F42.title: &a&lMekaSuit Bodyarmor
quest.6C5F9D0D447EFB9C.quest_desc:
What you think &l&2Vanilla&r was all we got? 

&6Allthemodium Armor&r has more Armor Points and Armor Toughness, plus increased Protection against Magic and other buffs you can read about in &6&lAllthemodium&r Quest Page! 

BTW you will need &cNetherite&r to craft it.
quest.6C5F9D0D447EFB9C.title: &6Allthemodium Armor
quest.6C8766679D0AA8F6.quest_desc:
This Weapon will 1 Hit Pigs, Piglins, and Zombified Piglins. 

2 Hit Hoglins and Zoglins. 

3 Hit Piglin Brutes.
quest.6C8766679D0AA8F6.title: &dPig Slayer
quest.6CA01DCE1F4A0EC3.quest_desc: The next stage of the mod requires the collection of &3Crude Oil&r. This Oil can be found naturally on the surface of the overworld.
quest.6CD7D99AA102A5C3.quest_desc:
&n&f&lLogistics&r: 
A system of moving, managing, and storing items or resources. 

In Modded Minecraft it's quite the same, moving items! With Modded you will need items and by the thousands, heck if you want the &6&lStar&r it gets in the millions! So you'll need to move items from factories, machines, farms, and especially chests. That's what &l&fLogistics&r is for.
quest.6D0876A402C22067.quest_desc: XyCraft has some item storage and manipulation. Not as much as fluid storage and manipulation though!
quest.6D124ACF4AE80490.quest_desc: With Micromissiles you can shoot explosions from far away! Now nobody can escape!\n\nTheses are needed to craft the &6ATM Star&r.
quest.6D1E8399AD39FFC8.quest_desc: The &7Paradox Machine&r can, for a price of a lot of Power and &aTime Fluid&r, take a Snapshot of blocks and entities in the designated area; then it can duplicate it. \n\nLots of Blocks and Entities are blacklisted by configs so no duplicating Bees!
quest.6D2425DAEA1FC211.quest_desc:
The &cSun Altar&r can change the time of &e&lThe Aether&r. 

Yeah even though there is no Daylight Cycle in &l&eThe Aether&r, this little Block can change it. 

Just scroll to whenever you want! 

If you turn it Nighttime then you can use a Bed in &l&eThe Aether&r to set a Respawn Point.
quest.6D2425DAEA1FC211.title: &cSun Altar
quest.6D738730B371B152.quest_desc:
The &l&7Mining Dimension&r is a Superflat world with absolutely nothing on the surface. 

Below the surface is almost every single Ore. 

The &7&lMining Dimension&r has no Caves, no Mob Spawns, and nothing to get in your way. It's just Stone types and Ores! 

Ore spawns differ for the Y Level and layer in the &7&lMining Dimension&r.

I recommend setting up a Quarry.
quest.6D738730B371B152.title: &l&7Mining Dimension
quest.6D88C19F47D0D469.title: Tier: &7Tiny
quest.6DB65926EE6D6C2E.quest_desc:
These &cTracks Kits&r are for changing momentum with your &7Carts&r. 

The &cTransition Kits&r change the speed of the passing &5Locomotive&r, needs redstone power. 
The &cBooster Kits&r will speed up the &7Cart&r if powered and slow down the &7Cart&r if not powered. 
The &cControl Kit&r gives the &7Carts&r a little push, when powered it'll change the direction it pushes it in. 
The &cThrottle Kit&r will change the speed of a passing &5Locomotive&r to whatever speed is configured, needs to be powered with redstone. 
The &cLauncher Kit&r will quite literally throw your &7Cart&r!
quest.6DB65926EE6D6C2E.title: &cTrack Kits&r for moving &7Carts&r
quest.6DBD81BA83B1D0A5.title: Draconic Capacitor
quest.6DCC11671A2BAA1C.quest_desc:
Rarely in the Forests of the &9&lStarlight&r you can come across &cBirds&r. 
If you Feed 2 &cBirds&r some Seeds near a Nest, they'll change from &cBirds&r to love birds. 

Not really, but they'll both cuddle in their Nest. After that they will leave you a gift. Sometimes that gift will be...
quest.6DCC11671A2BAA1C.title: The birds and the... birds?
quest.6E04A314CD796254.quest_desc: What does every Magic Mod need? Did you say a gun! I hope you said a gun! \n\nThe Nobu is a gun, which of course has 3 different firing Modes.
quest.6E04A314CD796254.title: &5&lNobu
quest.6E05B62A40D5A891.title: &3&lIntegrated Dynamics
quest.6E0624750DF8CD18.quest_desc: Can't craft these anymore now you need to upgrade &cNetherite&r to it always. \nYes, it saves Enchantments and Repairs it!
quest.6E0624750DF8CD18.title: &6Allthemodium Tools
quest.6E0E13806F388D7E.quest_desc: Welcome to &aArs Nouveau&f! \n\nArs Nouveau is a magic mod that allows you to create custom spells with the different Glyphs made within the mod!
quest.6E12C5DDF81DE88F.quest_desc:
This one is very helpful against Bosses. 

Some Hits will Stun you, when Stunned you can't move or fight back. 

This &eSkull&r will protect you from that. Once, per cooldown.
quest.6E12C5DDF81DE88F.title: &eUnbreakable Skull
quest.6E17595887A051C2.quest_desc:
&l&2Modded Minecraft&r introduces us to new Villager Professions! 

Forge Hammer: &5Industrialist&r 

Charger: &bFluix Researcher&r 

Advanced Beehive: &6Beekeeper&r 

Coffee Maker: &9Engineer&r 

Arcane Core: &dShady Wizard&r 

Foragers Table: &aForager&r 

Powered Rolling Machine: &eCartman&r 
Manual Rolling Machine: &eTrackman&r 

Engineer's Workbench: &7Gunsmith&r 
White Banner: &7Outfitter&r 
Engineer's Circuit Workbench: &7Electrician&r 
Engineer's Crafting Table: &7Machinist&r 
Turntable: &7Structural Engineer&r 

Charging Station: &4Pressure Mechanic&r 

Saw: &8Carpenter&r
quest.6E3AD764A67829CB.quest_desc:
Like its inferior brother, the &bInfusion Crystal&r, the &cMaster Infusion Crystal&r does everything the former can as well. 

This one just has Infinite Uses and can upgrade 4 Blocks of Essence to the next one in Block form! 

It does require &cSupremium&r to make it, but trust me it's worth it!
quest.6E3AD764A67829CB.title: &cMaster Infusion Crystal
quest.6E7C4228CD2B6BB9.quest_desc: This &4Crowbar&r has a few different modes, each with change the design of a &5Locomotive&r. From default which is described while hovering over the item in your inventory, none which goes to &7grey&r, &6H&r&5a&r&6l&r&5l&r&6o&r&5w&r&6e&r&5e&r&6n&r which makes it spooky, and &cC&r&2h&r&cr&r&2i&r&cs&r&2t&r&cm&r&2a&r&cs&r which makes it festive!
quest.6E7C8537D8A28833.title: Depths
quest.6ECDD26CCCBC07C3.title: &6Allthemodium Armor
quest.6ECDD55D55D4D44E.title: &5Starfall Longbow
quest.6EF206A0BD5BAC0A.quest_desc:
&5Epic&r is finally climbing more to the overpowered side. 

&5Epic&r appears after &lWorld Tier: &2Frontier&r and is most common in &lWorld Tier: &4Pinnacle&r. 

&5Arcane Sands&r are made from using &5Epic&r &eItems&r in a &c&lSalvaging Table&r.
quest.6F183B06683D1213.quest_desc: The &#EBA844Kanthal Hot Ingot&r can be cooled down using the &#6DC0F7Vacuum Freezer&r.
quest.6F3602F5600A6221.quest_desc: Tier 3 Glyphs require 10 levels of experience to be made. \n\nThey also require an &6Archmage Spell Book&r.
quest.6F483B77D64F4EE2.title: Rogdorium Grove
quest.6F57BE412A7BE84E.quest_desc:
&9Corrupt Souls&r are used for 2 things! 

1. Crafting recipe with the &l&dTier 4 &6Forge&r, which we don't need to worry about right now. 

2. Growing Edelwood! 

Growing Edelwood acts as the Sapling for Edelwood, these are the only way of getting Edelwood now.
quest.6F5F6BAB09CB4F5E.title: &9Malarite Spear
quest.6F67079A453DAABE.quest_desc: The &cCharm of Life I&r is a single-use item that will prevent death. Instead of dying, the charm will be consumed and you'll be given health regen for a short period of time.\n\nThese can be found in loot chests.
quest.6F71FD826C29C31A.quest_desc: This one might be new to ones returning from earlier versions. By using a Rune of Youth on a Spawner, it will only spawn in baby versions of the mobs in it. This only works with Vanilla baby versions of mobs, not modded.
quest.6F76DA3BBAE8337B.quest_desc:
The greatest Armor we can get from &6&lAllthemodium&r, &5Unobtainium&r! 

Now with 100% Knockback Resistance and higher stats everywhere! 

Also needs &3Vibranium Armor&r to make it.
quest.6FE6F50029D690C0.title: &9Tide Trident
quest.6FEED25FFAC4101F.quest_desc: Using &aStrigeor's Higher Binding&r, you can create Gray Paste. Smear this on a piece of Impure White Chalk to create Gray Chalk.
quest.6FFFAE334DFAAAAB.title: Iesnium Ritual Bowl
quest.702FC3E5D0D6C31F.quest_subtitle: What you do with that power is yours to decide.
quest.702FC3E5D0D6C31F.title: Tier V: The Pinnacle
quest.7040CA41C0A3C2F2.title: &9PCB Blueprint
quest.705AEEDA95C52C99.quest_desc:
The &b&lFreezer&r does as the name suggests, it &bFreezes&r certain objects. 

&9Water &fto &bIce&f, &bIce &fto &bPacked Ice&f, &bPacked Ice &fto &9Blue Ice&r, and &cLava &fto &5Obsidian&r. 

There's also Ice Rings and Pendants! 

The &b&lFreezer&r uses Icestone as Fuel.
quest.705AEEDA95C52C99.title: &b&lFreezer
quest.70A82A5D17D558FB.title: &bEnergy Sword
quest.70CCE558E03227AB.title: &l&6Runic Star Altar
quest.70D2718D54785867.title: The Crucible's Greed
quest.70D2C5FAC661E01A.title: &bHeart-Forged Seashelf
quest.70F8A8D6C442F2B6.title: &aFlowglaze Hoe
quest.710C7FEFAA6C0979.quest_desc: Upgraded version of the Wyvern Sword.
quest.711826BBCA832EE2.quest_desc:
All &8Casts&r are made equal. In another sense I mean they are made the same way. 

By Pouring &8Steel&r onto an Item in a &8Casting Table&r! 

How do we make &8Steel&r you ask? Simply Melt down any &8Steel&r Items or Ingots. Or you can Alloy 9 &7Iron&r to 10 &0Coal&r. 

Alloying will happen when the &c&lFoundry&r is &6Heated&r and the right amounts of different &7Liquid Metals&r are in it. These two &7Liquid Metals&r will combine into one &7Liquid Metal&r!
quest.713548E540B18E07.title: &9Moonring Bow
quest.713EF442D59501BA.quest_desc: The &5Chain of &9Souls&r can be crafted from drops by &9&lLunar Monstrosity&r. \n\nIt's a grappling hook! Tap Right Click to send it and once it hits something it will start reeling you in. Then, you have to Right Click again to detach it.
quest.713EF442D59501BA.title: &5Chain of &9Souls
quest.714960DF26EFFA53.quest_desc: All the &5Tools&r will Mine Blocks faster when they lose Durability. \n\nAlso the &5Pickaxe&r can Mine &dGravitite&r.
quest.714960DF26EFFA53.title: &5Zanite&r Tools
quest.7154D73516548149.quest_desc:
&6&lAllthemodium&r is a mod added specifically by the &6AllTheMods Team&r to add more content after Netherite! 

You'll need to adventure through it to get some Items needed for the &6&lATM Star&r. 

There is a Quest page now that you can follow for it!
quest.7154D73516548149.title: &l&6Allthemodium
quest.71581992E8E4C43E.quest_desc: Throw a few &8Wither Skeleton Skulls&r and an &dAbjuration Essence&r to make a &8Wither &3Glyph&r! \n\nIf it didn't work you might need more &aEXP&r.
quest.71581992E8E4C43E.title: &3Glyph of &8Wither
quest.718DABA6C9E5982A.quest_desc: Grants the player Night Vision when worn.
quest.7198ED7E97A256A4.quest_desc:
The first special crafted Divination Rod is the Abundant Material Rod! 

When you craft the Rod with an &eAlchemical Sulfur&r of an Item, the Rod will be attuned to that Item. 

You can see the list for Abundant Materials in the Tags, it's too big for me to read off in Quests.
quest.71A1FD0772453B51.quest_desc:
Don't you hate Right Clicking everything? From Sheeps with Shears to Cows with Buckets? It's the 21st Century we should have Robots to everything! Or atleast Routers do everything. 

With Activator Module it will act as if it were you Right Clicking things. 

You can set what it will Right Click, if it will Attack or Use the Mob or Block, if you Shift Right Click, and how close they need to be in the Module.
quest.71B72958B9F80355.quest_desc:
Don't worry there's no more dropping at this stage! 

Now we just need to craft! Craft the Lens of &3Certain Death&r, with a &bDiamond Sword&r, and &5Enchanted Book of Sharpness V&r. 

You can get the &5Enchanted Books&r from the &5&lRunic Enchanter&r! Which you can learn more in another Quest!
quest.71C58666D4BC2508.title: &eSaltpeter Matchbox
quest.71E0D06EA65172CF.title: Throwing Daggers
quest.71E4FD61787DE299.title: &6Allthemodium Smithing Template
quest.7208CB011F6E2ACF.quest_desc:
Can be found in structures in the &l&6Bumblezone&r or traded for with the &5Bee Queen&r! 

These Carpenter Bee Boots truly are incredible, you can wall-run or jump farther off of Wood Planks, Leaves, and &6Honey Blocks&r. 

Also while holding Shift the Boots will Mine the Block beneath you.
quest.72133DD1B3237493.quest_desc: The &4Vampire Blade&r has Lifesteel. \n\nWhen Dealing Damage you'll Heal a little bit of &4Hearts&r in return!
quest.72133DD1B3237493.title: &4Vampire Blade
quest.723F67A9C6993018.title: &bUltra Disk Interface
quest.72489FB9D9A5A24B.quest_desc:
Can be found in structures in the &l&6Bumblezone&r or traded for with the &5Bee Queen&r! 

These Carpenter Bee Boots truly are incredible, you can wall-run or jump farther off of Wood Planks, Leaves, and &6Honey Blocks&r. 

Also while holding Shift the Boots will Mine the Block beneath you.
quest.7297391D026EE9A6.quest_desc: Want something exciting and new to make Energy? What about using &dPotions&r for it! That's what the &dPotion Generator&r does, it will take your &dPotions&r and make Energy out of it depending on its strength and duration.
quest.7297391D026EE9A6.title: &dPotion Generator
quest.72989212DD45DC10.quest_desc:
To find this egg, you'll need to brush away &aSuspicious Sand&r in Warm Ocean Ruins.

You can place the Egg into the world and it will slowly hatch into a &dSnifflet&r. This takes around 20 minutes to hatch normally, but can be placed on a Moss block to double the hatch speed, taking only 10 minutes to hatch.

The Snifflet will eventually grow into an adult &dSniffer&r that can sniff up items like &2Torchflower Seeds&r or &2Pitcher Pods&r when they wander over blocks they can dig in.

You can breed 2 adult Sniffers by using Torchflowers.
quest.72AE56D34834D28E.quest_desc: Another one from PneumaticCraft? Oh this one is the actual Spawner I see. Like the Draconic Stabilized Spawner you'll need a Vanilla Spawner first. Once you have one, place a Spawner Extrator above the Spawner and give it below -0.5 Bars to get it to work. Once it's done it'll give you a Spawner Core filled with whatever mob was in it and it will leave you with an Empty Spawner. Then use the Empty Spawner to craft a Pressurized Spawner and then put the Spawner Core into it. (To upgrade the Core use a Vacuum Trap to suck up the mobs that will go into the Spawner Core). Once you do that the Spawner will now need Pressure to work, ignores Light Level, and is Redstone Activated.
quest.72F57D77C3FB366D.quest_desc: Blocks of Crystallized Menril can be crafted into Crystallized Menril Chunks. These chunks are the main crafting ingredient of ID.
quest.72F57D77C3FB366D.title: Crystallized Menril Chunks
quest.72FB345F3A7E7288.quest_desc:
&5Lightning Dragonsteel&r is made by combining &5Lightning Dragon Blood&r and &7Iron&r in a &5&lLightning DragonForge&r. 

We can make Weapons with it! These will deal a ton of Damage, plus will Summon &5Lightning&r on every Hit. 

Along with the Weapons also comes Armor. This Armor gives a ton of Stats, and looks great! Plus it Protects us extra from the &5Dragons Elemental Attacks&r! 

Why just get Armor for us though? What about our &5&lDragons&r too! This costs a ton more, but will give a ton of Protection for your &5&lDragon&r especially against other &5&lDragons&r.
quest.72FB345F3A7E7288.title: &5Lightning Dragonsteel
quest.7305EE0F7D73C231.quest_desc:
Blank Upgrades are the base of all abilities. Abilities are separated into two types, passive and active.

Passive abilities require no active input by the player to work, however Active abilities only work when triggered by a keybind players set in the configuration menu, also active abilities consume durability/power when used. When installed on higher tier armor Active abilities have reduced cooldowns and Passived abilities have greater effects.

The smithing table is used to apply upgrades to JDT tools and armor. Holding shift when hovering over JDT tools or armor shows what upgrades are valid.
quest.73201E591C2A40CC.quest_desc: Now that you got &6Star Shards&r, you can start making the different parts to remake our &6&lStars&r! \n\nYou'll need 262 &6Star Shards&r total to remake 1 &6&lStar&r... hope you've got a good Bee set up!
quest.73201E591C2A40CC.title: &6Star Shards&r
quest.7322332BB6CF5CF7.title: &7Deepsilver Brush
quest.73391A08D7615C77.title: Bind a Novicius Orb
quest.73A56DD4AC1B9590.quest_desc:
Whenever you Hit a Mob while falling down you'll deal a Critical Hit. 

These do a ton more Damage. 

While wearing this &3Ring&r, you'll do even more Damage!
quest.73A56DD4AC1B9590.title: &3Ring of Grudged
quest.73BE1EB3E69814E9.quest_desc:
First and easiest part of this recipe is &5Evil Sticks&r. Just need &8Dark Gems&r which you Mine for, and &cUndead Planks&r which you get from &cUndead Trees&r. 

Next, is the &5Empowered Inverted Potentia&r. It's not that hard to make simply craft an &7Inverted Potentia&r then keep it in an &aEnviromental Accumulator&r and have it get struck with Lightning! 

Last part has a huge line of &aEmpty Promises&r; you'll be infusing a whole lot. 

Hope you got plenty of &4Blood&r! Speak of the devil you'll also need to fill the &5Mace&r with &4Blood&r.
quest.73E09ED46A94B812.quest_desc: &4&lPinnacle&r is the final World Tier, which means your &aMax Eterna&r capabilities will go as high as possible, to &a100&r, once reached.\n\n&8At least no gate is necessary this time.&r
quest.73E09ED46A94B812.title: Ahh, &4&lPinnacle&r, at last
quest.7413BB136EF9D6C5.quest_desc: The Mechanical Drying Basin uses energy to dry
quest.744E620B7DEBB483.quest_desc: The &#27CFF5Vacuum Freezer&r will be used to cooldown &#E6AD1EHot Ingots&r or certain fluids for better ratios of items you have already been producing.
quest.745E616E97838D2E.quest_desc:
&lWait!&r Stop the mass genocide of animals it appears that PETA has given a compromise. You stop killing innocent animals and they will give you the &5Creative &4Blood Drop&r! 

With this you can fill any container that needs &4Blood&r infinitely! 

To craft it you'll need 4 &bPromise of Tenacity&r, an &6&lATM Star&r, along with 4 other Items that need to be full of &4Blood&r.
quest.74B0308336F5E017.quest_desc: The &cBlood Chest&r can be used to repair items using &cBlood&r.\n\nHowever, items repaired might become &dCursed&r...
quest.750B6316267CF574.quest_desc: When your Hives are vacant and in the dark you may find a little Bee visitor, the Skeletal Bee. \n\nYou can then feed your new visitor a &8Wither Rose&r to make them a &8Withered Bee&r.
quest.750B6316267CF574.title: &8Withered Comb Block
quest.752DD0BF36B70D88.quest_desc:
Furnaces just aren't fast enough in normal &2&lMinecraft&r, so how do you think they're going to fair in Modded!?

Thankfully &7&lIron Furnaces&r helps speed them up by a lot! 

It also has a Quest page it is just rooming together with &c&lGenerator Galore&r.
quest.752DD0BF36B70D88.title: &7&lIron Furnaces
quest.753B3EF7CC94A6DD.quest_desc: This is a unique drop from &aPlayers&r, including when you die!\n\nYou &ocould&r get this by dying over and over, or by participating in PvP.
quest.754B8F1FBCD983C5.quest_desc:
&eStock Tickers&r can be set to the &eNetwork&r by Right Clicking the &eStock Link &fwith the &eStock Ticker&r in Hand. 

Then, place down the &eStock Ticker&r and give it a &eStock Keeper&r by either placing down a &cBlaze Burner&r or a Mob on a Seat nearby. 

You'll know they are a &eStock Keeper&r by their stereotypical &aGreen&r Visor. We can now Right Click the &eStock Keeper&r to view and order &eItems&r from our &eNetwork&r. 

When you order &eItems&r, they'll be placed into a &ePackage &ffrom a &ePackager &fbelow the &eStock Link&r.
quest.7574A782DCFB87CE.quest_desc: Kivi can be used for a couple of things, mainly for decorations and machines.\n\nYou'll need Kivi for Machine Frames and other machines in XyCraft. It can be used with Xychorium Gems in a Stonecutter for decorative blocks.
quest.7574A782DCFB87CE.title: &l&7Kivi
quest.757B14D08A9A03C4.quest_desc: Like most Modded machines, Iron Furnaces has Configurations. Configs can be found by clicking the Top Left. There will be the Inputs, Outputs, and Redstone activation. The Redstone activation changes when the Furnace will smelt. The top buttons determine if it auto Inputs or Outputs, which means it will automatically move to and from connected Inventories. The boxes are each side of the Furnace and determine whether it Inputs, Outputs, does both, Inputs Fuel, or does nothing. This matters for Items being Piped in or out. The Furnace Settings Linker will copy all of these settings to other Furnaces!
quest.7597D3D06E761759.quest_desc: The &eValkyrie Lance&r is a Melee Weapon with huge Reach! \n\n10 Blocks!
quest.7597D3D06E761759.title: &eValkyrie Lance
quest.759B0D6F8C0CC1EF.title: Tier I: The Ring of Runes
quest.75A66B81C1181F59.quest_desc:
Forgotten Vestiges are tiny ruins of Depthrock Bricks found within the &2&lUndergarden&r. 

Here are plenty of Pots full of Loot! 

Just break them!
quest.75A66B81C1181F59.title: Forgotten Vestige
quest.75C5BFAEADEB486E.quest_desc:
&eValkyrie Armor&r has the same Stats as &cNetherite Armor&r. 

The fun part comes when you wear all of it at the same time: Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots, and Gloves. 

When wearing all 5 parts of it you can hold Space to Fly! Only for a short time though.
quest.75C5BFAEADEB486E.title: &eValkyrie Armor
quest.75DA0A46E41E6690.quest_desc:
A &6Relic&r that can be found anywhere, yet it's one of the rarest. 

&eExperience&r is meant to be shared with the &aExperience Disperser&r. 

&l- It has 1 Ability&r 

&aExperience Dispersion&r: 
Every time a &6Relic&r gains &eRelic Experience&r, all other &6Relics&r will gain &eExperience&r as well. 

- A &6Relic&r that shows generosity.
quest.75DA0A46E41E6690.title: &aExperience Disperser
quest.75EE965CBA598FEA.quest_desc: The recipe may look confusing but trust me it is pretty easy. Craft any &dWireless Terminals&r then craft them together to make the &dUniversal Wireless Terminal&r. \n\nIt will also keep whatever you had on the &dTerminal&r like Extended Patterns, that is very helpful for using &b&lAE2&r but doesn't matter for the &6&lATM Star&r!
quest.75EE965CBA598FEA.title: &dUniversal Wireless Terminal
quest.76062D375E4CC8DD.quest_desc: We've seen Filters and we've seen Round Robins, now we're seeing both! This is useful for keeping the Items in a select order like for when making Mystical Agriculture Seeds!
quest.7618153D6613790E.title: &6Thermal Springstone Scythe
quest.765F6A5A9779CF6D.quest_desc:
Aerclouds spawn all over &l&eThe Aether&r. I mean it is a sky Dimension, pretty much expected. 

Cold Aerclouds and &eGolden Aerclouds&r work the same. You'll sink slightly into them. Kind of like &6Honey&r, just less Sticky. They also absorb Fall Damage. 

&bBlue Aerclouds&r are different though. If you bounce off of it you'll get boosted high into the sky. When Shifting you'll sink all the way through them. 

You can pick up Aerclouds anywhere. You can also &5Enchant&r Cold Aerclouds to make &eGolden Aerclouds&r or &bFreeze&r Cold Aerclouds to make &bBlue Aerclouds&r.
quest.765F6A5A9779CF6D.title: Aerclouds
quest.766EEB89C6DF3575.quest_desc:
Eternal Stella can be used to either make an Item Unbreakable by combining it with the Item in a Smithing Table. Or you can use it to craft Alloy Tools! 

First, you'll need a Tier 3 Forge with plenty Materials in it. 

Then, you'll need 3 Xpetrified Orbs. Which you need to feed a Black Hole Items to get. 

Plus, a Stellarite Piece which you need to Mine for! And &6Allthemodium Ingot&r which is the same.
quest.7671AFAA1EFD287F.quest_desc:
You want to slowly automate &bAureal&r for your &6&lForge&r? Then, you'll need 2 &bArcane Crystal Blocks&r, &6Arcane Polished Darkstone&r, and &cMundabitur Dust&r! 

Place down the &6Arcane Polished Darkstone&r, then on top of it place both &bArcane Crystal Blocks&r. 

Once you get this 1x3x1 Structure, Right Click it with &cMundabitur Dust&r to make the &bObelisk&r! 

You can place these, where the Pedestals usually go, in the &6&lForge Multiblock&r in order to automate &bAureal&r!
quest.769B23E692CBA16B.quest_desc: These act like normal Buckets and Boats. \n\nJust from &l&eThe Aether&r!
quest.769B23E692CBA16B.title: &2Skyroot&r Boat and Bucket
quest.76A0592F4C294545.quest_desc:
The Sawmill cuts Logs into Sawdust and more Planks than you would get from crafting. Sawdust can be used to make Paper.

 - Fustic Logs will also give you Fustic.
 - Brazilwood Logs and Logwood Logs will also give you Haematoxylin.
quest.76A3A2A97AB66C43.quest_desc:
Want to create a Spawn Egg from a Vengeance Spirit you have trapped in a &9Box of Eternal Closure&r?

The &9Spirit Reanimator&r does exactly that. Give it a lot of &cBlood&r and an Egg, and of course a &9Box of Eternal Closure&r with the Spirit you want to create the Spawn Egg from, and it will attempt to create the Spawn Egg!

Note: Some mobs cannot be used to create Spawn Eggs.
quest.76BFC5815FC6565C.quest_desc:
Rarely above ground in the &9&lStarlight&r a &5Meteor Shower&r may occur. 

While chunks of Meteors striking the ground just feet away from you in real life it is terrifying, in &2&lMinecraft&r it is helpful! 

When these happen a Material called &5Aethersent&r will Spawn on the ground where Meteors hit. As well as some Mobs might Spawn from those same Meteors!
quest.76BFC5815FC6565C.title: &5Meteor Shower
quest.76C63670624C3C56.quest_desc:
&c&lGenerator Galore&r gives us tons of helpful and simple Power Generators! 

Some can even be combined with each other to be more powerful. 

There is a Quest page for them it's just roomates with &7&lIron Furnaces&r.
quest.76CDC18D7A208512.quest_desc:
In The &2&lUndergarden&r, &cRot Mobs&r: &cRotling&f, &cRotwalker&f, &cRotbelcher&f, and the &cRotbeast&r can infect you with &cUtherium&r. 

It will show up as Red Bars above your Hunger Bars if you catch it. After 4 full Bars red lines will appear on your screen. At 8 Bars the Bars will start shaking to warn you it's getting worse. At 10 Bars all of them will glow and this is when you start taking Damage. 

&cRot&r will slowly go away on its own unless it is full. You can also get Purity from Mysterious Totems or Eat &3Rogdorium&r to get rid of it. 

Both of these come from the Depths, which Spawn below Y Level 0. You'll need a &aForgotten Pickaxe&r or another Pickaxe of the same Tier like &6Allthemodium&r to reach it. 

The only way to prevent the &cRot&r is by Infusing your Armor with &3Rogdorium&r using the Infuser.
quest.76CDC18D7A208512.title: Warning
quest.770C0975CA61CE46.title: &bGlacite
quest.7725CB7D0AE55180.title: Advanced AE
quest.7731623EA92027D9.title: Tier IV: The Archmage's Orb
quest.7766E66A14643F4D.quest_desc: &6Awakening&r is a relatively new addition to &2&lMystical Agriculture&r. Through the &6Awakening Ritual&r you can make &6Awakened Essence&r. \n\nThen you can combine those with Ingots to get this Block!
quest.7798BC7C5112D6FB.title: &bGlacite Leggings
quest.77B185799366ACD2.quest_desc:
To set the Block Filter you just have to click the Block you want to prevent accidentally breaking, with the Block Filter. 

Each Filter can only hold 1 Block so if you want Beehives, Cables, Chests, Furnaces, and Brewing Stands to no longer be accidentally destroyed you'll need 5 Block Filters. 

You can exchange the Block in it by simply clicking a different Block with it.
quest.77B5B23A2C01ED7E.quest_desc: The &9Kineticator&r works like a magnet for items and experience.\n\nThe &eReverse Kineticator&r will instead repel items and experience.
quest.77B5B23A2C01ED7E.title: Kineticators
quest.77F2271C45DB49BA.quest_desc: This Module, when put into the &aMekaSuit&r Chestplate, will give you Creative Flight. \nYou only need some of the most expensive Items in the game to craft it!
quest.78311531069807DE.quest_desc:
In Applied Energistics 2, every ME network has a certain number of &echannels&f available, which simply means how many networked devices can fit on the whole network.

As a rule of thumb, any device that more or less handles ME data directly (items stored within the network) and carries out some form of I/O will take up a channel. Usually components that are only concerned with the internal power storage of the network, like &eEnergy Cells&f and &eInscribers&f, do &onot&r take up channels.

Networks without an &bME Controller&f are known as 'ad-hoc' networks and only support a maximum of 8 channels.
quest.7834734E79E41A3A.quest_desc:
Please reconsider playing with the &l&6Bumblezone&r Mod if you suffer from any of these phobias: 

Melissophobia, Apiphobia, Entomophobia, Arachnophobia, Trypophobia, Acrophobia, Claustrophobia, and Crystallophobia. 

If you suffer from Trypophobia you can use the resource pack added by &l&6Bumblezone&r to help! If it's anything else you're screwed.
quest.7846B7FFC3DD85C5.title: &dSPS Ports
quest.7878F190BC8ADC82.quest_desc: The best of the best. From Diamonds, to the Nether Star, to Allthemodium. This Rod finds only the best Items!
quest.78AAFE5AF04A13AC.quest_desc:
&bAerbunnys&r bounce around on Air. If you could, you would too! 

They are Passive with only 3 &4Hearts&r. 

If you're evil enough to Kill one, they'll Drop String.
quest.78AAFE5AF04A13AC.title: &bAerbunny
quest.78B7FC6A868F5C4D.quest_desc:
You have to either find these in structures in the &6&lBumblezone&r or you can trade with the &5Bee Queen&r to get one! 

While wearing it you can hold Space Bar to fly for a little. 

Except like a &6B&8e&6e&r the Wings are too small to keep your fat little body off the ground.
quest.78BD3D4FBA42D3DC.quest_desc:
Sheepuffs are silly little animals found in the Aether. 

They look like normal Sheeps but sometimes they'll randomly bolt up in the air and slowly fall down. I don't know why, maybe it's fun! 

Sometimes the Sheepuffs will puff up with extra Wool, these can be Sheared twice in a row! 

They have 4 Hearts and Drop Raw Mutton and Wool.
quest.78BD3D4FBA42D3DC.title: Sheepuff
quest.78CE2ECEF0B651DA.title: &3Ice Sword
quest.78D26411B482CD5A.title: &dStarlit Diamond Shovel
quest.78D8F40AA9568511.quest_desc:
The Powered Rolling Machine is much better version of the Manual Rolling Machine. 

You don't have to keep looking in the machine to craft things and it will automatically craft all of them. 

The only problem is it needs power!
quest.78DD2A3DFF6D1613.quest_desc:
With 2 &2Bio Fuel&r we can make 1 &aSubstrate&r through the &2&lP.R.C.&r. 

Well... we'll also need &9Water&r and Hydrogen in the &2&lP.R.C.&r but then we'll get our &aSubstrate&r and also &dChemical Ethene&r. 

In order to make HDPE Pellets we'll need our &aSubstrate&r as well as turning our &dChemical Ethene&r into &dLiquid Ethene&r. We can use a &c&lRotary &bCondensator&r to turn it &bLiquid&r! 

Now throw both of our &dLiquid Ethene &fand &aSubstrates&r into the &2&lP.R.C.&r to make HDPE Pellets! 

We can then Craft 4 Pellets together to make a HDPE Rod or &dEnrich&r 3 of them to make a HDPE Sheet.
quest.78E40BDB0E54B638.quest_desc:
Can be found in structures in the &6&lBumblezone&r or traded for with the &5Bee Queen&r! 

Ever hate getting stuck on &6Honey Blocks&r? Or even when &ePollen&r slows you down? Well there's no need to fear for the Honey Bee Leggings are here! They will help you move better through those Blocks. The more Bee Armor you wear, the easier travel will bee! 

Also you can Shift through &ePollen&r to collect it!
quest.78E51D22C16C4686.quest_desc: The Storage Controller is also able to connect to other storages wirelessly, this is possible using the Storage Tool, just right click the Storage Controller to bind it and right click the storages to link them.\n\nThe range for wireless linking is the same as regular, 14 blocks of space.
quest.78E66F1DE42C747A.quest_desc:
&9Echo Shards&r can be pretty annoying to farm, plus we'll need a lot of them! So why not have an easier way of Farming them. 

With &d&lInfusion&r we can make 1 &9Echo Shard&r into 4! 

We'll need &a70 Eterna&r, &c50% Quanta&r, and &550% Arcana&r. 

To get that, we can use either of the following:

14 &9Deepshelves&r, that aren't &9Dormant&r!
13 &4Glowing Hellshelves&r and 2 &9Deepshelves&r!
12 &bCrystalline Seashelves&r and 2 &9Deepshelves&r!
quest.78FBB0C88182040E.quest_desc: If you haven't played Minecraft since 1.13 this might confuse you, but you know Crossbows and Piercing. They have an enchantment which allows their Arrows to go through multiple targets and continuously dealing damage. This Module does exactly that!
quest.78FBB0C88182040E.title: Wyvern Projectile Penetration Module
quest.7953C87C488A2AF7.quest_desc:
Allows you to fly like Iron Man.

You can only have one level of these Upgrades in the Boots at a time. Each level will use more pressure than the previous.

Use these upgrades, don't just craft them.
quest.795FA102F6577368.title: Got &4&lMorgan
quest.796E922CA69BAE82.title: &4Mega Disk Interface
quest.7975C7145572C438.quest_desc: Whether you are an experienced modded player, or a complete noob to MC, everyone has to make a &2Wooden Pickaxe&r.\n\nPickaxes allow you to break most stone and metal blocks. This wooden one won't last long, so make sure to gather some &3Cobblestone&r with it!
quest.79A1A63BCE7A541B.quest_desc: The &bInvisibility Cloak&r will make you Invisible. As the name and Pop Culture suggests! \n\nMobs won't see you when you're Invisible unless you get too close or Hit them.
quest.79A1A63BCE7A541B.title: &bInvisibility Cloak
quest.79B03F769746784A.title: &9Malarite Pickaxe
quest.79B33E4691E6CB45.title: &aFlowglaze Sword
quest.79C1105A84B8BF8F.quest_desc:
Variable Cards are necessary for starting Interactions like Importing Items. You will put them in one of the slots of the Importer to add them.

From there you can edit everything via the + Button. You can change how much is Importer, which Item Slot, which Channel, practically everything with just that Card.

If you're just wanting to move items, nothing too fancy just put it in and maybe change the Limit for how much is moved.
quest.79D2617E01481281.quest_desc: To get started with AE2, you will need to mine an important resource for the mod known as &bCertus Quartz&f. You will find Certus Quartz Crystals in Meteorites that you can mine for Certus Quartz &eDust&f and &eCrystals&f.
quest.7A066DD274F970C2.title: Right &6&lATM Star&r part
quest.7A103577EAE7B3F1.quest_desc: This is the Tier 5 - Awakened Essence, made by combining 4 Cognizant Dust, 10 of each Elemental Essence and 1 Supremium Block together in an Awakening Alter.
quest.7A4B51313FB134EA.quest_desc:
&6Phoenix Armor&r in total will give 20 Armor Points and 8 Toughness, same as &cNetherite&r. 

Just &6Phoenix Armor&r actually puts through on Fire Protection, as when you are wearing it you won't take Damage from &cFire &for &cLava&r! 

Careful walking into &9Water&r with it or you might end up with...
quest.7A4B51313FB134EA.title: &6Phoenix Armor
quest.7A514E27E1A7FE32.quest_desc:
Diamonds also allow us to create some cool gadgets to help us build using the mod &l&cBuilding Gadgets&r.

These are great tools to help you build bigger bases, or for clearing out space using the &cDestruction Gadget&r.

You can even link these to an AE2 network by putting it into a Wireless Access Point!
quest.7A579E233C69871F.quest_desc: &b&lHostile Neural Networks&r is all about simulating Mobs for farming their Loot! \n\nNot much else to it.
quest.7AC6A958936636D9.quest_desc: The &5Mountaineer's Spawner Upgrade Rune&r is the 3rd tier of Spawner Upgrade Runes. Yes, you'll need to fight a Warden for this.\n\nIt sets Minimum Spawn Delay to 50, Maximum Spawn Delay to 200, Spawn Count to 13, Max Entities to 24, and Activation Range to 40.
quest.7AD4ED72AC31D912.quest_desc: &3Aerwhales&r are huge, fast, flying, Passive Mobs in &l&eThe Aether&r. \n\nThey don't Drop anything on Death, they're just pretty.
quest.7AD4ED72AC31D912.title: &3Aerwhale
quest.7AEFF81E7C8CF300.quest_desc: Using Shift Right Click when holding a JDT tool or wand will open the configuration menu where the player can configure and toggle abilities.
quest.7AF8567CF8C543F7.title: &6Thermal Springstone Axe
quest.7AFEB7A91DC8F413.title: The Apprentice's Orb
quest.7B0764DDE94E73D0.quest_desc:
In bigger &2&lReactors&r we'll need a more advanced fail safe. 
For this one, our &2&lReactor&r will need to be atleast 5 Blocks wide. That gives 3 Block width for our 2 &2FRLA&r. 

Place 1 of our &2FRLA&r in the &2&lReactor&r and set it to either High Temperature or Damage Critical. Then, place the second one atleast 1 Block away while on the same Y Level. The second will need to be set to Activation. 

Now, let's do some &4Redstone&r! 

Place a &4Redstone Repeater&r facing out from the first &2FRLA&r. Then, where the &4Repeater&r is facing, place a Block that can transmit &4Redstone&r. 

On that Block, place a &4Redstone Torch&r in the direction that the second &2FRLA&r is. 

After that, place &4Redstone Dust&r next to the &4Torch&r, while on the same X/Z Level of the second &2FRLA&r. And lastly, place a second &4Redstone Repeater&r going from the &4Redstone Dust&r and into the second &2FRLA&r.
quest.7B140A034DF1291C.quest_desc: The &7&lNexium Emitter&r needs something to move it around, that can be either the &6Mechanical Arm&f or &6Large Advanced Motor&r! \n\nBoth move, so either work!
quest.7B2008977702D0C8.quest_subtitle: What happened to RF or FE?
quest.7B293C32824033F9.title: Activate the Crystallum Fractura
quest.7B447E986493AD6B.quest_desc:
&7Creosote Oil&r is a byproduct of the &lCoke Oven&r. 

Its main use will be for making Treated Wood, an essential Building Block of &8&lIE&r. 

You will also need it for a different Fluid later, we'll worry about it when we get there.
quest.7B4AF35313D7D779.title: &6Supreme Machine Frame
quest.7B5D34650BBD97D9.quest_desc: &5Aethersent&r is Dropped from &5Creteors&r and from &5Meteor Showers&r. \n\nMost &5Meteor Showers&r Drop a ton of them so don't worry!
quest.7B5D34650BBD97D9.title: &5Aethersent
quest.7B937E68FEFBBA98.title: &dStarlit Diamond Chestplate
quest.7BC616DDB5933479.quest_desc: This one can be created with a &5Blood Vial&r and normal ingrediants for Scrolls. \nYou will need to make sure it is Level 10 and &6Legendary&r which you can upgrade it to.
quest.7BC616DDB5933479.title: &4Wither Skull Scroll
quest.7BCD4A425CF6199B.quest_desc: After slaying the Goat of Mercy summoned from &9Xeovrenth Adjure&r, you'll find yourself one Cruelty Essence richer. Combine this with some Cocao Beans to create Brown Chalk.
quest.7BFB4DA68A7912E5.quest_desc:
Ambrosium is the Coal of &e&lThe Aether&r. 

We can make Torches out of it or use it as Furnace Fuel! 

You can also use it on Aether Grass to Enchant it.
quest.7BFB4DA68A7912E5.title: &eAmbrosium
quest.7C3D763CF22D167A.quest_desc:
The Starlight Charger can "enchant" materials with the "Star Charged" enchantment.

A structure must be built with the Starlight Charger in the middle in view of the night sky. It only gains Starlight Power during the night.

The Charger must be placed in the middle of a 7x7 structure, with a Pillar in each corner. Each pillar must have a "Starlight Charger Cap".

It also requires a charger catalyst per material.
quest.7C3F65B5DAC7E57B.quest_desc:
Deep within the &eEnd&r, hidden among ancient ruins, lies a &6relic&r woven from &9night itself&r... the &5Midnight Mantle&r. 

This mantle shifts with the &bsky&r above, growing stronger as the &9Moon&r reaches its peak, and fading into shadow when darkness takes over. 

- &lIt has 4 abilities:&r 

 1. &dLunar Phase&r: 
 Your &cdamage&r and &2attack speed&r are greatly increased, but their &cpower&r depends on how close the &9Moon&r is to its full phase. 

 2. &8Shadow&r: 
 In &olow light&r, the &omantle cloaks&r you in &8darkness&r, granting &linvisibility&r. Leaving the &8shadows weakens&r this effect for a &2&oshort time&r&r, and &cenemies&r must lose sight of you before it can be used again. 

 3. &7Constellation&r: 
 Taking &cdamage&r may summon wandering &zstars&r around you. These &estars&r can connect into constellations, disrupting &cenemies&r who cross them, or &cexplode&r when touched, &cdamaging&r everything nearby. 

 4. &eStarfall&r: 
 When you strike your &cenemies&r, there is a chance to call down a falling star, creating a &eshockwave&r on impact that &cdamages&r and briefly stuns targets. 

- A &6relic&r bound to the heavens... and to the &8darkness&r between them.
quest.7C3F65B5DAC7E57B.title: &5Midnight Mantle
quest.7C4D8AA107780795.quest_desc:
By using the &aFluidizer&r, we can combine &dBlutonium&r with &eYellorium&r to make &2Verderium.

When used as fuel in a reactor, &2Verderium&r produces &cRossinite&r as a reactant. We need this!

To use &2Verderium&r as a fuel, you'll need to make &cFuel Injection Ports&r for your reactor.

Note: You might need to empty out the fuel currently in your reactor, or make a new reactor for this purpose.
quest.7C4D8AA107780795.title: Rossinite
quest.7C53F52992EA2064.title: &4Amaramber Shovel
quest.7C5FC2015F1E6DB1.quest_desc:
All &8Trolls&r will hold Weapons. They use these &8Weapons&r to try and Kill you. 

Very rarely they'll Drop their &8Weapon&r upon Death. 

All these &8Weapons&r are massive! Yet the Player can still Hold and Use them! They do a ton of Damage but are very slow to Swing.
quest.7C5FC2015F1E6DB1.title: &8Troll Weapons
quest.7C758209D06ED0E3.quest_desc:
By combining an &4Infused Hellshelf&r with some &eGlowstone&r we can make &4Glowing Hellshelves&r! 

These have the same &aEterna&r and &cQuanta&r, but give &53.3333% Arcana&r. 

This will be helpful in later &d&lInfusions&r, like if we wish to use 13 of them to &d&lInfuse&r a &9Dormant Deepshelf&f into a &9Deepshelf&r!
quest.7C758209D06ED0E3.title: &4Glowing Hellshelf
quest.7C7C061FC04B89FB.quest_desc: Demonite, once refined, becomes &cHellforged Ingots&r — the backbone of nearly everything we'll build in the endgame.
quest.7C7C061FC04B89FB.title: Hellforged Steel
quest.7C7C0D3D7FCB0297.quest_desc:
Can be found in structures in the &6&lBumblezone&r or traded for with the &5Bee Queen&r! 

&6B&8e&6e&8s&r have quite an interesting way of finding and communicating with each other. I don't know how they do it so I'm just going to guess their Antennas give and receive radio signals. 

While wearing the Stingless Bee Helmet you can Shift to highlight all &6B&8e&6e&8s&r around you. 

Also while wearing it, poison and nausea will go away quicker.
quest.7C9154EF6068BE27.quest_desc:
Technically you can also use the Crusher to make the &6&lATM Star&r into 5 &6Star Shards&r... 

But you'll need 262 to make a new &6&lStar&r... 

So why would you?
quest.7C9D9D1C054874A7.quest_desc:
Ever want the most perfect &5Enchantments&r? Like, every stat maxed out, every good &5Enchantment&r available? Then, you'll need these! 

First, is the 5 &9Soul-Touched Sculkshelves&r and 5 &9Echoing Sculkshelves&r. These will give us all the &cQuanta&r and &5Arcana&r we need! 

Next, is the &dDraconic Endshelf&r which will give us &a100 Eterna&r, as in amount of &aEterna&r and the max level. 

Third, is the &6Geode-Encased Bookshelf of Stability&r, this will make it so the &cQuanta&r doesn't backstab us with awful &5Enchantments&r! 

Last is optional but you should add it, the &6Deepshelf of Arcane Treasures&r. That &7Bookshelf&r will allow us to get &5Enchantments&r we normally wouldn't, like &5Mending&r!
quest.7C9D9D1C054874A7.quest_subtitle: Without the Enchanting Table of the Raven
quest.7CBEBBCB9D95D11A.quest_desc:
The &5Abyssal Egg&r is also a drop from &5&lThe Leviathan&r, because apparently you killed a pregnant one. 

Place the &5Egg&r down, then wait awhile and you'll have your own baby &5Leviathan&r. 

Once its hatched you can feed it a ton of Tropical Fish to tame it. 

The &5baby&r has 1200 &4Hearts&r and can heal by feeding it Tropical Fish. 

Once tamed, like the &eModern Remnant&r it can be set with Shift Right Click to follow or stay or wander.
quest.7CBF22CCCF599F26.quest_desc:
To make the &cSiren Flute&r you'll need the previously mentioned &bShiny Scales&r, plus a &cSiren Tear&r. 

&cSiren Tears&r are rare Drops from &cSirens&r and will make the &cFlute&r or the Banner. 

The &cSiren Flute&r will basically give Weakness 1 Million to the Mob you are looking at. They will fall in Love, and when in Love they won't Attack you. 

The &cFlute&r does have a Cooldown though.
quest.7CC96CE9901F25BB.quest_desc:
&l&5Forbidden and Arcanus&r is another magic mod, this one revolving around the Multiblock structure called, the Hephaestus Forge.

To make it follow the instructions in the forge's tooltip! Once made you can feed it the 4 Materials to power Rituals: Aureal, Souls, Blood, and Experience.

You'll also need to upgrade the Forge via Rituals (all these you can find in JEI).
quest.7CF9A68167ADAD1A.title: A Sluggish Heart Serves No One
quest.7D1A27CBF1508712.quest_desc:
The &3Snow Queen&r lives in the &bAurora Palace&r within the Glacier Biome. 

You'll need to kill the Alpha Yeti in order to enter the Glacier Biome. 

Once usurped, she will drop a ton of loot, Trophy included!
quest.7D40B80DBBC4E160.quest_desc:
The Manual Rolling Machine will be your little crafting machine for many things material for railcraft! 

When you put the recipe in and it can make more than 1 it will autocraft while you're still looking at it. When you leave the Rolling Machine while crafting it will abort the crafting and put it in your inventory. 

You must manually build the last recipe!
quest.7D68FD0637351E02.title: &6Thermal Springstone Helmet
quest.7D7BB45D84A4E94A.quest_desc:
When wearing the &3Swet Cape&r, &9Swets&r will become Friendly! 

Now instead of getting captured, you can ride them safely. 

They take a lot less Fall Damage when they aren't trying to kill you.
quest.7D7BB45D84A4E94A.title: &3Swet Cape
quest.7D7BD1458CF12021.title: &5Lunaris Cactus
quest.7D7E4C31DFE59E29.title: Wyvern Projectile Damage Module
quest.7D972A3C4211EB26.quest_desc: &zRainbow Coal&r is obtained by blowing up a &zRainbow Furnace&r.
quest.7DAED14CEC4CDA51.quest_desc:
&aNature's Aura&r is a magic mod about using and replenishing &aAura&r. These quests will just go over some of the basics.

To get started, make some &eBrilliant Fiber&r which is made with &eGold Nuggets&r, &aLeaves&r and &aGrass&r. Right-clicking on any leaves with &eBrilliant Fiber&r will turn them into &eGolden Leaves&r.

Make sure to read the &aBook of Natural Aura&r, you can also use it to show how to make the multiblocks in &aNature's Aura&r.
quest.7DD638E4111D66E7.quest_desc: Advanced Storage Housing&r is required in order to craft high tier &9Storage Disks&r.
quest.7DD638E4111D66E7.title: &8Advanced Storage Housing
quest.7E07C5A6FA6B6B1F.title: Blutonium
quest.7E35ED5B30697722.quest_desc:
Ever wanted the ultimate Quantum Computer setup? Well, here's a setup for you, focused on maximizing co-processing threads.

218 Quantum Computer Structural Glass, 123 Quantum Computer Accelerators, 1 Quantum Computer Core, and 1 Quantum Computer Multi-Threader are what we need. This gives us a total of 8928 co-processing threads. Note that I did not include any storage here besides the core, as the 256M crafting storage from the core is plenty enough already. The Data Entangler quest is optional for a reason.

Get 200 Q.C. Structural Glass and 100 Q.C. Accelerators, and I'll give you the rest, because I'm just as generous as the Apothic Enchanting chapter.
quest.7E35ED5B30697722.title: The Ultimate Quantum Computer
quest.7E3B19796870C2B1.quest_desc: The &#9955EDChemical Reactor&r will be one of the most useful machines for you going forward. It will be used to create several chemicals.
quest.7E4367252A39BE6C.quest_desc: &c&lPowah&r is about power! Generating Power like FE to use Machines from other Mods like &5&lMekanism&r or &lIndustrial Foregoing&r! \n\nThere's different Tiers you'll have to craft up to and of course we'll need the last one for the &6&lStar&r!
quest.7E4367252A39BE6C.title: &c&lPowah
quest.7E79F52147B606F9.quest_desc:
To start collecting blood, we need to craft the &cBlood Extractor&r.

As long as you have this in your inventory, killing mobs will collect blood into the extractor. &cBlood&r is an important resource in EvilCraft.

Need to increase the storage of the Extractor? Simply make another, and then combine them in a crafting grid! You can also use Dark Tanks to increase the Extractor's storage.

These can also be used to extract blood from &cBlood Stains&r you find (or create) on the ground.

Lastly, with enough blood stored, you can sneak-right click on the ground to place a bucket of blood down.
quest.7E92ED270C67FDE5.quest_desc: Almost every single machine you can make in the mod will require a &9Dielectric Casing&r.\n\nYou'll need to make the &bPaste&r first, as well as some &aRods&r to progress!
quest.7EC8814940C4C3D7.title: Personal Shrinking Device
quest.7EF873DCEB3B9D48.quest_desc:
The last &lWorld Tier&r, &lWorld Tier: &4Pinnacle&r. To get it, you'll need to Kill the &d&lEnder Dragon&r atleast once, and equip all &5Epic&r or &6Mythic&r &eArmor &fand &eTool/Weapon&r. 

Now &5Epic&r and &6Mythic&r are most common for &aGems &fand &eTools&r, plus we are more likely to get &zPerfect&r gems! This comes at the loss of &8Common&r and &aUncommon&r but hey, who'll miss them! 

On the same pattern of upgrades you'll get 125% Experience Gained and 100% Luck increase, and your &aMax Eterna&r reaches its highest point, &a100&r. 

&4Monsters&r will receive their final upgrade, getting: 16 Armor Points, 20 Armor Toughness, 25 Armor Pierce, and 20 Protection Pierce.
quest.7F007C888C23EC42.quest_desc:
The &5Gem Case&r is the single greatest &aApotheosis Gem&r storage, ever! 

To Craft it you'll need 1 &3Ender Chest&r, 1 &5Gem Cutting Table&r, 4 Basalt, and 3 Glass blocks. 

To use it, you can either Shift Left Click &aGems&r or bring them into the &9Blue Slot&r. This will add the &aGems&r to the &5Case&r.

The &5Case&r can only hold up to 32768 of each unique &aGem&r and Purity (for example, the &5Case&r can hold 32k &zPerfect Gems of the Warlord&r, and 32k &aChipped Gems of the Warlord&r), and they can be extracted by Left Clicking the stored &aGem&r type, then Left Clicking one of the shown Purities.

You can also use the &5Gem Case&r as a Gem Cutting Table, using Rarity Materials and &9Gem Dust&r in the slots to the left. Left Click a stored &aGem&r type, then Left Click one of the hammers to upgrade 2 of those &aGems&r to the next Purity.
quest.7F007C888C23EC42.title: &5Gem Case
quest.7F0B2D58361FB00E.quest_desc: Just Dire Things is a jack of all trades mod. Just Dire Things adds a new crafting mechanic called Goo Spread, along with machines that assist in the automation of Goo Spread and other utilities.
quest.7F0B2D58361FB00E.title: Just Dire Things
quest.7F187E291C3D5BA7.quest_desc: The Fluid Unloader is the exact opposite of the Fluid Loader. Instead of being over the &6Track&r its under. Instead of giving &3Steam Locomotives&r water it takes their water. I don't know why you'd want to do that but you can!
quest.7F187E291C3D5BA7.title: Fluid Unloader
quest.7F4B734CFB0F0306.quest_desc: These new &7Carts&r are similar to the special &2Vanilla&r &7Carts&r. The &7Minecart with a Tank&r will hold and move any Liquid held in it. The &7Minecart with an Energy cell&r will instead hold and move Energy!
quest.7F4B734CFB0F0306.title: New Carts
quest.7F6B66566C211735.quest_desc: Runes of Debilitation used on the spawner will reduce the max health of the mob spawned. This can decrease their health to as low as 20%
quest.7FBB431AC055FE93.quest_desc:
The &7Soulit Spectator&r is crafted with a &9Soul Dew&r and a &9Nightfal Spider Eye&r. 

It works similar to a Sticky Camera from Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell. You can Right Click to send the &7Spectator&r and after a bit you will be able to see out of it. You can even see yourself with it! 

It can't be ended early so careful when you use it. It also has durability and a cooldown.
quest.7FBB431AC055FE93.title: &7Soulit Spectator
quest.7FBD51663C1A711A.title: &4Amaramber Sword
quest.7FE969CB4B419FC6.quest_desc: With a little work into Mekanism, this machine allows you to transfer anything wirelessly.\n\nYou can set specific channels to transfer individual items, energy, or even gases from Mekanism. It's pretty cool.
